import Mathlib

open BigOperators Finset Matrix

/-- Values are monotone increasing down columns -/
lemma mono_down {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    A (Fin.castSucc i) j ≤ A (Fin.succ i) j := by
  rcases hb i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Values are monotone increasing rightward in rows -/
lemma mono_right {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    A i (Fin.castSucc j) ≤ A i (Fin.succ j) := by
  rcases hc i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Monotonicity for multiple steps down a column -/
lemma mono_down_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i i' : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) (hi : i ≤ i') : A i j ≤ A i' j := by
  induction i' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hi0 : i = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hi
    rw [hi0]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hik : i ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    ·
      have h1 := ih hik
      have h2 := mono_down hb k j
      omega
    ·
      push_neg at hik
      have heq : i = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < i := hik
        have h2 : (i : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hi
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]

/-- If entry is positive, all entries below are positive (downward closure) -/
lemma pos_of_pos_above {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    {i i' : Fin (m + 2)} {j : Fin (m + 2)}
    (h : A i j > 0) (hi : i ≤ i') : A i' j > 0 := by
  have hmono := mono_down_le hb i i' j hi
  omega

/-- Monotonicity for multiple steps right in a row -/
lemma mono_right_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j j' : Fin (m + 2)) (hj : j ≤ j') : A i j ≤ A i j' := by
  induction j' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hj
    rw [hj0]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hjk : j ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    ·
      have h1 := ih hjk
      have h2 := mono_right hc i k
      omega
    ·
      push_neg at hjk
      have heq : j = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < j := hjk
        have h2 : (j : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hj
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]

/-- If entry is positive, all entries to the right are positive (rightward closure) -/
lemma pos_of_pos_left {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i : Fin (m + 2)} {j j' : Fin (m + 2)}
    (h : A i j > 0) (hj : j ≤ j') : A i j' > 0 := by
  have hmono := mono_right_le hc i j j' hj
  omega

/-- The first nonzero entry in a column equals 1 -/
lemma first_nonzero_col_eq_one {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i j : Fin (m + 2)} (hpos : A i j > 0)
    (hfirst : ∀ i' : Fin (m + 2), i' < i → A i' j = 0) : A i j = 1 := by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  ·
    subst hi
    have hj_gt_m : (j : ℕ) > m := by
      by_contra h_le
      push_neg at h_le
      have := ha 0 j (by simp; omega)
      omega
    have hj_eq : j = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
      apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [Fin.last]
      have hj_le := Fin.is_le j
      omega
    subst hj_eq
    have h0m : A 0 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m)) = 0 := by
      apply ha
      simp [Fin.last, Fin.coe_castSucc]
    have hstep := hc 0 (Fin.last m)
    simp only [Fin.succ_last] at hstep
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h, h0m] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, h0m]
  ·
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
    subst hi'
    have h_above_zero : A (Fin.castSucc i') j = 0 := by
      apply hfirst
      exact Fin.castSucc_lt_succ i'
    have hstep := hb i' j
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, h_above_zero]

/-- The first nonzero entry in a row equals 1 -/
lemma first_nonzero_row_eq_one {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i j : Fin (m + 2)} (hpos : A i j > 0)
    (hfirst : ∀ j' : Fin (m + 2), j' < j → A i j' = 0) : A i j = 1 := by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  ·
    subst hj
    have hi_gt_m : (i : ℕ) > m := by
      by_contra h_le
      push_neg at h_le
      have := ha i 0 (by simp; omega)
      omega
    have hi_eq : i = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
      apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [Fin.last]
      have hi_le := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    subst hi_eq
    have hm0 : A (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m)) 0 = 0 := by
      apply ha
      simp [Fin.last, Fin.coe_castSucc]
    have hstep := hb (Fin.last m) 0
    simp only [Fin.succ_last] at hstep
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h, hm0] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, hm0]
  ·
    obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hj
    subst hj'
    have h_left_zero : A i (Fin.castSucc j') = 0 := by
      apply hfirst
      exact Fin.castSucc_lt_succ j'
    have hstep := hc i j'
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, h_left_zero]

/-- Each step down increases by at most 1 -/
lemma step_down_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    A (Fin.succ i) j ≤ A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1 := by
  rcases hb i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Each step right increases by at most 1 -/
lemma step_right_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    A i (Fin.succ j) ≤ A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1 := by
  rcases hc i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Entry bounded by path length down -/
lemma entry_le_path_down {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i i' : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) (hi : i ≤ i') :
    A i' j ≤ A i j + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)) := by
  induction i' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hi0 : i = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hi
    rw [hi0]; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hik : i ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    · have h1 := ih hik
      have h2 := step_down_le hb k j
      have hcs : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) := Fin.coe_castSucc k
      have hsucc : (Fin.succ k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + 1 := Fin.val_succ k
      have hi_le : (i : ℕ) ≤ (k : ℕ) := by
        rw [← hcs]
        exact hik
      omega
    · push_neg at hik
      have heq : i = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < i := hik
        have h2 : (i : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hi
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]; simp

/-- Entry bounded by path length right -/
lemma entry_le_path_right {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j j' : Fin (m + 2)) (hj : j ≤ j') :
    A i j' ≤ A i j + ((j' : ℕ) - (j : ℕ)) := by
  induction j' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hj
    rw [hj0]; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hjk : j ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    · have h1 := ih hjk
      have h2 := step_right_le hc i k
      have hcs : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) := Fin.coe_castSucc k
      have hsucc : (Fin.succ k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + 1 := Fin.val_succ k
      have hj_le : (j : ℕ) ≤ (k : ℕ) := by
        rw [← hcs]
        exact hjk
      omega
    · push_neg at hjk
      have heq : j = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < j := hjk
        have h2 : (j : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hj
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]; simp

/-- Entry bounded by total path length from any smaller position -/
lemma entry_le_path {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (p i : Fin (m + 2)) (q j : Fin (m + 2)) (hp : p ≤ i) (hq : q ≤ j) :
    A i j ≤ A p q + ((i : ℕ) - (p : ℕ)) + ((j : ℕ) - (q : ℕ)) := by
  have h1 := entry_le_path_down hb p i q hp
  have h2 := entry_le_path_right hc i q j hq
  omega

/-- Key lemma: Entry value is bounded by distance from zero-boundary -/
lemma entry_le_dist_from_zero {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i j : Fin (m + 2)) (hpos : A i j > 0) :
    A i j ≤ (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) - m := by
  have hij_gt_m : (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) > m := by
    by_contra h_le
    push_neg at h_le
    have := ha i j h_le
    omega
  by_cases hi_le : (i : ℕ) ≤ m
  ·
    have hq_def : m - (i : ℕ) < m + 2 := by omega
    let q : Fin (m + 2) := ⟨m - (i : ℕ), hq_def⟩
    have hq_le_j : q ≤ j := by
      simp only [q, Fin.le_def]
      omega
    have hpq_sum : (i : ℕ) + (q : ℕ) ≤ m := by simp only [q]; omega
    have h_zero : A i q = 0 := ha i q hpq_sum
    have h_path := entry_le_path hb hc i i q j (le_refl i) hq_le_j
    simp only [Nat.sub_self, add_zero] at h_path
    rw [h_zero] at h_path
    simp only [zero_add] at h_path
    calc A i j ≤ (j : ℕ) - (q : ℕ) := h_path
      _ = (j : ℕ) - (m - (i : ℕ)) := by simp [q]
      _ = (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) - m := by omega
  ·
    push_neg at hi_le
    have hi_eq : (i : ℕ) = m + 1 := by
      have h := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    have hp_def : m < m + 2 := by omega
    let p : Fin (m + 2) := ⟨m, hp_def⟩
    have hp_le_i : p ≤ i := by simp [p, Fin.le_def, hi_eq]
    have hpq_sum : (p : ℕ) + ((0 : Fin (m + 2)) : ℕ) ≤ m := by simp [p]
    have h_zero : A p 0 = 0 := ha p 0 hpq_sum
    have hq_le_j : (0 : Fin (m + 2)) ≤ j := Fin.zero_le j
    have h_path := entry_le_path hb hc p i 0 j hp_le_i hq_le_j
    rw [h_zero] at h_path
    simp only [zero_add, Fin.val_zero, Nat.sub_zero] at h_path
    calc A i j ≤ (i : ℕ) - (p : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) := h_path
      _ = (i : ℕ) - m + (j : ℕ) := by simp [p]
      _ = (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) - m := by omega

/-- Column sum is bounded by triangular number of nonzero count -/
lemma col_sum_bound {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    let t_j := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0)).card
    ∑ i : Fin (m + 2), A i j ≤ t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := by
  set S := univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0) with hS_def
  intro t_j
  have h_sum_eq : ∑ i : Fin (m + 2), A i j = ∑ i ∈ S, A i j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := univ) (p := fun i => A i j ≠ 0)]
    simp only [not_not, hS_def]
    have : ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => A i j = 0), A i j = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    linarith
  rw [h_sum_eq]
  by_cases hS_empty : S.card = 0
  ·
    have hS_eq_empty : S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hS_empty
    rw [hS_eq_empty]
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty, Nat.zero_le]
  have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hS_empty)
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0_mem, hi0_min⟩ := S.exists_min_image id hS_nonempty
  have hi0_nonzero : A i0 j ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi0_mem).2
  have hi0_pos : A i0 j > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0_nonzero
  have h_above_zero : ∀ i' : Fin (m + 2), i' < i0 → A i' j = 0 := by
    intro i' hi'
    by_contra h_nonzero
    have hi'_mem : i' ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i', h_nonzero⟩
    have := hi0_min i' hi'_mem
    simp at this
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi' this)
  have hi0_eq_one : A i0 j = 1 := first_nonzero_col_eq_one ha hb hc hi0_pos h_above_zero
  have h_pos_below : ∀ i : Fin (m + 2), i0 ≤ i → A i j > 0 := fun i hi => pos_of_pos_above hb hi0_pos hi
  have hS_char : S = univ.filter (fun i => i0 ≤ i) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hS_def]
    constructor
    · intro h_nonzero
      by_contra h_lt
      push_neg at h_lt
      have := h_above_zero i h_lt
      exact h_nonzero this
    · intro hi0_le
      have := h_pos_below i hi0_le
      omega
  have h_entry_bound : ∀ i ∈ S, A i j ≤ (i : ℕ) - (i0 : ℕ) + 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hi0_le : i0 ≤ i := by
      rw [hS_char] at hi
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have := entry_le_path_down hb i0 i j hi0_le
    rw [hi0_eq_one] at this
    omega
  have h_sum_le : ∑ i ∈ S, A i j ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, ((i : ℕ) - (i0 : ℕ) + 1) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    exact h_entry_bound i hi
  have hi0_bound : (i0 : ℕ) ≤ m + 1 := Fin.is_le i0
  have hS_card : S.card = m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ) := by
    rw [hS_char]
    have heq : univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => i0 ≤ i) = Finset.Icc i0 (Fin.last (m + 1)) := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Icc, Fin.le_last, and_true]
    rw [heq, Fin.card_Icc, Fin.last, Fin.val_mk]
  have ht_j : t_j = m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ) := hS_card
  have h_sum_reindex : ∑ i ∈ S, ((i : ℕ) - (i0 : ℕ) + 1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range t_j, (k + 1) := by
    rw [hS_char, ht_j]
    refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun (i : Fin (m + 2)) _ => (i : ℕ) - (i0 : ℕ))
                           (fun (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Finset.range (m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ))) =>
                             (⟨k + (i0 : ℕ), by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk; omega⟩ : Fin (m + 2)))
                           ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      have hi_bound := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    ·
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fin.le_def, Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    ·
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      ring
  have h_sum_compute : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range t_j, (k + 1) = t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_id]
    cases ht : t_j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n =>
      have hdiv2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) := by
        rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
        · exact ⟨k * (n + 1), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
        · exact ⟨(k + 1) * n, by rw [hk]; ring⟩
      have key : n * (n + 1) / 2 + (n + 1) = (n + 1) * (n + 2) / 2 := by
        have h1 : n * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1) = (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by ring
        have h2 : 2 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by
          rcases Nat.even_or_odd (n + 1) with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
          ·
            exact ⟨k * (n + 2), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
          ·
            have hn : n = 2 * k := by omega
            exact ⟨(k + 1) * (n + 1), by rw [hn]; ring⟩
        have h3 : n * (n + 1) / 2 + (n + 1) = (n * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1)) / 2 := by
          have := Nat.div_add_mod (n * (n + 1)) 2
          have hmod : n * (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp hdiv2
          have hdiv_eq : n * (n + 1) / 2 * 2 = n * (n + 1) := by omega
          omega
        rw [h3, h1]
        conv_rhs => rw [mul_comm]
      have h_comm : n * (n + 1) = (n + 1) * n := by ring
      rw [h_comm] at key
      exact key
  calc ∑ i ∈ S, A i j
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, ((i : ℕ) - (i0 : ℕ) + 1) := h_sum_le
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range t_j, (k + 1) := h_sum_reindex
    _ = t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := h_sum_compute

/-- Sum of (m+2-i) over nonzero positions in column j equals triangular number -/
lemma col_weight_sum_eq {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    let t_j := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0)).card
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0), (m + 2 - (i : ℕ)) =
    t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := by
  set S := univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0) with hS_def
  intro t_j
  by_cases hS_empty : S.card = 0
  ·
    have hS_eq_empty : S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hS_empty
    have ht_j_zero : t_j = 0 := hS_empty
    simp only [hS_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, ht_j_zero, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_div]
  have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hS_empty)
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0_mem, hi0_min⟩ := S.exists_min_image id hS_nonempty
  have hi0_nonzero : A i0 j ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi0_mem).2
  have hi0_pos : A i0 j > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0_nonzero
  have h_above_zero : ∀ i' : Fin (m + 2), i' < i0 → A i' j = 0 := by
    intro i' hi'
    by_contra h_nonzero
    have hi'_mem : i' ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i', h_nonzero⟩
    have := hi0_min i' hi'_mem
    simp at this
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi' this)
  have h_pos_below : ∀ i : Fin (m + 2), i0 ≤ i → A i j > 0 := fun i hi => pos_of_pos_above hb hi0_pos hi
  have hS_char : S = univ.filter (fun i => i0 ≤ i) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hS_def]
    constructor
    · intro h_nonzero
      by_contra h_lt
      push_neg at h_lt
      have := h_above_zero i h_lt
      exact h_nonzero this
    · intro hi0_le
      have := h_pos_below i hi0_le
      omega
  have hi0_bound : (i0 : ℕ) ≤ m + 1 := Fin.is_le i0
  have hS_card : S.card = m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ) := by
    rw [hS_char]
    have heq : univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => i0 ≤ i) = Finset.Icc i0 (Fin.last (m + 1)) := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Icc, Fin.le_last, and_true]
    rw [heq, Fin.card_Icc, Fin.last, Fin.val_mk]
  have ht_j : t_j = m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ) := hS_card
  have h_sum_reindex : ∑ i ∈ S, (m + 2 - (i : ℕ)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range t_j, (k + 1) := by
    rw [hS_char, ht_j]
    refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun (i : Fin (m + 2)) _ => m + 1 - (i : ℕ))
                           (fun (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Finset.range (m + 2 - (i0 : ℕ))) =>
                             (⟨m + 1 - k, by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk; omega⟩ : Fin (m + 2)))
                           ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      have hi_bound := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    ·
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fin.le_def, Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      have hi_bound := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    ·
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    ·
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      have hi_bound : (i : ℕ) ≤ m + 1 := Fin.is_le i
      have h1 : m + 2 - (i : ℕ) = (m + 1 - (i : ℕ)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [h1]
  have h_sum_compute : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range t_j, (k + 1) = t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_id]
    cases ht : t_j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n =>
      have hdiv2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) := by
        rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
        · exact ⟨k * (n + 1), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
        · exact ⟨(k + 1) * n, by rw [hk]; ring⟩
      have key : n * (n + 1) / 2 + (n + 1) = (n + 1) * (n + 2) / 2 := by
        have h1 : n * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1) = (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by ring
        have h2 : 2 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by
          rcases Nat.even_or_odd (n + 1) with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
          ·
            exact ⟨k * (n + 2), by rw [hk]; ring⟩
          ·
            have hn : n = 2 * k := by omega
            exact ⟨(k + 1) * (n + 1), by rw [hn]; ring⟩
        have h3 : n * (n + 1) / 2 + (n + 1) = (n * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1)) / 2 := by
          have := Nat.div_add_mod (n * (n + 1)) 2
          have hmod : n * (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp hdiv2
          have hdiv_eq : n * (n + 1) / 2 * 2 = n * (n + 1) := by omega
          omega
        rw [h3, h1]
        conv_rhs => rw [mul_comm]
      have h_comm : n * (n + 1) = (n + 1) * n := by ring
      rw [h_comm] at key
      exact key
  rw [h_sum_reindex, h_sum_compute]

name: Lambda.call_node_eval_eq
statement:
/-- When a factory call's arguments ARE all fully reduced, evaluating the renamed
    call in the renamed store equals evaluating the original call in the pulled-back
    store: the residual `.fst` lists coincide (each argument value-syncs), and the
    shared reduct is CLOSED (its free variables come only from the canonical — hence
    closed — argument residuals), so `eval` is store-independent on it. -/
theorem call_node_eval_eq
    (hIdent : ∀ a b : Tbase.Identifier, a.name = b.name → a = b)
    (n' : Nat) (F : @Factory Tbase) (σ' : Env Tbase) (hWF : FactoryWF F) (hClosed : FactoryClosed F)
    (hwfs : ∀ x v, σ' x = some v → LExpr.isCanonicalValue F v = true)
    (sm : Map Tbase.Identifier (LExpr Tbase.mono))
    (hVar : VarOnly sm)
    (e : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (op_expr : LExpr Tbase.mono) (args : List (LExpr Tbase.mono)) (lfunc : LFunc Tbase)
    (hcall : F.callOfLFunc e = some (op_expr, args, lfunc))
    (hcanF : LExpr.isCanonicalValue F e = false)
    (hfull : (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).snd.isValueTrue) = true)
    (ih : ∀ (e v : LExpr Tbase.mono),
      LExpr.eval n' F σ' (e.substFvars sm) = (v, .value true) ↔
        LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e = (v, .value true))
    (v : LExpr Tbase.mono) :
    (LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F σ' (LExpr.substFvars e sm) = (v, .value true))
      ↔ (LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e = (v, .value true))
src:
/-- When a factory call's arguments ARE all fully reduced, evaluating the renamed
    call in the renamed store equals evaluating the original call in the pulled-back
    store: the residual `.fst` lists coincide (each argument value-syncs), and the
    shared reduct is CLOSED (its free variables come only from the canonical — hence
    closed — argument residuals), so `eval` is store-independent on it. -/
theorem call_node_eval_eq
    (hIdent : ∀ a b : Tbase.Identifier, a.name = b.name → a = b)
    (n' : Nat) (F : @Factory Tbase) (σ' : Env Tbase) (hWF : FactoryWF F) (hClosed : FactoryClosed F)
    (hwfs : ∀ x v, σ' x = some v → LExpr.isCanonicalValue F v = true)
    (sm : Map Tbase.Identifier (LExpr Tbase.mono))
    (hVar : VarOnly sm)
    (e : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (op_expr : LExpr Tbase.mono) (args : List (LExpr Tbase.mono)) (lfunc : LFunc Tbase)
    (hcall : F.callOfLFunc e = some (op_expr, args, lfunc))
    (hcanF : LExpr.isCanonicalValue F e = false)
    (hfull : (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).snd.isValueTrue) = true)
    (ih : ∀ (e v : LExpr Tbase.mono),
      LExpr.eval n' F σ' (e.substFvars sm) = (v, .value true) ↔
        LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e = (v, .value true))
    (v : LExpr Tbase.mono) :
    (LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F σ' (LExpr.substFvars e sm) = (v, .value true))
      ↔ (LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e = (v, .value true)) := by
  -- Both stores bind only closed (canonical) values.
  have henvσ' : ∀ x v, σ' x = some v → LExpr.LExpr.getVars v = [] := by
    intro x v hx; exact isCanonicalValue_getVars_nil F v (hwfs x v hx)
  have henvPB : ∀ x v, substStoreExpr σ' sm x = some v → LExpr.LExpr.getVars v = [] := by
    intro x v hx
    exact isCanonicalValue_getVars_nil F v (pullback_closed F σ' hwfs sm hVar x v hx)
  -- The renamed and pullback argument residual lists coincide, and the
  -- `argsAllFull` bit agrees.
  have hfullL : ((args.map (LExpr.substFvars · sm)).all
      fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F σ' a).snd.isValueTrue) = true := by
    rw [call_argsAllFull_eq n' F σ' sm ih args]; exact hfull
  have hfst := call_args_fst_eq n' F σ' sm ih args (by simpa using hfullL)
  have hbit := call_argsAllFull_eq n' F σ' sm ih args
  have hcanFL : LExpr.isCanonicalValue F (LExpr.substFvars e sm) = false := by
    rw [isCanonicalValue_substFvars_eq F sm hVar e]; exact hcanF
  have hcallL : F.callOfLFunc (LExpr.substFvars e sm)
      = some (op_expr, args.map (LExpr.substFvars · sm), lfunc) :=
    callOfLFunc_substFvars F e sm op_expr args lfunc hcall
  -- Each reduct that is actually evaluated is closed, so `eval_env_congr` makes the
  -- two evaluations (in `σ'` vs `substStoreExpr σ' sm`) agree on it.
  have hstore_indep : ∀ (r : LExpr Tbase.mono),
      LExpr.LExpr.getVars r = [] →
      LExpr.eval n' F σ' r = LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) r :=
    fun r hr => eval_env_congr hIdent n' F σ' (substStoreExpr σ' sm) hWF hClosed henvPB r
      (fun x hx => by rw [hr] at hx; simp at hx)
  -- Each pullback-side argument residual is fully reduced, hence canonical, hence
  -- closed (`getVars = []`).
  have hargClosed : ∀ a ∈ args,
      LExpr.LExpr.getVars (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).fst = [] := by
    intro a ha
    have haVT : (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).snd.isValueTrue = true := by
      have := (List.all_eq_true).mp hfull a ha
      simpa using this
    have hsnd : (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).snd = .value true := by
      cases hs : (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).snd with
      | value b => cases b with
        | true => rfl
        | false => rw [hs] at haVT; simp [LExpr.EvalResult.isValueTrue] at haVT
      | nonvalue => rw [hs] at haVT; simp [LExpr.EvalResult.isValueTrue] at haVT
      | outOfFuel => rw [hs] at haVT; simp [LExpr.EvalResult.isValueTrue] at haVT
    have hcana := eval_value_isCanonicalValue n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a (b := true) hsnd
    exact isCanonicalValue_getVars_nil F _ hcana
  -- Bundled facts needed to bound the reducts' free variables.
  have h_mem := callOfLFunc_func_mem F _ _ _ lfunc false hcall
  have h_wf := hWF.lfuncs_wf lfunc h_mem
  have h_closed := hClosed.lfuncs_closed lfunc h_mem
  obtain ⟨mo, no, to, hop_eq, _, h_arity⟩ := callOfLFunc_eq_some hcall
  -- Every element of the pullback-side residual list is closed.
  have hRclosed : ∀ r ∈ args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).fst),
      LExpr.LExpr.getVars r = [] := by
    intro r hr; rw [List.mem_map] at hr
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hr; exact hargClosed a ha
  -- The two evaluations either coincide (shared closed reduct + store independence)
  -- or are both `.nonvalue`.  Phrased as a plain disjunction, the shared branch
  -- structure is `split`-able (unlike the biconditional, whose `dite`s straddle the
  -- `↔`).  After the rewrites both sides share every scrutinee, so a single `split`
  -- drives both in lockstep; we then lift the disjunction to the biconditional.
  have hpair :
      LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F σ' (LExpr.substFvars e sm)
        = LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e
      ∨ ((LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F σ' (LExpr.substFvars e sm)).snd ≠ .value true
        ∧ (LExpr.eval (n' + 1) F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) e).snd ≠ .value true) := by
    have hmeta : (LExpr.substFvars e sm).metadata = e.metadata :=
      substFvars_metadata_of_ne_fvar e sm (fun m x ty heq => by
        rw [heq, callOfLFunc_fvar_none F m x ty] at hcall
        simp at hcall)
    simp only [LExpr.eval, LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval,
      LExpr.List_all_snd_isValueTrue_map_eval, LExpr.combineEvalResValueFlag_eq_pair,
      hcanFL, hcallL, hcanF, hcall, hfst, hbit, hmeta]
    split
    · -- `isCanonicalValue` guard: rewritten to `false`, so this branch is impossible.
      exact absurd ‹false = true› (by simp)
    · split
      · -- inline branch
        rename_i h_cond
        split
        · -- computeTypeSubst = some: shared closed reduct, store-independent.
          rename_i tySubst h_ts
          have hclosed : LExpr.LExpr.getVars
              (((lfunc.body.get (by simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond; exact h_cond.1)).applySubst tySubst).substFvarsLifting
                (lfunc.inputs.keys.zip
                  (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).fst)))) = [] := by
            apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
            intro x hx
            rcases getVars_substFvarsLifting_mem _ _ x hx with ⟨hin, hnone⟩ | ⟨k, v, hk, hv⟩
            · rw [getVars_applySubst] at hin
              have hsome : lfunc.body.isSome = true := by
                simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond; exact h_cond.1
              have hbody_eq : lfunc.body = some (lfunc.body.get hsome) := by simp [Option.some_get]
              have hy_key := lfunc_body_getVars_subset_keys hIdent lfunc h_closed _ hbody_eq x hin
              have h_len : lfunc.inputs.keys.length =
                  (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).fst)).length := by
                rw [ListMap.keys_eq_map_fst]; simp [h_arity]
              have h_mem_keys : x ∈ Map.keys (lfunc.inputs.keys.zip
                  (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F (substStoreExpr σ' sm) a).fst))) := by
                rw [Map.keys_eq_map_fst, List.map_fst_zip (by omega)]; exact hy_key
              exact Map_find?_ne_none_of_mem_keys _ x h_mem_keys hnone
            · have hv_mem := Map_find?_some_mem_values _ k v hk
              have hv_R := List.mem_map_snd_zip _ _ v hv_mem
              have := hRclosed v hv_R
              rw [this] at hv; exact absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil)
          left; rw [hstore_indep _ hclosed]
        · -- computeTypeSubst = none: both `.nonvalue`.
          right; exact ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
      · -- non-inline branch
        cases h_fEC : Strata.DL.Util.FuncAttr.findEvalIfConstr lfunc.attr <;>
        cases h_fEV : Strata.DL.Util.FuncAttr.findEvalIfCanonical lfunc.attr <;> (
          simp only []
          split
          · split
            · -- concreteEval none: the (now possibly certifying) results
              -- coincide on both sides after the residual rewrites.
              left; rfl
            · rename_i ceval h_ce
              split
              · -- ceval succeeds: shared closed reduct, store-independent.
                rename_i e'c h_ceval_eq
                have hclosed : LExpr.LExpr.getVars e'c = [] := by
                  apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
                  intro x hx
                  have hexists := h_wf.concreteEval_freeVars ceval h_ce _ _ e'c h_ceval_eq x hx
                  obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, hxa'⟩ := hexists
                  have := hRclosed a ha_mem
                  rw [this] at hxa'; exact absurd hxa' (List.not_mem_nil)
                left; rw [hstore_indep _ hclosed]
              · -- ceval fails: both `.nonvalue`.
                right; exact ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
          · -- symbolic args: both `.nonvalue`.
            right; exact ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
        )
  rcases hpair with heq | ⟨hL, hR⟩
  · rw [heq]
  · constructor <;> intro h
    · exact absurd (congrArg Prod.snd h) hL
    · exact absurd (congrArg Prod.snd h) hR

name: ProximityGap.RS_exists_kernelVec_BW_homMatrix_eval_of_mem_goodCoeffs
statement:
open scoped BigOperators in
open Polynomial in
theorem RS_exists_kernelVec_BW_homMatrix_eval_of_mem_goodCoeffs
    {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0} [NeZero deg]
    (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι) {z : F}
    (hz : z ∈ RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ) :
    let e : ℕ := Nat.floor (δ * Fintype.card ι)
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1) → F,
      ∃ b : Fin (e + deg) → F,
        a ≠ 0 ∧
          Matrix.mulVec
              (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e deg (fun i => domain i)
                (fun i => u 0 i + z * u 1 i))
              (Fin.append a b) = 0
src:
open scoped BigOperators in
open Polynomial in
theorem RS_exists_kernelVec_BW_homMatrix_eval_of_mem_goodCoeffs
    {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0} [NeZero deg]
    (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι) {z : F}
    (hz : z ∈ RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ) :
    let e : ℕ := Nat.floor (δ * Fintype.card ι)
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1) → F,
      ∃ b : Fin (e + deg) → F,
        a ≠ 0 ∧
          Matrix.mulVec
              (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e deg (fun i => domain i)
                (fun i => u 0 i + z * u 1 i))
              (Fin.append a b) = 0 := by
  classical
  -- Unfold the `let e := ...` in the goal, but avoid changing the quantifier structure
  simp only
  -- Name the error bound (this rewrites occurrences of the floor expression)
  set e : ℕ := Nat.floor (δ * Fintype.card ι) with he
  -- Get the close polynomial `Pz`
  obtain ⟨Pz, hPzdeg, hdist⟩ :=
    RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u (z := z) hz
  have hdist' : Δ₀(u 0 + z • u 1, Pz.eval ∘ domain) ≤ e := by
    simpa [he] using hdist
  -- Extract a small set of disagreement coordinates
  obtain ⟨D, hDcard, hAgree⟩ :=
    (Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_possibleDisagreeCols
        (u := u 0 + z • u 1)
        (v := Pz.eval ∘ domain)
        (e := e)).1 hdist'
  -- Error-locator polynomial and the corresponding `Q`
  set E : F[X] := ∏ i ∈ D, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (domain i)) with hE
  set Q : F[X] := E * Pz with hQ
  -- Coefficient vectors (truncated to the required degrees)
  let a : Fin (e + 1) → F := fun t => E.coeff t.1
  let b : Fin (e + deg) → F := fun s => Q.coeff s.1
  have hE_monic : E.Monic := by
    -- `E` is a product of monic linear factors
    simpa [hE] using (Polynomial.monic_prod_X_sub_C (b := fun i : ι => domain i) (s := D))
  have hE_natDegree : E.natDegree = D.card := by
    -- degree of product of monic polynomials is sum of degrees
    have hdeg :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic (s := D)
        (f := fun i : ι => (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (domain i) : F[X]))
        (by
          intro i hi
          simpa using (Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C (domain i)))
    -- simplify the RHS
    convert hdeg using 1
    simp
  have hE_deg_lt : E.natDegree < e + 1 := by
    have : D.card < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hDcard
    simpa [hE_natDegree] using this
  have hQ_deg_lt : Q.natDegree < e + deg := by
    -- `natDegree (E*Pz) ≤ natDegree E + natDegree Pz`
    have hmul : Q.natDegree ≤ E.natDegree + Pz.natDegree := by
      simpa [hQ] using (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := E) (q := Pz))
    have hPz_le : Pz.natDegree ≤ deg - 1 := Nat.le_pred_of_lt hPzdeg
    have hE_le : E.natDegree ≤ e := by
      simpa [hE_natDegree] using hDcard
    have hsum_le : E.natDegree + Pz.natDegree ≤ e + (deg - 1) := Nat.add_le_add hE_le hPz_le
    have hle : Q.natDegree ≤ e + (deg - 1) := le_trans hmul (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hsum_le)
    -- turn into a strict inequality
    have hdegpos : 0 < deg := Nat.pos_of_neZero deg
    have : e + (deg - 1) < e + deg :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.pred_lt (Nat.ne_of_gt hdegpos)) e
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle this
  -- `a` is nonzero because the leading coefficient of `E` is 1
  have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := by
    have hcard_lt : D.card < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hDcard
    let t0 : Fin (e + 1) := ⟨D.card, hcard_lt⟩
    have hcoeff : E.coeff D.card = 1 := by
      have hlead : E.leadingCoeff = 1 := hE_monic.leadingCoeff
      simpa [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, hE_natDegree] using hlead
    have ht0 : a t0 = 1 := by
      simpa [a, t0] using hcoeff
    intro hzero
    have hz0 : a t0 = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg (fun f => f t0) hzero
    have h1 : (1 : F) = 0 := by
      rwa [ht0] at hz0
    exact one_ne_zero h1
  refine ⟨a, b, ha_ne, ?_⟩
  -- Show the vector is in the kernel via the characterization lemma
  apply (BW_homMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (ι := ι) (e := e) (k := deg)
      (ωs := fun i => domain i)
      (f := fun i => u 0 i + z * u 1 i)
      (a := a) (b := b)).2
  intro i
  -- Convert the coefficient sums into polynomial evaluations
  have hsum_a : (∑ t : Fin (e + 1), a t * (domain i) ^ t.1) = E.eval (domain i) := by
    have hfin : (∑ t : Fin (e + 1), a t * (domain i) ^ t.1)
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), E.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n := by
      simpa [a] using
        (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (f := fun n : ℕ => E.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n) (n := e + 1))
    have heval : E.eval (domain i) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), E.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n :=
      Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (p := E) (n := e + 1) hE_deg_lt (domain i)
    simpa [hfin] using heval.symm
  have hsum_b : (∑ s : Fin (e + deg), b s * (domain i) ^ s.1) = Q.eval (domain i) := by
    have hfin : (∑ s : Fin (e + deg), b s * (domain i) ^ s.1)
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (e + deg), Q.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n := by
      simpa [b] using
        (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (f := fun n : ℕ => Q.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n) (n := e + deg))
    have heval : Q.eval (domain i) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (e + deg), Q.coeff n * (domain i) ^ n :=
      Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (p := Q) (n := e + deg) hQ_deg_lt (domain i)
    simpa [hfin] using heval.symm
  -- Reduce to showing `E.eval ω * f = Q.eval ω` and discharge by cases
  by_cases hiD : i ∈ D
  · -- On error positions, `E(ω_i)=0`
    have hE0 : E.eval (domain i) = 0 := by
      -- expand `E` and use that evaluation commutes with products
      rw [hE]
      rw [Polynomial.eval_prod (s := D)
        (p := fun j : ι => (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (domain j) : F[X]))
        (x := domain i)]
      refine Finset.prod_eq_zero hiD ?_
      simp
    calc
      (∑ t : Fin (e + 1), a t * (domain i) ^ t.1) * (u 0 i + z * u 1 i)
          = (E.eval (domain i)) * (u 0 i + z * u 1 i) := by rw [hsum_a]
      _ = 0 := by simp [hE0]
      _ = Q.eval (domain i) := by
            have hmul_eval : Q.eval (domain i) = (E.eval (domain i)) * (Pz.eval (domain i)) := by
              rw [hQ, Polynomial.eval_mul]
            simp [hmul_eval, hE0]
      _ = ∑ s : Fin (e + deg), b s * (domain i) ^ s.1 := by rw [hsum_b]
  · -- On agreement positions, `f_i = Pz(ω_i)`
    have hf_eq : (u 0 i + z * u 1 i) = Pz.eval (domain i) := by
      have := hAgree i hiD
      simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
    calc
      (∑ t : Fin (e + 1), a t * (domain i) ^ t.1) * (u 0 i + z * u 1 i)
          = (E.eval (domain i)) * (u 0 i + z * u 1 i) := by rw [hsum_a]
      _ = (E.eval (domain i)) * (Pz.eval (domain i)) := by simp [hf_eq]
      _ = Q.eval (domain i) := by
            rw [hQ, Polynomial.eval_mul]
      _ = ∑ s : Fin (e + deg), b s * (domain i) ^ s.1 := by rw [hsum_b]

statement:
/-- The vertices of every hollow rational polytope admit a `p`-hollow
reduction for some prime `p`. -/

src:
/-- The vertices of every hollow rational polytope admit a `p`-hollow
reduction for some prime `p`. -/
theorem hasPrimeHollowReduction_of_isHollow {d : ℕ}
    (P : RationalPolytope d) (hP : P.IsHollow) :
    P.HasPrimeHollowReduction := by
  classical
  let H := P.vertexHomogenization
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := H.exists_uniform_face_saturation_bound
  obtain ⟨p, hBp, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (B + 1)
  have hBp' : B < p := by omega
  let _ : Fintype P.vertexSet := P.finite_vertexSet.fintype
  let e : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard ≃ P.vertexSet :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by
      rw [Fintype.card_fin, Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard])
  let v : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard → FpVec p d := fun i ↦
    (H.scaledVertex (e i)).mod p
  refine ⟨p, hp, v, ?_⟩
  intro α hsum
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    let scaledSum : IntCoord d :=
      ∑ i, α i • H.scaledVertex (e i)
    have hscaledMod : scaledSum.mod p = 0 := by
      funext j
      have hj := congrFun hzero j
      simpa [scaledSum, v, IntCoord.mod, Finset.sum_apply] using hj
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IntCoord.exists_smul_eq_of_mod_eq_zero scaledSum hscaledMod
    let q : RealCoord d := (H.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • z.real
    have hDne : (H.denominator : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt H.denominator_pos)
    have hpne : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
    have hzreal : z.real = (H.denominator : ℝ) • q := by
      funext j
      simp only [q, IntCoord.real_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    let weight : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard → ℝ := fun i ↦ (α i : ℝ) / p
    have hweight0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ weight i := by
      intro i
      exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have hweightsum : (∑ i, weight i) = 1 := by
      dsimp [weight]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      have hsumReal : (∑ i, (α i : ℝ)) = p := by exact_mod_cast hsum
      rw [hsumReal]
      exact div_self hpne
    have hbary : q = ∑ i, weight i • (e i : RealCoord d) := by
      funext j
      have hzj := congrFun hz j
      have hzjReal : (p : ℝ) * (z j : ℝ) =
          ∑ i, (α i : ℝ) * (H.scaledVertex (e i) j : ℝ) := by
        simpa [scaledSum, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
          congrArg (· : ℤ → ℝ) hzj
      have hscaled (i : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard) :
          (H.scaledVertex (e i) j : ℝ) =
            (H.denominator : ℝ) * (e i : RealCoord d) j :=
        congrFun (H.scaledVertex_real (e i)) j
      simp_rw [hscaled] at hzjReal
      let S : ℝ := ∑ i, (α i : ℝ) * (e i : RealCoord d) j
      have hrel : (p : ℝ) * (z j : ℝ) =
          (H.denominator : ℝ) * S := by
        calc
          (p : ℝ) * (z j : ℝ) =
              ∑ i, (α i : ℝ) *
                ((H.denominator : ℝ) * (e i : RealCoord d) j) := hzjReal
          _ = (H.denominator : ℝ) * S := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            ring
      dsimp [q, weight]
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_apply]
      change (H.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ * (z j : ℝ) =
        ∑ i, ((α i : ℝ) / p) * (e i : RealCoord d) j
      calc
        (H.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ * (z j : ℝ) =
            (z j : ℝ) / H.denominator := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
        _ = S / p := (div_eq_div_iff hDne hpne).2 (by
          simpa [mul_comm] using hrel)
        _ = ∑ i, ((α i : ℝ) / p) * (e i : RealCoord d) j := by
          dsimp [S]
          simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
    have hqP : q ∈ P.carrier := by
      rw [hbary]
      apply P.convex.sum_mem (t := Finset.univ) (w := weight)
        (z := fun i ↦ (e i : RealCoord d))
      · intro i _
        exact hweight0 i
      · simpa using hweightsum
      · intro i _
        exact extremePoints_subset (e i).property
    obtain ⟨F, hFleast⟩ :=
      RationalPolytope.Face.exists_isLeastFaceAt P hqP
    have hvertexF (i : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard) (hi : 0 < α i) :
        (e i : RealCoord d) ∈ F.carrier := by
      apply F.mem_of_pos_of_eq_convexCombination
        (fun j ↦ (e j : RealCoord d)) weight q (i := i)
      · intro j
        exact extremePoints_subset (e j).property
      · exact hweight0
      · exact hweightsum
      · exact hbary
      · exact hFleast.1
      · dsimp [weight]
        positivity
    have hsumSub :
        (∑ i, (α i : ℤ) • H.homogenizedVertex (e i)) ∈
          H.faceSubmodule F := by
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i _
      by_cases hi : α i = 0
      · simp [hi]
      · apply Submodule.smul_mem
        exact H.homogenizedVertex_mem_faceSubmodule F (e i)
          (hvertexF i (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi))
    have hhomogenized :
        (p : ℤ) • z.homogenize =
          ∑ i, (α i : ℤ) • H.homogenizedVertex (e i) := by
      funext j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k ↦ ?_) j
      · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, IntCoord.homogenize_last,
          H.homogenizedVertex_last, mul_one, Finset.sum_apply]
        exact_mod_cast hsum.symm
      · have hzk := congrFun hz k
        simpa [scaledSum, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hzk
    have hpsub : (p : ℤ) • z.homogenize ∈ H.faceSubmodule F := by
      rw [hhomogenized]
      exact hsumSub
    have hzsub : z.homogenize ∈ H.faceSubmodule F := hB hp hBp' F hpsub
    have hqspan : q ∈ affineIntSpan (P.vertexSet ∩ F.carrier) :=
      (H.homogenize_mem_faceSubmodule_iff F hzreal).mp hzsub
    have hqvertex : q ∈ P.vertexSet := by
      apply hP q hqP
      exact ⟨F, hFleast.mem_relInterior, hqspan⟩
    have heq_of_pos (i : Fin P.vertexSet.ncard) (hi : 0 < α i) :
        (e i : RealCoord d) = q := by
      apply RationalPolytope.eq_of_pos_of_eq_convexCombination_of_mem_vertexSet
        (P := P) (fun j ↦ (e j : RealCoord d)) weight q
      · intro j
        exact extremePoints_subset (e j).property
      · exact hweight0
      · exact hweightsum
      · exact hbary
      · exact hqvertex
      · dsimp [weight]
        positivity
    have hexpos : ∃ i, 0 < α i := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have hzeroCoeff : ∀ i, α i = 0 := by
        intro i
        exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (h i)
      have : (∑ i, α i) = 0 := by simp [hzeroCoeff]
      rw [hsum] at this
      exact hp.ne_zero this
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hexpos
    have hzeroOff : ∀ j, j ≠ i → α j = 0 := by
      intro j hji
      by_contra hj
      have heji : e j = e i := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (heq_of_pos j (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj)).trans
          (heq_of_pos i hi).symm
      exact hji (e.injective heji)
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have hsingle : (∑ j, α j) = α i := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
      · intro j _ hji
        exact hzeroOff j hji
      · simp
    exact hsingle.symm.trans hsum
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hzeroOff : ∀ j, j ≠ i → α j = 0 := by
      intro j hji
      have hsumErase : ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), α k = 0 := by
        have hdecomp := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ)
          (f := α) (Finset.mem_univ i)
        rw [hsum, hi] at hdecomp
        omega
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hsumErase j (by simp [hji])
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [hi]
      exact FpVec.characteristic_nsmul p (v i)
    · intro j _ hji
      simp [hzeroOff j hji]
    · simp

name: sum_powers_lower_bound
statement:
/-- Sum of power lower bound: for β > 0, the sum Σ_{k=M}^{n-1} k^β is at least
    some constant times n^{1+β} for large enough n. -/
lemma sum_powers_lower_bound (β : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (hβ : 0 < β) (_hM : 0 < M) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N' ≤ n →
      c * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M n, (k : ℝ) ^ β
src:
/-- Sum of power lower bound: for β > 0, the sum Σ_{k=M}^{n-1} k^β is at least
    some constant times n^{1+β} for large enough n. -/
lemma sum_powers_lower_bound (β : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (hβ : 0 < β) (_hM : 0 < M) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N' ≤ n →
      c * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M n, (k : ℝ) ^ β := by
  use (1/8 : ℝ) ^ (1 + β)
  constructor
  · positivity
  use max (4 * M) 8
  intro n hn
  have hn_ge_4M : 4 * M ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hn_ge_8 : 8 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by omega
  let M' := n / 2
  have hM'_ge_M : M ≤ M' := by simp only [M']; omega
  have hM'_lt_n : M' < n := by simp only [M']; omega
  have hM'_ge_n4 : n / 4 ≤ M' := by simp only [M']; omega
  have hcard : (Finset.Ico M' n).card = n - M' := Nat.card_Ico M' n
  have hcard_ge : n / 4 ≤ (Finset.Ico M' n).card := by rw [hcard]; simp only [M']; omega
  have hn4_ge_2 : 2 ≤ n / 4 := by omega
  have hn4_pos : 0 < n / 4 := by omega
  have hn4_real_bound : (n : ℝ) / 8 ≤ ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h2 : n - 3 ≤ 4 * (n / 4) := by
      omega
    have h3 : ((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have hn_ge_3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
    calc (n : ℝ) / 8 = (((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) / 8 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hn_ge_3]; ring
      _ = ((n - 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 8 + 3/8 := by ring
      _ ≤ (4 * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 8 + 3/8 := by linarith
      _ = ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 + 3/8 := by ring
      _ ≤ ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn4_ge_2
          linarith
  have hk_lower : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico M' n, n / 4 ≤ k := by
    intro k hk; have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).1; omega
  have hk_lower_real : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico M' n, ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ β := fun k hk =>
    Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hk_lower k hk) (le_of_lt hβ)
  have hsum_lower : ((Finset.Ico M' n).card : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M' n, (k : ℝ) ^ β := by
    have h := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum (Finset.Ico M' n) (fun k => (k : ℝ) ^ β) (((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β) hk_lower_real
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h
  have hcard_lower : ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β ≤
      ((Finset.Ico M' n).card : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard_ge) (by positivity)
  have hsubset : Finset.Ico M' n ⊆ Finset.Ico M n := Finset.Ico_subset_Ico hM'_ge_M (le_refl n)
  have hsum_ge : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M' n, (k : ℝ) ^ β ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M n, (k : ℝ) ^ β :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset (fun i _ _ => by positivity)
  have hn4_cast_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn4_pos
  have hfinal_step1 : ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M n, (k : ℝ) ^ β := by
    have hrpow_split : ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) = ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β := by
      rw [rpow_add hn4_cast_pos, rpow_one]
    calc ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) = ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β := hrpow_split
      _ ≤ ((Finset.Ico M' n).card : ℝ) * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β := hcard_lower
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M' n, (k : ℝ) ^ β := hsum_lower
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico M n, (k : ℝ) ^ β := hsum_ge
  have hn_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos
  have hfinal_step2 : (1/8 : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) ≤ ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) := by
    have h_eq : (1/8 : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 + β) = ((n : ℝ) / 8) ^ (1 + β) := by
      rw [← mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/8) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ n)]
      ring_nf
    rw [h_eq]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hn4_real_bound
    linarith [hβ]
  linarith [hfinal_step1, hfinal_step2]
