import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2025_b6_solution : ℝ := 1 / 4

/-- The set of valid exponents r: those for which there exists g : ℕ → ℕ satisfying
    the functional inequality g(n+1) - g(n) ≥ (g(g(n)))^r for all positive n.

    This is the target set in the IsGreatest statement. -/
def validExponentSet : Set ℝ :=
  {r : ℝ | ∃ g : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ)}

theorem g_ge_n (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n := by
  have h_base : 1 ≤ g 1 := by
    have h₁ : 0 < g 1 := hg_pos 1 (by norm_num)
    have h₂ : 1 ≤ g 1 := by
      by_contra h
      omega
    exact h₂

  have h_inductive_step : ∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → k ≤ g k → k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk h_ik
    have h₁ : g k < g (k + 1) := hg_mono k (by omega)
    have h₂ : k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
      have h₃ : k < g (k + 1) := by
        omega
      have h₄ : k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
        omega
      exact h₄
    exact h₂

  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n := by
    intro n hn
    induction' hn with n hn IH
    ·
      exact h_base
    ·
      exact h_inductive_step n hn IH

  exact h_main

theorem g_succ_gt_sq (g : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hgn_pos : 0 < g n)
    (hdiff : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ)) :
    (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
  have h_lt_sum : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 + (g n : ℝ) := by
    have h₁ : 0 < (g n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgn_pos
    have h₃ : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 + (g n : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    exact h₃

  have h_main : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    linarith

  exact h_main

theorem iterated_squaring_bound (g : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (_hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ m n : ℕ, M ≤ m → m < n → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g n : ℝ) := by
  have h_main : ∀ (m : ℕ), M ≤ m → ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) < (g (m + k) : ℝ) := by
    intro m hm k hk
    have h₁ : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) < (g (m + k) : ℝ) := by
      intro k hk
      induction' hk with k _ IH
      ·
        have h₂ : M ≤ m := hm
        have h₃ : 0 < m := by
          omega
        have h₄ : (g m : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
          have h₅ : M ≤ m := hm
          have h₆ : 0 < m := by omega
          have h₇ : (g m : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
            exact hsquare m h₅ h₆
          exact h₇
        norm_num at h₄ ⊢
        try simp_all [pow_succ]
      ·
        have h₂ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) < (g (m + (k + 1)) : ℝ) := by
          have h₃ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) = ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 := by
            calc
              (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) = (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k * 2) := by
                rw [show 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k * 2 by
                  ring_nf]
              _ = ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 := by
                rw [show (2 ^ k * 2 : ℕ) = 2 ^ k + 2 ^ k by ring]
                rw [pow_add]
                ring_nf
          rw [h₃]
          have h₄ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            have h₅ : 0 ≤ (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) := by positivity
            have h₈ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith
            exact h₈
          have h₅ : (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := by
            have h₆ : M ≤ (m + k : ℕ) := by
              omega
            have h₇ : 0 < (m + k : ℕ) := by
              omega
            have h₈ : (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g ((m + k) + 1) : ℝ) := by
              exact hsquare (m + k) h₆ (by exact_mod_cast h₇)
            simpa [add_assoc] using h₈
          have h₆ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := by
            calc
              ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := h₄
              _ < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := h₅
          have h₇ : (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) = (g (m + (k + 1)) : ℝ) := by
            ring_nf
          rw [h₇] at h₆
          exact h₆
        exact h₂
    exact h₁ k hk
  have h_final : ∀ m n : ℕ, M ≤ m → m < n → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g n : ℝ) := by
    intro m n hm hmn
    have h₁ : 0 < n - m := by
      omega
    have h₂ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g (m + (n - m)) : ℝ) := by
      have h₃ : 0 < n - m := h₁
      have h₄ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g (m + (n - m)) : ℝ) := h_main m hm (n - m) h₃
      exact h₄
    have h₃ : m + (n - m) = n := by
      omega
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  exact h_final

theorem diff_ge_sq_from_domination (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ineq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ))
    (_hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1))
    (hr : 1 / 4 < r)
    (hg_dominates : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ p ≤ g n) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
  have h_p1 : ∃ (N1 : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N1 ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ≤ g n := by
    have h1 : ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ g n := by
      have h3 : ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ g n := by
        apply hg_dominates 1 (by norm_num)
      exact h3
    obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := h1
    refine' ⟨N1, _⟩
    intro n hn hn'
    have h4 : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ g n := hN1 n hn hn'
    have h5 : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast
      field_simp [Real.rpow_one]
    rw [h5] at h4
    have h6 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (g n : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h4
    exact_mod_cast h6

  have h_p2r' : ∃ (N2r : ℕ), ∀ (m : ℕ), N2r ≤ m → 0 < m → (m : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ g m := by
    have h₁ : ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ g n := by
      have h₂ : (2 : ℝ) / r > 0 := by positivity
      have h₃ : ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ g n := by
        apply hg_dominates ((2 : ℝ) / r) h₂
      exact h₃
    obtain ⟨N2r, hN2r⟩ := h₁
    refine' ⟨N2r, _⟩
    intro m hm hm'
    exact hN2r m hm hm'

  have h_main : ∃ (M : ℕ), 0 < M ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := h_p1
    obtain ⟨N2r, hN2r⟩ := h_p2r'
    use max (max N1 N2r) 1
    constructor
    ·
      have h₁ : 0 < max (max N1 N2r) 1 := by
        have h₃ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ max (max N1 N2r) 1 := by simp [le_max_right]
        omega
      exact h₁
    ·
      intro n hn hn'
      have h₄ : (n : ℕ) ≥ N1 := by
        have h₆ : (N1 : ℕ) ≤ max N1 N2r := by
          apply le_max_left
        have h₇ : (max N1 N2r : ℕ) ≤ max (max N1 N2r) 1 := by
          apply le_max_left
        have h₈ : (N1 : ℕ) ≤ n := by
          linarith
        exact_mod_cast h₈
      have h₅ : (n : ℕ) ≥ N2r := by
        have h₇ : (N2r : ℕ) ≤ max N1 N2r := by
          apply le_max_right
        have h₈ : (max N1 N2r : ℕ) ≤ max (max N1 N2r) 1 := by
          apply le_max_left
        have h₉ : (N2r : ℕ) ≤ n := by
          linarith
        exact_mod_cast h₉
      have h₇ : (n : ℝ) ≤ g n := by
        have h₈ : (n : ℕ) ≥ N1 := h₄
        have h₁₀ : (n : ℝ) ≤ g n := by
          have h₁₁ := hN1 n (by exact_mod_cast h₈) (by positivity)
          exact_mod_cast h₁₁
        exact h₁₀
      have h₈ : (g n : ℕ) ≥ N2r := by
        have h₁₀ : (g n : ℕ) ≥ n := by
          have h₁₁ : (n : ℝ) ≤ g n := h₇
          have h₁₂ : (n : ℕ) ≤ g n := by
            norm_cast at h₁₁ ⊢
          exact_mod_cast h₁₂
        have h₁₁ : (g n : ℕ) ≥ N2r := by
          linarith
        exact_mod_cast h₁₁
      have h₉ : 0 < (g n : ℕ) := by
        have h₁₁ : 0 < g n := hg_pos n (by positivity)
        exact_mod_cast h₁₁
      have h₁₀ : ((g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := by
        have h₁₁ : (N2r : ℕ) ≤ (g n : ℕ) := by
          exact_mod_cast h₈
        have h₁₃ : ((g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := by
          have h₁₄ := hN2r (g n) (by exact_mod_cast h₁₁) (by positivity)
          exact_mod_cast h₁₄
        exact h₁₃
      have h₁₃ : 0 < r := by
        by_contra h
        linarith
      have h₁₄ : ( ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ) ^ r ≤ ( (g (g n) : ℝ) ) ^ r := by
        have h₁₇ : ((g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := h₁₀
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h₁₇ (by linarith)
      have h₁₅ : ( ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ) ^ r = ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have h₁₆ : ( ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ) ^ r = ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (((2 : ℝ) / r) * r) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
        rw [h₁₆]
        have h₁₇ : ((2 : ℝ) / r) * r = 2 := by
          field_simp [h₁₃.ne']
        rw [h₁₇]
        norm_cast
      have h₁₆ : ( (g (g n) : ℝ) ) ^ r ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
        have h₁₈ : ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
          have h₁₉ := hg_ineq n (by positivity)
          simpa using h₁₉
        exact h₁₈
      have h₁₇ : ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
        calc
          ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = ( ( (g n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / r) ) ^ r := by rw [h₁₅]
          _ ≤ ( (g (g n) : ℝ) ) ^ r := h₁₄
          _ ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := h₁₆
      exact_mod_cast h₁₇
  exact h_main

/-- Helper: 2 * k < 2 ^ k for k ≥ 4 -/
lemma two_mul_lt_two_pow (k : ℕ) (hk : 4 ≤ k) : 2 * k < 2 ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n IH =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge n 4 with
    | inl h =>
      have : n + 1 = 4 := by omega
      simp only [this]
      norm_num
    | inr h =>
      have IH' := IH h
      calc 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by ring
        _ < 2 ^ n + 2 := by omega
        _ ≤ 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by
          have : 2 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
            calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
              _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
          omega
        _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) := by ring

/-- For any A : ℕ, there exists k₀ such that for all k ≥ k₀, we have 2^{2^k} > A + k.
    This follows from the fact that 2^{2^k} grows doubly exponentially while A + k is linear. -/
lemma two_pow_two_pow_unbounded (A : ℕ) :
    ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k → A + k < 2 ^ (2 ^ k) := by
  use max A 4
  intro k hk
  have h_k_ge_4 : 4 ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right A 4) hk
  have h_k_ge_A : A ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left A 4) hk
  have h_pow : 2 * k < 2 ^ (2 ^ k) := by
    have h1 : 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ k) := by
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
      have : k < 2 ^ k := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self k
      omega
    have h2 : 2 * k < 2 ^ k := two_mul_lt_two_pow k h_k_ge_4
    omega
  omega

/-- g(n) - n → ∞ as n → ∞.

    From the squaring property g(n+1) > (g(n))^2, we can show that
    g(n) grows at least doubly exponentially, hence g(n) - n → ∞. -/
theorem g_minus_n_unbounded (g : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ C : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → M ≤ n → C + n < g n := by
  intro C
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := two_pow_two_pow_unbounded (C + M)
  use max (M + 1) (M + k₀)
  intro n hn hMn
  have hk : k₀ ≤ n - M := by omega
  have hMn_strict : M < n := by omega
  have h_iter := iterated_squaring_bound g M hM_pos hgM_ge_2 hsquare M n (le_refl M) hMn_strict
  have h_two_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - M)) ≤ (g M : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - M)) := by
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    exact_mod_cast hgM_ge_2
  have h_bound : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - M)) < (g n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt h_two_le h_iter
  have h_unbdd := hk₀ (n - M) hk
  have h1 : (C + n : ℕ) < 2 ^ 2 ^ (n - M) := by omega
  have h_cast : (C + n : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - M)) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have h_final : (C + n : ℝ) < (g n : ℝ) := lt_trans h_cast h_bound
  exact_mod_cast h_final

/-- Helper lemma: 2^k > K for sufficiently large k when K > 0. -/
lemma two_pow_eventually_gt (K : ℝ) (_hK : 0 < K) :
    ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k → K < 2 ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt K
  use k₀
  intro k hk
  calc K < ↑k₀ := hk₀
    _ ≤ ↑k := by exact Nat.cast_le.mpr hk
    _ < 2 ^ k := by
      have : k < 2 ^ k := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self k
      exact_mod_cast this

/-- Power domination of g(g(n)) over g(n+1).
    For any K > 0, eventually (g(n+1))^K < g(g(n)). -/
lemma power_domination (g : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (_hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1))
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ge_n : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n) :
    ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → M ≤ n → 0 < n →
      (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ K < (g (g n) : ℝ) := by
  intro K hK
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := two_pow_eventually_gt K hK
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := g_minus_n_unbounded g M hM_pos hgM_ge_2 hsquare (k₀ + 1)
  use max N₁ (M + 1)
  intro n hn hMn hn_pos
  have hn_ge_N₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have h_gap : k₀ + 1 + n < g n := hN₁ n hn_ge_N₁ hMn
  have h_gn_minus : k₀ ≤ g n - (n + 1) := by omega
  have hn1_lt_gn : n + 1 < g n := by omega
  have hM_le_n1 : M ≤ n + 1 := by omega
  have h_iter := iterated_squaring_bound g M hM_pos hgM_ge_2 hsquare (n + 1) (g n) hM_le_n1 hn1_lt_gn
  have hgn1_pos : 0 < g (n + 1) := hg_pos (n + 1) (by omega)
  have hgn1_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g (n + 1) := by
    have : n + 1 ≤ g (n + 1) := hg_ge_n (n + 1) (by omega)
    omega
  have hgn1_gt_1 : (1 : ℝ) < g (n + 1) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ g (n + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hgn1_ge_2
  have h_exp_bound : K < (2 : ℝ) ^ (g n - (n + 1)) := by
    calc K < 2 ^ k₀ := hk₀ k₀ (le_refl k₀)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (g n - (n + 1)) := by
        apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
        exact h_gn_minus
  have h_exp_ineq : (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ K < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℕ) ^ (g n - (n + 1))) := by
    have h1 : K < (2 ^ (g n - (n + 1)) : ℕ) := by
      calc K < (2 : ℝ) ^ (g n - (n + 1)) := h_exp_bound
        _ = ((2 : ℕ) ^ (g n - (n + 1)) : ℕ) := by norm_cast
    have h2 : K < ((2 ^ (g n - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h3 : (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ K < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ ((2 ^ (g n - (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact (Real.rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff hgn1_gt_1).mpr h2
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at h3
    exact h3
  calc (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ K
      < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℕ) ^ (g n - (n + 1))) := h_exp_ineq
    _ < (g (g n) : ℝ) := h_iter

/-- Eventually (g(g(n)))^r > g(n+1), contradicting the functional inequality. -/
theorem eventual_violation (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1))
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ge_n : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n)
    (hr_pos : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ M ≤ n ∧ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) < ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) := by
  have hK_pos : 0 < 1/r := by positivity
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := power_domination g M hM_pos hgM_ge_2 hsquare hg_mono hg_pos hg_ge_n (1/r) hK_pos
  let n := max N (max M 1)
  have hn_ge_N : N ≤ n := le_max_left _ _
  have hn_ge_M : M ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left M 1) (le_max_right N _)
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 1) (le_trans (le_max_right M 1) (le_max_right N _))
  have h1 : (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ (1/r) < (g (g n) : ℝ) := hN n hn_ge_N hn_ge_M hn_pos
  have hgn1_pos : 0 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < g (n + 1) := hg_pos (n + 1) (by omega)
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr this
  have h2 : ((g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ (1/r)) ^ r < ((g (g n) : ℝ)) ^ r := by
    apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow (le_of_lt (by positivity : 0 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ (1/r))) h1 hr_pos
  have h3 : ((g (n + 1) : ℝ) ^ (1/r)) ^ r = (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    rw [one_div_mul_cancel hr_pos.ne']
    exact Real.rpow_one _
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact ⟨n, hn_pos, hn_ge_M, h2⟩

/-- Main theorem: If g dominates all polynomials and satisfies the functional
    inequality with r > 1/4, we derive False.

    Proof outline:
    1. Use diff_ge_sq_from_domination to get M where (g(n))^2 ≤ g(n+1) - g(n)
    2. Use g_succ_gt_sq to get g(n+1) > (g(n))^2 for n ≥ M
    3. Establish g_ge_n, then take M' = max(M, 2) so g(M') ≥ 2
    4. Use eventual_violation to find n where (g(g(n)))^r > g(n+1)
    5. This contradicts the functional inequality since
       (g(g(n)))^r ≤ g(n+1) - g(n) < g(n+1). -/
theorem super_polynomial_contradiction (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ineq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ))
    (hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1))
    (hr : 1 / 4 < r)
    (hg_dominates : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ^ p ≤ g n) :
    False := by
  obtain ⟨M₁, _, hdiff_sq⟩ := diff_ge_sq_from_domination g r hg_pos hg_ineq hg_mono hr hg_dominates

  have hsucc_gt_sq : ∀ n : ℕ, M₁ ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn hn_pos
    have hgn_pos := hg_pos n hn_pos
    exact g_succ_gt_sq g n hgn_pos (hdiff_sq n hn hn_pos)

  have hg_ge_n := g_ge_n g hg_pos hg_mono

  let M := max M₁ 2
  have hM_ge_M₁ : M₁ ≤ M := le_max_left M₁ 2
  have hM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ M := le_max_right M₁ 2
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) hM_ge_2

  have hgM_ge_M : M ≤ g M := hg_ge_n M (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hM_pos))
  have hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M := le_trans hM_ge_2 hgM_ge_M

  have hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn hn_pos
    exact hsucc_gt_sq n (le_trans hM_ge_M₁ hn) hn_pos

  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by linarith

  obtain ⟨n, hn_pos, _, hviolate⟩ := eventual_violation g r M hM_pos hgM_ge_2 hsquare hg_mono hg_pos hg_ge_n hr_pos


  have hfunc := hg_ineq n hn_pos
  linarith

theorem strict_mono_implies_ge_id (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1))
    (hg_1 : 1 ≤ g 1) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → n ≤ g n := by
  have h_inductive_step : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → k ≤ g k → k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk_pos hk_ineq
    have h_mono : g k < g (k + 1) := hg_mono k hk_pos
    have h_final : k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
      omega
    exact h_final

  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → n ≤ g n := by
    intro n hn
    induction' hn with n hn IH
    ·
      exact hg_1
    ·
      have h₁ : n + 1 ≤ g (n + 1) := h_inductive_step n hn IH
      exact h₁

  exact h_main

theorem functional_ineq_implies_strict_mono (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ineq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ))
    (hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1) := by
  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have h₁ : 0 < g n := hg_pos n hn
    have h₂ : 0 < g (g n) := hg_pos (g n) (by
      have h₃ : 0 < g n := h₁
      have h₄ : 0 < (g n : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h₃
      exact h₄
    )
    have h₃ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := by
      have h₄ : 1 ≤ (g (g n) : ℕ) := by
        have h₆ : 1 ≤ g (g n) := by
          omega
        exact h₆
      exact_mod_cast h₄
    have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r := by
      exact one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h₅ : ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := hg_ineq n hn
    have h₈ : g (n + 1) ≥ g n + 1 := by
      have h₁₀ : (g (n + 1) : ℕ) ≥ (g n : ℕ) + 1 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₁₂ : (g (n + 1) : ℕ) ≤ (g n : ℕ) := by
          omega
        have h₁₃ : (g (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤ (g n : ℝ) := by
          norm_cast at h₁₂ ⊢
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h₁₀
    have h₉ : g n < g (n + 1) := by
      omega
    exact h₉
  exact h_main

theorem recurrence_diverges (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 / 4 < r) :
    ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ k : ℕ, M < (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) := by
  have h_quadratic_bound : ∀ (x : ℝ), r * x ^ 2 - x + 1 ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by
    intro x
    have h₁ : 0 < r := by linarith
    have h₄ : r * x ^ 2 - x + 1 - (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) = r * (x - 1 / (2 * r)) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [h₁.ne']
      ring_nf
    have h₅ : r * (x - 1 / (2 * r)) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith
    linarith

  have h_step_bound : ∀ (k : ℕ), (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) (k + 1) 1) - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by
    intro k
    have h₁ : (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) (k + 1) 1) - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) = r * (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) ^ 2 - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) + 1 := by
      simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      ring_nf
    rw [h₁]
    have h₂ : r * (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) + 1 ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by
      have h₃ : ∀ (x : ℝ), r * x ^ 2 - x + 1 ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := h_quadratic_bound
      have h₄ : r * (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) + 1 ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by
        specialize h₃ ((Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ))
        exact h₃
      exact h₄
    linarith

  have h_iterate_lower_bound : ∀ (k : ℕ), (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) ≥ 1 + (k : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r)) := by
    intro k
    have h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ), (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) n 1 : ℝ) ≥ 1 + (n : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r)) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        norm_num [Function.iterate_zero]
      | succ n ih =>
        have h₂ : (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) (n + 1) 1 : ℝ) - (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) n 1 : ℝ) ≥ (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by
          exact_mod_cast h_step_bound n
        have h₃ : (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) (n + 1) 1 : ℝ) ≥ (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) n 1 : ℝ) + (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by linarith
        calc
          (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) (n + 1) 1 : ℝ) ≥ (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) n 1 : ℝ) + (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := h₃
          _ ≥ (1 + (n : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r))) + (4 * r - 1) / (4 * r) := by linarith
          _ = 1 + ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r)) := by ring
          _ = 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r)) := by
            norm_cast
    exact_mod_cast h₁ k

  have h_main : ∀ (M : ℝ), ∃ (k : ℕ), M < (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1) := by
    intro M
    have h₁ : 0 < (4 * r - 1 : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    have h₂ : 0 < (4 * r : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h₃ : 0 < (4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ) := by
      apply div_pos
      · exact h₁
      · exact h₂
    have h₄ : ∃ (k : ℕ), (M - 1 : ℝ) / ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ)) < k := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((M - 1 : ℝ) / ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ)))
      refine' ⟨k, _⟩
      exact_mod_cast hk
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₄
    have h₆ : M < (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) := by
      have h₇ : (Nat.iterate (fun α => 1 + r * α ^ 2) k 1 : ℝ) ≥ 1 + (k : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1) / (4 * r)) := h_iterate_lower_bound k
      have h₉ : (M - 1 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ)) := by
        calc
          (M - 1 : ℝ) = ((M - 1 : ℝ) / ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ))) * ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ)) := by
            field_simp [h₁.ne', h₂.ne']
          _ < (k : ℝ) * ((4 * r - 1 : ℝ) / (4 * r : ℝ)) := by
            nlinarith
      linarith
    exact ⟨k, by exact_mod_cast h₆⟩

  exact h_main

/-- The key inequality for the construction: (n⁴)^{1/4} ≤ (n+1)² - n².
    For g(n) = n²:
    - The left side is (g(g(n)))^{1/4} = (n⁴)^{1/4} = n (by rpow_fourth_root_of_fourth_power).
    - The right side is g(n+1) - g(n) = (n+1)² - n² = 2n + 1.
    - We need n ≤ 2n + 1, which holds for all n ≥ 0. -/
lemma construction_inequality (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (((n : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ (((n + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((n ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  have h_left : (((n : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = (n : ℝ) := by
    have h₃ : (((n : ℝ) ^ 4 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
      have h₄ : Real.log ((((n : ℝ) ^ 4 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
        have h₅ : Real.log ((((n : ℝ) ^ 4 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
          rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)]
        rw [h₅]
        have h₆ : Real.log ((n : ℝ) ^ 4) = 4 * Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.log_pow]
          norm_num
        rw [h₆]
        ring_nf
      have h₈ : (((n : ℝ) ^ 4 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
      have h₉ : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
      have h₁₀ : (((n : ℝ) ^ 4 : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h₈) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr h₉)
        linarith
      exact h₁₀
    simpa using h₃

  have h_right : (((n + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((n ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have h₁ : (((n + 1 : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
      norm_cast
    have h₂ : (((n : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      norm_cast
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    ring_nf

  have h_ineq : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    linarith

  have h_main : (((n : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ (((n + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((n ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [h_left]
    rw [h_right]
    exact h_ineq

  exact h_main

/-- 1/4 is in the set of valid exponents. The witness is g(n) = n².

    For g(n) = n²:
    - g(g(n)) = g(n²) = (n²)² = n⁴
    - g(n+1) - g(n) = (n+1)² - n² = 2n + 1
    - (g(g(n)))^{1/4} = (n⁴)^{1/4} = n
    - We need n ≤ 2n + 1, which is true for all positive n.

    Combines nat_sq_pos_of_pos and construction_inequality. -/
theorem quarter_in_validExponentSet : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ validExponentSet := by
  refine ⟨fun n => n ^ 2, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·
    intro n hn
    exact pow_pos hn 2
  ·
    intro n hn
    have h_gg : (fun n => n ^ 2) ((fun n => n ^ 2) n) = n ^ 4 := by ring
    have h_gn1 : (fun n => n ^ 2) (n + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2 := rfl
    have h_gn : (fun n => n ^ 2) n = n ^ 2 := rfl
    simp only [h_gg, h_gn1, h_gn]
    have h_cast : ((n ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := by norm_cast
    rw [h_cast]
    exact construction_inequality n hn

/-- For n ≥ 1 and α ≥ 1, we have n^α ≥ n.
    This follows from monotonicity of rpow in the exponent for base ≥ 1. -/
lemma rpow_ge_self_of_ge_one (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ α := by
  have hn_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  calc (n : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [rpow_one]
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ α := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn_ge_one hα

/-- For n ≥ N₀ where g(n) ≥ n^α for all n ≥ N₀, we have g(n) ≥ N₀.
    This follows from g(n) ≥ n^α ≥ n ≥ N₀ when α ≥ 1. -/
lemma g_ge_threshold (g : ℕ → ℕ) (α : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hg_lower : ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → (n : ℝ) ^ α ≤ g n) (n : ℕ) (hn : N₀ ≤ n) (hn_pos : 0 < n) :
    N₀ ≤ g n := by
  have h1 : (n : ℝ) ^ α ≤ (g n : ℝ) := hg_lower n hn
  have hn_ge_one : 1 ≤ n := hn_pos
  have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ α := rpow_ge_self_of_ge_one n α hn_ge_one hα
  have h3 : (n : ℝ) ≤ (g n : ℝ) := le_trans h2 h1
  have h4 : n ≤ g n := by exact_mod_cast h3
  exact le_trans hn h4

/-- Main bound: g(g(n)) ≥ n^{α²} for large n.
    Uses the hypothesis that g(m) ≥ m^α for m ≥ N₀, applied twice. -/
lemma gog_lower_bound (g : ℕ → ℕ) (α : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hg_lower : ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → (n : ℝ) ^ α ≤ g n)
    (_hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : N₀ ≤ n) (hn_pos : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := by
  have hgn_ge_N₀ : N₀ ≤ g n := g_ge_threshold g α N₀ hα hg_lower n hn hn_pos
  have hgn_lower : (n : ℝ) ^ α ≤ (g n : ℝ) := hg_lower n hn
  have hggn_lower : ((g n) : ℝ) ^ α ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := hg_lower (g n) hgn_ge_N₀
  have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hα_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ α := le_trans zero_le_one hα
  have h_nalpha_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg hn_nonneg α
  have h_pow_mono : ((n : ℝ) ^ α) ^ α ≤ ((g n) : ℝ) ^ α :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow h_nalpha_nonneg hgn_lower hα_nonneg
  have h_exp_eq : (n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2) = ((n : ℝ) ^ α) ^ α := by
    rw [sq]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hn_nonneg α α]
  calc (n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2)
      = ((n : ℝ) ^ α) ^ α := h_exp_eq
    _ ≤ ((g n) : ℝ) ^ α := h_pow_mono
    _ ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) := hggn_lower

/-- Lower bound on differences: g(n+1) - g(n) ≥ n^{rα²} for n ≥ N₀.
    Uses the functional inequality and gog_lower_bound. -/
lemma diff_lower_bound (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r α : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_ineq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ))
    (hr_pos : 0 < r) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hg_lower : ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → (n : ℝ) ^ α ≤ g n)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : N₀ ≤ n) (hn_pos : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (r * α ^ 2) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := by
  have h_gog : (n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2) ≤ (g (g n) : ℝ) :=
    gog_lower_bound g α N₀ hα hg_lower hg_pos n hn hn_pos
  have h_ineq : ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := hg_ineq n hn_pos
  have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have h_exp_eq : (n : ℝ) ^ (r * α ^ 2) = ((n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2)) ^ r := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hn_nonneg (α ^ 2) r]
    ring_nf
  have h_nalpha2_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hn_nonneg (α ^ 2)
  have hr_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := le_of_lt hr_pos
  have h_pow_mono : ((n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2)) ^ r ≤ ((g (g n) : ℝ)) ^ r :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow h_nalpha2_nonneg h_gog hr_nonneg
  calc (n : ℝ) ^ (r * α ^ 2)
      = ((n : ℝ) ^ (α ^ 2)) ^ r := h_exp_eq
    _ ≤ ((g (g n) : ℝ)) ^ r := h_pow_mono
    _ ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ) := h_ineq

name: Lambda.eval_value_true_mono
statement:
/-- **Fuel monotonicity for `.value true`.** If `eval m F env e = (v, .value true)`,
    then `eval (m+1) F env e = (v, .value true)`. -/
theorem eval_value_true_mono (F : @Factory Tbase) (env : Env Tbase)
    (m : Nat) (e : LExpr Tbase.mono) (v : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (h : LExpr.eval m F env e = (v, .value true)) :
    LExpr.eval (m+1) F env e = (v, .value true)
src:
/-- **Fuel monotonicity for `.value true`.** If `eval m F env e = (v, .value true)`,
    then `eval (m+1) F env e = (v, .value true)`. -/
theorem eval_value_true_mono (F : @Factory Tbase) (env : Env Tbase)
    (m : Nat) (e : LExpr Tbase.mono) (v : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (h : LExpr.eval m F env e = (v, .value true)) :
    LExpr.eval (m+1) F env e = (v, .value true) := by
  induction m generalizing e v with
  | zero =>
    simp only [LExpr.eval] at h
    by_cases hcan : LExpr.isCanonicalValue F e = true
    · rw [if_pos hcan] at h
      have hfe : v = e := by
        have := congrArg Prod.fst h; simp at this; exact this.symm
      subst hfe
      exact eval_canonical_identity (0 + 1) F env v hcan
    · rw [if_neg hcan] at h
      have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this
  | succ n' ih =>
    -- The inductive step factors two common lemmas: `arg_lift` (each fully-reduced
    -- arg has its eval-result stable across fuel increments), and `args_lift`
    -- (the same lift extended to the whole args list — `.map` and `.all` versions).
    have arg_lift : ∀ a, (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue = true →
        LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a = ((LExpr.eval n' F env a).fst, .value true) := by
      intro a h_ivt
      have h_a_snd : LExpr.eval n' F env a =
          ((LExpr.eval n' F env a).fst, .value true) := by
        rw [← (isValueTrue_eq_true_iff _).mp h_ivt]
      exact ih _ _ h_a_snd
    -- Deduce the "all args fully-reduced" fact from a top-level `.combineValueFlag …`
    -- equation.  This bundles two `rcases` chains that appeared 3× in the old
    -- proof (inline body, ceval, and default).
    have args_from_andValue : ∀ (inner : LExpr Tbase.mono)
        (args : List (LExpr Tbase.mono)),
        (LExpr.eval n' F env inner).snd.combineValueFlag
          (args.all (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue))
            = LExpr.EvalResult.value true →
        LExpr.eval n' F env inner =
          ((LExpr.eval n' F env inner).fst, .value true) ∧
        (∀ a ∈ args, (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue = true) := by
      intro inner args h_snd
      have h_and := (andValue_eq_valueTrue_iff _ _).mp h_snd
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← h_and.1]
      · rw [← List.all_eq_true]; exact h_and.2
    -- Lift the whole args list from fuel n' to fuel n'+1 (both projections).
    have list_lifts : ∀ (args : List (LExpr Tbase.mono))
        (h_all : ∀ a ∈ args, (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue = true),
        args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a).fst) =
          args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env a).fst) ∧
        (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a).snd.isValueTrue) = true := by
      intro args h_all
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · apply List.map_congr_left
        intro a ha; rw [arg_lift a (h_all a ha)]
      · rw [List.all_eq_true]
        intro a ha; rw [arg_lift a (h_all a ha)]
        simp [LExpr.EvalResult.isValueTrue]
    -- Now the main analysis: split on `eval (n'+1) F env e`'s outer structure.
    simp only [LExpr.eval] at h
    revert h
    split
    · rename_i hcan; intro h
      have hfe : v = e := by
        have := congrArg Prod.fst h; simp at this; exact this.symm
      subst hfe
      exact eval_canonical_identity (n' + 1 + 1) F env v hcan
    · rename_i h_not_can
      split
      · rename_i op_expr args lfunc h_call
        split
        · -- inline branch
          rename_i h_cond
          have h_body_isSome : lfunc.body.isSome = true := by
            simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond; exact h_cond.1
          split
          · -- computeTypeSubst = some tySubst
            rename_i tySubst h_ts
            intro h
            -- `inner` is the substituted body evaluated at fuel n'.
            let inner := LExpr.substFvarsLifting
                ((lfunc.body.get h_body_isSome).applySubst tySubst)
                (lfunc.inputs.keys.zip
                  (List.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env a).fst) args))
            have h_fst : (LExpr.eval n' F env inner).fst = v := by
              have := congrArg Prod.fst h; simp at this; exact this
            have h_snd_and : (LExpr.eval n' F env inner).snd.combineValueFlag
                (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue) = .value true := by
              have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this; exact this
            obtain ⟨h_inner_snd, h_argsAllFull⟩ := args_from_andValue inner args h_snd_and
            obtain ⟨h_map_eq', h_argsAllFull_lift⟩ := list_lifts args h_argsAllFull
            have h_new_lift := ih _ _ h_inner_snd
            have h_map_eq'_prod : List.map Prod.fst
                (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a)) =
                List.map Prod.fst (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval n' F env a)) := by
              rw [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval, LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval]; exact h_map_eq'
            show LExpr.eval (n'+1+1) F env e = (v, .value true)
            conv => lhs; rw [LExpr.eval]
            rw [if_neg h_not_can, h_call]
            dsimp only
            split
            · rename_i h_cond_lift
              rw [h_map_eq'_prod, h_ts]
              simp only [LExpr.EvalResult.combineValueFlag,
                LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval, LExpr.List_all_snd_isValueTrue_map_eval, LExpr.combineEvalResValueFlag_eq_pair]
              rw [h_new_lift]
              simp only [h_argsAllFull_lift, h_fst]
              simp
            · rename_i h_cond_lift
              exfalso; apply h_cond_lift; rw [h_map_eq'_prod]; exact h_cond
          · intro h
            exfalso; have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this
        · -- non-inline branch
          rename_i h_cond
          split
          · rename_i h_eval_cond
            split
            · -- concreteEval = none: certified when the rebuilt call is
              -- canonical on fully evaluated arguments
              rename_i h_ceval_none
              intro h
              simp only [LExpr.combineEvalResValueFlag_eq_pair, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
              obtain ⟨h_fst, h_snd⟩ := h
              split at h_snd
              case isFalse =>
                exact absurd h_snd (by simp [LExpr.EvalResult.combineValueFlag])
              rename_i h_can
              have h_argsAllFull :
                  (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval n' F env a)).all
                    (fun r => r.snd.isValueTrue) = true := by
                simpa [LExpr.EvalResult.combineValueFlag] using h_snd
              obtain ⟨h_map_eq, h_argsAllFull_lift⟩ :=
                list_lifts args (fun a ha =>
                  List.all_eq_true.mp h_argsAllFull _ (List.mem_map_of_mem ha))
              have h_map_eq_prod : List.map Prod.fst
                  (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a)) =
                  List.map Prod.fst (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval n' F env a)) := by
                rw [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval, LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval]
                exact h_map_eq
              show LExpr.eval (n'+1+1) F env e = (v, .value true)
              conv => lhs; rw [LExpr.eval]
              rw [if_neg h_not_can, h_call]
              dsimp only
              split
              · rename_i h_cond_lift
                exfalso; apply h_cond; rw [← h_map_eq_prod]; exact h_cond_lift
              · rw [h_map_eq_prod, if_pos h_eval_cond]
                simp only [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval]
                rw [h_ceval_none]
                dsimp only
                simp only [LExpr.List_all_snd_isValueTrue_map_eval]
                rw [h_argsAllFull_lift]
                simp only [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval] at h_can h_fst
                have h_can_v : LExpr.isCanonicalValue F v = true :=
                  h_fst ▸ h_can
                simp [h_fst, h_can_v, LExpr.EvalResult.combineValueFlag]
            · rename_i ceval h_ceval
              split
              · rename_i e' h_ceval_res
                intro h
                have h_fst : (LExpr.eval n' F env e').fst = v := by
                  have := congrArg Prod.fst h; simp at this; exact this
                have h_snd_and : (LExpr.eval n' F env e').snd.combineValueFlag
                    (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env a).snd.isValueTrue) = .value true := by
                  have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this; exact this
                obtain ⟨h_e'_snd, h_argsAllFull⟩ := args_from_andValue _ _ h_snd_and
                obtain ⟨h_map_eq, h_argsAllFull_lift⟩ := list_lifts args h_argsAllFull
                have h_map_eq_prod : List.map Prod.fst
                    (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval (n'+1) F env a)) =
                    List.map Prod.fst (args.map (fun a => LExpr.eval n' F env a)) := by
                  rw [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval, LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval]; exact h_map_eq
                have h_e'_lift := ih _ _ h_e'_snd
                show LExpr.eval (n'+1+1) F env e = (v, .value true)
                conv => lhs; rw [LExpr.eval]
                rw [if_neg h_not_can, h_call]
                dsimp only
                split
                · rename_i h_cond_lift
                  exfalso; apply h_cond; rw [← h_map_eq_prod]; exact h_cond_lift
                · rename_i h_cond_lift
                  simp only [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval] at h_ceval_res
                  rw [h_map_eq_prod, if_pos h_eval_cond]
                  simp only [LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval]
                  rw [h_ceval]
                  dsimp only
                  rw [h_ceval_res]
                  simp only [LExpr.combineEvalResValueFlag_eq_pair]
                  rw [h_e'_lift]
                  simp only [LExpr.EvalResult.combineValueFlag,
                    LExpr.List_all_snd_isValueTrue_map_eval]
                  rw [h_argsAllFull_lift, h_fst]
                  simp
              · intro h; exfalso; have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this
          · intro h; exfalso; have := congrArg Prod.snd h; simp at this
      · rename_i h_nocall
        intro h
        have h_ec := evalCore_value_true_mono n' F env e v
          (fun e' v' hev => ih e' v' hev) h
        simp only [LExpr.eval]
        rw [if_neg h_not_can, h_nocall]
        exact h_ec

name: ArkLib.Lattices.CyclotomicModulus.traceH_Xpow_eq_zero
statement:
/-- **(Claim 2)** `Tr_H(X^i) = 0` whenever `d/2k ∤ i`. Splitting `H = ⟨σ_{-1}, σ_{4k+1}⟩` into the
`⟨4k+1⟩`-orbit `{p_a}` and its conjugate `{q_a = -p_a}`, the orbit sum is `X^i·∑_{j}(X^{4ki})^j`
(`four_pow_i_reindex`), which vanishes (`four_pow_i_geom_zero`); the conjugate sum is its image
under `σ_{-1}`, hence also `0`. -/
theorem traceH_Xpow_eq_zero (α k : ℕ) (h2 : (2 : R) ≠ 0) (hk2pow : ∃ κ, k = 2 ^ κ)
    (hk : 2 * k ∣ 2 ^ α) {i : ℕ} (hi0 : ¬ (2 ^ α / (2 * k)) ∣ i) :
    traceH α k (Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α) i) = 0
src:
/-- **(Claim 2)** `Tr_H(X^i) = 0` whenever `d/2k ∤ i`. Splitting `H = ⟨σ_{-1}, σ_{4k+1}⟩` into the
`⟨4k+1⟩`-orbit `{p_a}` and its conjugate `{q_a = -p_a}`, the orbit sum is `X^i·∑_{j}(X^{4ki})^j`
(`four_pow_i_reindex`), which vanishes (`four_pow_i_geom_zero`); the conjugate sum is its image
under `σ_{-1}`, hence also `0`. -/
theorem traceH_Xpow_eq_zero (α k : ℕ) (h2 : (2 : R) ≠ 0) (hk2pow : ∃ κ, k = 2 ^ κ)
    (hk : 2 * k ∣ 2 ^ α) {i : ℕ} (hi0 : ¬ (2 ^ α / (2 * k)) ∣ i) :
    traceH α k (Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α) i) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨κ, rfl⟩ := hk2pow
  have hκ : κ + 1 ≤ α := succ_le_of_two_mul_two_pow_dvd hk
  have hrange : 2 ^ α / (2 * 2 ^ κ) = 2 ^ (α - κ - 1) := by
    rw [show 2 * 2 ^ κ = 2 ^ (κ + 1) from by rw [pow_succ]; ring, Nat.pow_div hκ (by norm_num),
      Nat.sub_sub]
  have hi0' : ¬ 2 ^ (α - κ - 1) ∣ i := by rwa [hrange] at hi0
  have hmpos : 0 < 2 ^ (α + 1) := by positivity
  have hm4 : (4 : ℕ) ∣ 2 ^ (α + 1) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 from rfl]; exact pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)
  have hm40 : 2 ^ (α + 1) % 4 = 0 := by obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hm4; omega
  have hp4 : ∀ a, (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1) % 4 = 1 := fun a => by
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hm4, Nat.pow_mod]
    norm_num [show (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) % 4 = 1 from by omega]
  have hplt : ∀ a, (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1) < 2 ^ (α + 1) := fun a => Nat.mod_lt _ hmpos
  have hqeq : ∀ a, (2 ^ (α + 1) - (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) % 2 ^ (α + 1)
      = 2 ^ (α + 1) - (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1) := fun a =>
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := hplt a; have := hp4 a; omega)
  have hpinj : Set.InjOn (fun a => (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1))
      ↑(Finset.range (2 ^ (α - κ - 1))) := four_pow_injOn κ α hκ
  -- the orbit sum and conjugate sum both vanish
  have hTp : ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (α - κ - 1)),
      Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α) (i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1))) = 0 := by
    rw [four_pow_i_reindex α κ i hκ, four_pow_i_geom_zero α κ i h2 hκ hi0', mul_zero]
  have hTq : ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (α - κ - 1)),
      Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α)
        (i * ((2 ^ (α + 1) - (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) % 2 ^ (α + 1))) = 0 := by
    have hconj : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ (α - κ - 1)),
        Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α)
          (i * ((2 ^ (α + 1) - (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) % 2 ^ (α + 1)))
        = conjAut α (Xpow (powTwoCyclotomic (R := R) α)
            (i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)))) := by
      intro a _
      rw [conjAut, galoisRingHom_apply, galoisAut_Xpow' α (conjExp α) _ (conjExp_odd α)]
      apply Xpow_congr_mod
      have hpa := hplt a
      have key : i * (2 ^ (α + 1) - (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1))
          ≡ i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) * conjExp α [MOD 2 ^ (α + 1)] := by
        apply Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' (i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)))
        have hc1 : conjExp α + 1 = 2 ^ (α + 1) := by
          rw [conjExp]; have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (α + 1) := Nat.one_le_two_pow; omega
        rw [← Nat.mul_add,
          Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt hpa),
          show i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) * conjExp α
              + i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1))
            = i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)) * 2 ^ (α + 1) from by
            rw [← hc1]; ring]
        exact (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr ⟨i, by ring⟩).trans
          (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr ⟨i * ((4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1)), by ring⟩).symm
      exact (Nat.ModEq.mul_left i (Nat.mod_modEq _ _)).trans key
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hconj, ← map_sum, hTp, map_zero]
  -- assemble
  rw [traceH_Xpow' α (2 ^ κ)]
  unfold Hexp
  rw [hrange, Finset.sum_biUnion (by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Function.onFun]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    have hpab : (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ a % 2 ^ (α + 1) ≠ (4 * 2 ^ κ + 1) ^ b % 2 ^ (α + 1) :=
      fun h => hab (hpinj ha hb h)
    intro x hx hx'
    rw [hqeq a] at hx; rw [hqeq b] at hx'
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hx'
    have := hp4 a; have := hp4 b; have := hplt a; have := hplt b
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hx' with h' | h' <;> omega)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_pair (by
    rw [hqeq a]; have := hp4 a; have := hplt a; omega)),
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, hTp, hTq, add_zero]

name: LeanPool.CencovPetz.MonotoneMetricFamily.uniformScalar_eq_of_mul
statement:
theorem uniformScalar_eq_of_mul (G : MonotoneMetricFamily) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    uniformScalar G (Fintype.card (Fin n × Fin m))
      (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)
      =
      uniformScalar G n hn
src:
theorem uniformScalar_eq_of_mul (G : MonotoneMetricFamily) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    uniformScalar G (Fintype.card (Fin n × Fin m))
      (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)
      =
      uniformScalar G n hn := by
  classical
  -- Notation.
  let α := Fin n
  let β := Fin n × Fin m
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_two hn⟩⟩
  have : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hm⟩⟩
  have : Nonempty β := by
    classical
    rcases (inferInstance : Nonempty α) with ⟨a0⟩
    exact ⟨(a0, ⟨0, hm⟩)⟩
  let N : ℕ := Fintype.card β
  have : Nonempty (Fin N) := ⟨⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩⟩
  let e : β ≃ Fin N := Fintype.equivFin β
  let κ : MarkovMorphism α β := MarkovMorphism.replicate (α := α) m hm
  let δ : MarkovMorphism β (Fin N) :=
    MarkovMorphism.deterministic (α := β) (β := Fin N) (g := (e : β → Fin N)) e.surjective
  have hκ_uniform : κ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) = Simplex.uniform (α := β) := by
    simpa [κ, β] using MarkovMorphism.replicate_pushforward_uniform (α := α) (m := m) (hm := hm)
  have hδ_uniform : δ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := β)) = Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N) := by
    classical
    ext j
    have hj :
        (δ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := β))).p j =
          (Simplex.uniform (α := β)).p (e.symm j) := by
      simpa [δ] using
        (MarkovMorphism.deterministic_pushforward_apply_of_equiv (α := β) (β := Fin N) (e := e)
          (p := Simplex.uniform (α := β)) (b := j))
    rw [hj]
    simp [Simplex.uniform_apply, Fintype.card_congr e]
  -- The `Fin n` scalar is detected on `dij 0 1`.
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_two hn⟩
  let i1 : Fin n := ⟨1, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hn⟩
  have hi01 : i0 ≠ i1 := by
    intro h
    exact Nat.zero_ne_one (congrArg Fin.val h)
  let u : tangentSpace (α := α) := TangentFin.Basis.dij (n := n) i0 i1
  -- Transport `u` along replicate, then along the equivalence `e : β ≃ Fin N`.
  let v : tangentSpace (α := Fin N) := δ.tangentPushforward (κ.tangentPushforward u)
  -- `u` is nonzero, so Fisher on it is positive.
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := congrArg (fun w : tangentSpace (α := α) => (w : α → ℝ) i0) h
    have hu_eval : (u : α → ℝ) i0 = 0 := by
      simpa using h'
    have hu_eval' : (u : α → ℝ) i0 = (1 : ℝ) := by
      simp [u, TangentFin.Basis.dij_coe, TangentFin.Basis.e, hi01]
    simp_all
  have hFpos : 0 < fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u :=
    fisherBilin.pos (p := Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u hu0
  have hFne : fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hFpos
  -- Replication + equivalence invariance for `G` and for Fisher.
  have hG :
      G.g (α := Fin N) (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N)) v v
        = G.g (α := α) (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
    -- First reduce from `Fin N` to `β` by `e`.
    have h_equiv :
        G.g (α := Fin N) (δ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := β))) v v
          =
          G.g (α := β) (Simplex.uniform (α := β))
            (κ.tangentPushforward u) (κ.tangentPushforward u) := by
      -- `eq_of_equiv` has the `Fin N` side on the left.
      simpa [v, δ] using
        (MonotoneMetricFamily.eq_of_equiv (G := G) (α := β) (β := Fin N) (e := e)
          (p := Simplex.uniform (α := β))
          (u := κ.tangentPushforward u) (v := κ.tangentPushforward u))
    -- Then reduce from `β` to `α` by replication.
    have h_repl :
        G.g (α := β) (κ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := α)))
            (κ.tangentPushforward u) (κ.tangentPushforward u)
          = G.g (α := α) (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
      simpa [κ] using
        (MonotoneMetricFamily.eq_of_replicate (G := G) (α := α) (m := m) (hm := hm)
          (p := Simplex.uniform (α := α)) (u := u) (v := u))
    -- Assemble and rewrite the pushed-forward uniform points.
    simpa [hδ_uniform, hκ_uniform] using (h_equiv.trans (by simpa [hκ_uniform] using h_repl))
  have hF :
      fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N)) v v
        = fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
    -- Same argument with `fisherMetricFamily`.
    have h_equiv :
        fisherBilin (δ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := β))) v v
          =
          fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := β))
            (κ.tangentPushforward u) (κ.tangentPushforward u) := by
      have h :=
        (MonotoneMetricFamily.eq_of_equiv
          (G := fisherMetricFamily) (α := β) (β := Fin N) (e := e)
          (p := Simplex.uniform (α := β))
          (u := κ.tangentPushforward u) (v := κ.tangentPushforward u))
      -- Rewrite the pushed-forward uniform point.
      simpa [fisherMetricFamily, v, δ, hδ_uniform] using h
    have h_repl :
        fisherBilin (κ.pushforward (Simplex.uniform (α := α)))
            (κ.tangentPushforward u) (κ.tangentPushforward u)
          = fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
      simpa [κ, fisherMetricFamily] using
        (MonotoneMetricFamily.eq_of_replicate (G := fisherMetricFamily) (α := α) (m := m) (hm := hm)
          (p := Simplex.uniform (α := α)) (u := u) (v := u))
    simpa [hδ_uniform, hκ_uniform] using (h_equiv.trans (by simpa [hκ_uniform] using h_repl))
  -- Apply the uniform-point scalar-multiple identities on `Fin n` and `Fin N`,
  -- then compare scalars.
  have hFinN :
      (TangentFin.Bilin.B (G := G) (n := N))
        =
        (uniformScalar G N (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)) •
          fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N)) := by
    -- Use `UniformScalarMultiple` at `0,1` on `Fin N`.
    let j0 : Fin N := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_two
      (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)⟩
    let j1 : Fin N := ⟨1, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two
      (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)⟩
    have hj01 : j0 ≠ j1 := by
      intro h
      exact Nat.zero_ne_one (congrArg Fin.val h)
    simpa [MonotoneMetricFamily.uniformScalar, j0, j1] using
      (TangentFin.Bilin.B_eq_smul_fisherBilin_uniform (G := G) (n := N) (i0 := j0) (i1 := j1) hj01)
  have hFinn :
      (TangentFin.Bilin.B (G := G) (n := n))
        =
        (uniformScalar G n hn) • fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin n)) := by
    -- Use `UniformScalarMultiple` at `0,1` on `Fin n`.
    simpa [MonotoneMetricFamily.uniformScalar, i0, i1, hi01] using
      (TangentFin.Bilin.B_eq_smul_fisherBilin_uniform (G := G) (n := n) (i0 := i0) (i1 := i1) hi01)
  -- Evaluate both bilinear-form identities on `v` / `u` and use the isometry equalities.
  have hFinN_apply :
      G.g (α := Fin N) (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N)) v v
        = (uniformScalar G N (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)) *
          fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := Fin N)) v v := by
    -- Unfold `B` and apply `hFinN`.
    simp_all
  have hFinn_apply :
      G.g (α := α) (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u
        = (uniformScalar G n hn) * fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
    have := congrArg (fun B => B u u) hFinn
    simpa [TangentFin.Bilin.B, mul_assoc, α] using this
  -- Compare the two scalar factors using `hG` and `hF`.
  have :
      (uniformScalar G N (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm)) *
          fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u
        =
        (uniformScalar G n hn) *
          fisherBilin (Simplex.uniform (α := α)) u u := by
    -- Rewrite `hFinN_apply` and `hFinn_apply` using `hG`/`hF`.
    simp_all
  -- Cancel the positive Fisher factor.
  have hscalar :
      uniformScalar G N
        (by exact two_le_card_prod (n := n) (m := m) hn hm) = uniformScalar G n hn :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hFne this
  simpa [β, N] using hscalar

name: col_weight_sum_eq
statement:
/-- Sum of (m+2-i) over nonzero positions in column j equals triangular number -/
lemma col_weight_sum_eq {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    let t_j := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0)).card
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0), (m + 2 - (i : ℕ)) =
    t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2
src:
/-- Sum of (m+2-i) over nonzero positions in column j equals triangular number -/
lemma col_weight_sum_eq {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    let t_j := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0)).card
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0), (m + 2 - (i : ℕ)) =
    t_j * (t_j + 1) / 2 := by
  set S := univ.filter (fun i : Fin (m + 2) => A i j ≠ 0) with hS_def
  intro t_j
  by_cases hS_empty : S.card = 0
  ·
    have hS_eq_empty : S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hS_empty
    have ht_j_zero : t_j = 0 := hS_empty

import Mathlib

open BigOperators Finset Matrix

/-- Values are monotone increasing down columns -/
lemma mono_down {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    A (Fin.castSucc i) j ≤ A (Fin.succ i) j := by
  rcases hb i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Values are monotone increasing rightward in rows -/
lemma mono_right {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    A i (Fin.castSucc j) ≤ A i (Fin.succ j) := by
  rcases hc i j with h | h <;> omega

/-- Monotonicity for multiple steps down a column -/
lemma mono_down_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (i i' : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 2)) (hi : i ≤ i') : A i j ≤ A i' j := by
  induction i' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hi0 : i = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hi
    rw [hi0]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hik : i ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    ·
      have h1 := ih hik
      have h2 := mono_down hb k j
      omega
    ·
      push_neg at hik
      have heq : i = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < i := hik
        have h2 : (i : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hi
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]

/-- If entry is positive, all entries below are positive (downward closure) -/
lemma pos_of_pos_above {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    {i i' : Fin (m + 2)} {j : Fin (m + 2)}
    (h : A i j > 0) (hi : i ≤ i') : A i' j > 0 := by
  have hmono := mono_down_le hb i i' j hi
  omega

/-- Monotonicity for multiple steps right in a row -/
lemma mono_right_le {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j j' : Fin (m + 2)) (hj : j ≤ j') : A i j ≤ A i j' := by
  induction j' using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.le_zero_iff.mp hj
    rw [hj0]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hjk : j ≤ Fin.castSucc k
    ·
      have h1 := ih hjk
      have h2 := mono_right hc i k
      omega
    ·
      push_neg at hjk
      have heq : j = Fin.succ k := by
        apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
        have h1 : (Fin.castSucc k : ℕ) < j := hjk
        have h2 : (j : ℕ) ≤ (Fin.succ k : ℕ) := hj
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc] at h1 h2 ⊢
        omega
      rw [heq]

/-- If entry is positive, all entries to the right are positive (rightward closure) -/
lemma pos_of_pos_left {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i : Fin (m + 2)} {j j' : Fin (m + 2)}
    (h : A i j > 0) (hj : j ≤ j') : A i j' > 0 := by
  have hmono := mono_right_le hc i j j' hj
  omega

/-- The first nonzero entry in a column equals 1 -/
lemma first_nonzero_col_eq_one {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j + 1)
    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i j : Fin (m + 2)} (hpos : A i j > 0)
    (hfirst : ∀ i' : Fin (m + 2), i' < i → A i' j = 0) : A i j = 1 := by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  ·
    subst hi
    have hj_gt_m : (j : ℕ) > m := by
      by_contra h_le
      push_neg at h_le
      have := ha 0 j (by simp; omega)
      omega
    have hj_eq : j = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
      apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [Fin.last]
      have hj_le := Fin.is_le j
      omega
    subst hj_eq
    have h0m : A 0 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m)) = 0 := by
      apply ha
      simp [Fin.last, Fin.coe_castSucc]
    have hstep := hc 0 (Fin.last m)
    simp only [Fin.succ_last] at hstep
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h, h0m] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, h0m]
  ·
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
    subst hi'
    have h_above_zero : A (Fin.castSucc i') j = 0 := by
      apply hfirst
      exact Fin.castSucc_lt_succ i'
    have hstep := hb i' j
    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h] at hpos
      omega
    ·
      rw [h, h_above_zero]

/-- The first nonzero entry in a row equals 1 -/
lemma first_nonzero_row_eq_one {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℕ}
    (ha : ∀ (i j : Fin (m + 2)), (i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) ≤ m → A i j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2)),
      A (Fin.succ i) j = A (Fin.castSucc i) j ∨

    (hc : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 2)) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) ∨
      A i (Fin.succ j) = A i (Fin.castSucc j) + 1)
    {i j : Fin (m + 2)} (hpos : A i j > 0)
    (hfirst : ∀ j' : Fin (m + 2), j' < j → A i j' = 0) : A i j = 1 := by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  ·
    subst hj
    have hi_gt_m : (i : ℕ) > m := by
      by_contra h_le
      push_neg at h_le
      have := ha i 0 (by simp; omega)
      omega
    have hi_eq : i = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
      apply Fin.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [Fin.last]
      have hi_le := Fin.is_le i
      omega
    subst hi_eq
    have hm0 : A (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m)) 0 = 0 := by

      simp [Fin.last, Fin.coe_castSucc]
    have hstep := hb (Fin.last m) 0

    rcases hstep with h | h

    ·
      rw [h, hm0]

      exact Fin.castSucc_lt_succ j'

    rcases hstep with h | h
    ·
      rw [h] at hpos
      omega
    ·
