  have Φ1_inner_Φ2_re : (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).re = cos t/(4 * t * (sin t)^2) * (1 - t * sin t) := by
    rw [Φ1_inner_Φ2, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.re_mul_ofReal]
    simp
  have Φ1_inner_Φ2_im : (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ).im = cos t/(4 * t * (sin t)^2) * (- t * cos t) := by
    rw [Φ1_inner_Φ2, Complex.add_im, Complex.im_mul_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_im]
    simp
  have potential_H_cos_sin : potential .stabilityCounterExample H =
      - (cos t) ^ 2/ (4 * (sin t)^2) := by
    rw [potential, massTerm_stabilityCounterExample, quarticTerm_stabilityCounterExample]
    rw [Φ1_norm_sq, Φ2_norm_sq, Φ1_inner_Φ2_re, Φ1_inner_Φ2_im]
    field
  have potential_eq_c : potential .stabilityCounterExample H = - (|c| + 1) := by
    have htan : sin t / cos t = (2 * √(|c| + 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      exact tan_arctan _
    rw [potential_H_cos_sin, show -cos t ^ 2 / (4 * sin t ^ 2) = -1 / (4 * (sin t / cos t) ^ 2) by
      field, htan]
    field_simp
    rw [sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  /- Proving potential is unbounded. -/
  use H
  rw [potential_eq_c]
  grind

name: filter_Icc_card_eq_set_card
statement:
/-- The map x ↦ 2x - 1 gives a bijection from elements of {1,..,p-1} satisfying x(x-1) = -1
    to square roots of -3 in ZMod p. -/
lemma filter_Icc_card_eq_set_card (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)).card =
    ({x : ZMod p | x ^ 2 = -3}.toFinset).card
src:
/-- The map x ↦ 2x - 1 gives a bijection from elements of {1,..,p-1} satisfying x(x-1) = -1
    to square roots of -3 in ZMod p. -/
lemma filter_Icc_card_eq_set_card (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)).card =
    ({x : ZMod p | x ^ 2 = -3}.toFinset).card := by
  have h2_ne : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    omega
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun (n : ℕ) (_ : n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)) => (2 * (n : ZMod p) - 1 : ZMod p))
  · intro n hn
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn
    have hsol := hn.2
    rw [near_diag_eq_transform p hp3] at hsol
    exact hsol
  · intro n₁ hn₁ n₂ hn₂ heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn₁ hn₂
    have h2eq : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ := by
      have heq' : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ - 1 = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ - 1 := heq
      have : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ - 1 + 1 = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ - 1 + 1 := by rw [heq']
      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at this
      exact this
    have h2_unit : IsUnit (2 : ZMod p) := h2_ne.isUnit
    have hmod : (n₁ : ZMod p) = (n₂ : ZMod p) := h2_unit.mul_left_cancel h2eq
    have hn₁_bound : n₁ < p := by omega
    have hn₂_bound : n₂ < p := by omega
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at hmod
    have : n₁ % p = n₂ % p := hmod
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn₁_bound, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn₂_bound] at this
    exact this
  · intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy
    let x : ZMod p := (y + 1) / 2
    have hx_eq : 2 * x - 1 = y := by
      simp only [x]
      field_simp
    have hx_sol : x * (x - 1) = -1 := by
      rw [near_diag_eq_transform p hp3]
      rw [hx_eq]
      exact hy
    have hx_ne0 : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx0
      rw [hx0] at hx_sol
      have : (0 : ZMod p) * (0 - 1) = 0 := by ring
      rw [this] at hx_sol
      have : (-1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have h1eq0 : (1 : ZMod p) = 0 := by
          calc (1 : ZMod p) = -(-1) := by ring
            _ = -0 := by rw [h]
            _ = 0 := by ring
        have hp1 : p ∣ 1 := by
          have := ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd 1 p
          rw [Nat.cast_one] at this
          exact this.mp h1eq0
        have : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp1
        omega
      exact this hx_sol.symm
    have hval_pos : 0 < x.val := by
      rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
      intro hval0
      have : x = 0 := by
        have : (x.val : ZMod p) = x := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
        rw [hval0] at this
        simp at this
        exact this.symm
      exact hx_ne0 this
    have hval_lt : x.val < p := ZMod.val_lt x
    have hcast : (x.val : ZMod p) = x := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
    have hmem : x.val ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod p) * ((n : ZMod p) - 1) = -1) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · constructor <;> omega
      · rw [hcast]; exact hx_sol
    exact ⟨x.val, hmem, by rw [hcast, hx_eq]⟩
header:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

abbrev modInv (p : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ := ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹)

abbrev descentCount (p : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  #{k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) | modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k}

theorem prime_gt_3_mod_12 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
  have h_not_even : p % 2 = 1 := by
    have h₁ : p % 2 = 1 := by
      have h₂ := hp.1.eq_two_or_odd
      cases h₂ with
      | inl h₂ =>
        exfalso
        omega
      | inr h₂ =>
        omega
    exact h₁

  have h_not_div_3 : p % 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h₁ : p % 3 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have h₃ : 3 ∣ p := by
        omega
      have h₄ : p.Prime := hp.1
      have h₅ : p = 3 := by
        have h₆ := h₄.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 3 h₃
        omega
      omega
    exact h₁

  have h_mod_12 : p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
    have h₁ : p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
      have h₂ : p % 12 = 0 ∨ p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 2 ∨ p % 12 = 3 ∨ p % 12 = 4 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 6 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 8 ∨ p % 12 = 9 ∨ p % 12 = 10 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
        omega
      rcases h₂ with (h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂)
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inl h₂
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        have h₃ : p % 3 = 0 := by
          omega
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₂)
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h₂))
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        have h₃ : p % 3 = 0 := by
          omega
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h₂))
    exact h₁

  exact h_mod_12

/-- The key hyperbola identity: For k in the valid range, (I(k)+1)(I(k+1)-1) ≡ -1 (mod p).
    This follows from the fact that if k·I(k) ≡ 1 and (k+1)·I(k+1) ≡ 1, then
    subtracting and rearranging gives (I(k)+1)(I(k+1)-1) ≡ -1.
    The proof uses that 1/I(k) - 1/I(k+1) = 1, so I(k+1) - I(k) = I(k)·I(k+1),
    which can be rearranged to the hyperbola form. -/
theorem hyperbola_identity (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((modInv p k : ZMod p) + 1) * ((modInv p (k + 1) : ZMod p) - 1) = -1 := by
  have hval_k : (modInv p k : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have hval_k1 : (modInv p (k + 1) : ZMod p) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  rw [hval_k, hval_k1]
  have hp_two_le : 2 ≤ p := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.out
  have hk_lt : k < p := by omega
  have hk1_lt : k + 1 < p := by omega
  have hk_ne : (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < k) hdvd
    omega
  have hk1_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < k + 1) hdvd
    omega
  have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p) + 1 := by norm_cast
  rw [hcast]
  have hk1_add_ne : (k : ZMod p) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    convert hk1_ne using 1
    norm_cast
  have key : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  calc ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + 1) * (((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1)
      = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1 := by ring
    _ = ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹) - (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1 := by rw [key]
    _ = -1 := by ring

/-- There are no solutions (u, v) to uv ≡ -1 (mod p) with u, v ∈ {1,...,p-1} and u = v + 2.
    This is because if u = v + 2, then (v+2)v ≡ -1 (mod p), so v² + 2v + 1 ≡ 0,
    i.e., (v+1)² ≡ 0 (mod p). Since p is prime, v = p - 1. Then u = v + 2 = p + 1,
    which is not in {1,...,p-1}. So the hypotheses lead to a contradiction. -/
theorem no_gap_two_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p)
    (u v : ℕ) (hu : 1 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ p - 1) (_ : 1 ≤ v ∧ v ≤ p - 1)
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hgap : u = v + 2) :
    False := by
  have h1 : ((v : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have eq1 : ((v + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * v = -1 := by rw [← hgap]; exact huv
    calc ((v : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 2 = (v : ZMod p)^2 + 2 * v + 1 := by ring
      _ = ((v : ZMod p) + 2) * v + 1 := by ring
      _ = ((v + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * v + 1 := by simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [eq1]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  have h2 : (v : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
    rwa [sq_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  have h3 : v = p - 1 := by
    have hv1 : (v : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      calc (v : ZMod p) = (v : ZMod p) + 1 - 1 := by ring
        _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [h2]
        _ = -1 := by ring
    have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.Prime.pos hp.out
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
    have hvlt : v < p := by omega
    have hpm1lt : p - 1 < p := Nat.sub_lt hp0 (by omega)
    have h_neg1_val : (-1 : ZMod p).val = p - 1 := by
      have hp_zero : (p : ZMod p) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (ZMod p) p
      have h_pm1_eq_neg1 : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
        rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
        calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = ((p - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) := by
              simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          _ = (p : ℕ) := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hp1]
          _ = (0 : ZMod p) := hp_zero
      calc (-1 : ZMod p).val = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p).val := by rw [← h_pm1_eq_neg1]
        _ = p - 1 := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hpm1lt
    have h_v_val : (v : ZMod p).val = v := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hvlt
    rw [hv1] at h_v_val
    rw [h_neg1_val] at h_v_val
    exact h_v_val.symm
  omega

/-- For u ∈ {1,...,p-1} with p prime, the val of -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ is in {1,...,p-1}.
    Since u ≠ 0 in ZMod p, its inverse is nonzero, so -u⁻¹ is also nonzero,
    hence its val is in {1,...,p-1}. -/
lemma neg_inv_val_mem_Icc (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) :
    ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) := by
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu ⊢
  constructor
  · have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
      have hp1 : p > u := by omega
      have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
      omega
    have hinv_ne : (u : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hu_ne
    have hneg_ne : (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr hinv_ne
    have hval_ne : ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)).mpr hneg_ne
    omega
  · have hval_lt : ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) < p := ZMod.val_lt _
    omega

/-- The product (u : ZMod p) * (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)) equals -1 in ZMod p. -/
lemma neg_inv_val_mul_eq_neg_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) :
    (u : ZMod p) * (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
  have h1 : (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) : ZMod p) = -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  rw [h1]
  ring_nf
  have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
    rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
    have hp1 : p > u := by omega
    have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
    omega
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hu_ne]

/-- The filtered set of solutions equals the image of u ↦ (u, ZMod.val(-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)). -/
lemma hyperbola_eq_image (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    {x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1} =
    (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).image (fun (u : ℕ) => (u, ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹))) := by
  ext ⟨u, v⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  ·
    intro ⟨⟨hu, hv⟩, huv_eq⟩
    use u, hu
    constructor
    · rfl
    ·
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hv hu
      have hv_lt : v < p := by omega
      have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
        have hp1 : p > u := by omega
        have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
        omega
      have hv_eq : (v : ZMod p) = -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
        have : (v : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu_ne, one_mul]
        rw [huv_eq] at this
        simp only [mul_neg, mul_one] at this
        exact this
      have hv_cast : (v : ZMod p).val = v := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hv_lt
      rw [hv_eq] at hv_cast
      exact hv_cast
  ·
    intro ⟨u', hu', hu'_eq, hv_eq⟩
    subst hu'_eq hv_eq
    constructor
    · constructor
      · exact hu'
      · exact neg_inv_val_mem_Icc p u' hu'
    · exact neg_inv_val_mul_eq_neg_one p u' hu'

/-- The function u ↦ (u, ZMod.val(-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)) is injective. -/
lemma hyperbola_map_injective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    Function.Injective (fun (u : ℕ) => (u, ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹))) := by
  intro u₁ u₂ h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  exact h.1

/-- The number of solutions (u,v) to uv ≡ -1 (mod p) with u,v ∈ {1,...,p-1} is exactly p-1. -/
theorem count_hyperbola_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1} = p - 1 := by
  rw [hyperbola_eq_image p hp3]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (hyperbola_map_injective p)]
  rw [Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

/-- When p % 4 = 1, there are exactly 2 solutions to x² = -1 in {1,...,p-1} -/
lemma count_diagonal_solutions_mod_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (hmod : p % 4 = 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card = 2 := by
  have hs : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) := by
    rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, ZMod.card p]
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hs
  have hr' : r * r = -1 := hr.symm
  have hr_ne_zero : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq, mul_zero] at hr'
    exact one_ne_zero (neg_eq_zero.mp hr'.symm)
  have hnr : (-r) ^ 2 = -1 := by
    rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  have hr_ne_neg : r ≠ -r := by
    intro heq
    have h2r : r + r = 0 := by
      calc r + r = r - (-r) := by ring
           _ = r - r := by rw [← heq]
           _ = 0 := by ring
    have : (2 : ZMod p) * r = 0 := by
      rw [show (2 : ZMod p) * r = r + r from by ring, h2r]
    have h2_ne : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      have : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
      exact ZMod.prime_ne_zero p 2 (by omega : p ≠ 2)
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp this with
    | inl h => exact h2_ne h
    | inr h => exact hr_ne_zero h
  have hsol : ∀ x : ZMod p, x ^ 2 = -1 ↔ x = r ∨ x = -r := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [sq] at hx
      have heq_sq : x ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by rw [sq, sq, hx, hr']
      rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp heq_sq with h | h
      · left; exact h
      · right; exact h
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · rw [sq, hr']
      · rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.out.pos
  have hne : NeZero p := ⟨hp_pos.ne'⟩
  have hr_val_pos : 0 < r.val := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h
    rw [ZMod.val_eq_zero] at h
    exact hr_ne_zero h
  have hr_val_lt : r.val < p := ZMod.val_lt r
  have hnr_val_pos : 0 < (-r).val := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h
    rw [ZMod.val_eq_zero] at h
    have : -r = 0 := h
    rw [neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact hr_ne_zero this
  have hnr_val_lt : (-r).val < p := ZMod.val_lt (-r)
  have hvals_ne : r.val ≠ (-r).val := by
    intro h
    have hinj := ZMod.val_injective p
    exact hr_ne_neg (hinj h)
  have hfilter : (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1) = {r.val, (-r).val} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hx_range, hx_sq⟩
      have hx_lt : x < p := by omega
      rw [hsol (x : ZMod p)] at hx_sq
      rcases hx_sq with h | h
      · left
        have : (x : ZMod p).val = r.val := by rw [h]
        rwa [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx_lt] at this
      · right
        have : (x : ZMod p).val = (-r).val := by rw [h]
        rwa [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx_lt] at this
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · constructor
        · exact ⟨hr_val_pos, by omega⟩
        · simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, sq, hr']
      · constructor
        · exact ⟨hnr_val_pos, by omega⟩
        · simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
          rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_pair hvals_ne]

/-- When p % 4 ≠ 1, there are 0 solutions to x² = -1 in {1,...,p-1} -/
lemma count_diagonal_solutions_not_mod_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (hmod : p % 4 ≠ 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card = 0 := by
  have hp_odd : Odd p := hp.out.odd_of_ne_two (by omega : p ≠ 2)
  have hp_mod_two : p % 2 = 1 := Nat.odd_iff.mp hp_odd
  have hp_mod4 : p % 4 = 1 ∨ p % 4 = 3 := Nat.odd_mod_four_iff.mp hp_mod_two
  have hmod3 : p % 4 = 3 := by omega
  have hns : ¬IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) := by
    rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, ZMod.card p]
    omega
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_false_of_mem]
  intro x _
  intro hx
  rw [sq] at hx
  exact hns ⟨x, hx.symm⟩

/-- For a prime p, the equation x² ≡ -1 (mod p) has exactly 2 solutions if p ≡ 1 (mod 4),
    and 0 solutions if p ≡ 3 (mod 4). More precisely, the number of x ∈ {1,...,p-1}
    with x² ≡ -1 (mod p) equals 2 if p % 4 = 1, and 0 otherwise.
    This uses FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff from Mathlib. -/
theorem count_diagonal_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card =
      if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0 := by
  by_cases hmod : p % 4 = 1
  ·
    simp only [hmod, ↓reduceIte]
    exact count_diagonal_solutions_mod_one p hp3 hmod
  ·
    simp only [hmod, ↓reduceIte]
    exact count_diagonal_solutions_not_mod_one p hp3 hmod

/-- Helper: p - 1 = -1 in ZMod p -/
lemma pminus1_eq_neg1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have h2 : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
    have h3 : (p - 1 + 1 : ℕ) = p := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
    calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = (((p - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
      _ = ((p : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by rw [h3]
      _ = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self p
  calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 + (-1) := by ring
    _ = 0 + (-1) := by rw [h2]
    _ = -1 := by ring

/-- Helper: val of -1 is p - 1 -/
lemma val_neg1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] : (-1 : ZMod p).val = p - 1 := by
  rw [← pminus1_eq_neg1 p]
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p)]

/-- For k in [1, p-2], k cast to ZMod p is nonzero. -/
lemma k_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
  intro heq
  have hdvd : p ∣ k := (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd k p).mp heq
  have h1 : p ≤ k := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
  have h2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], k+1 cast to ZMod p is nonzero. -/
lemma k_succ_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
  intro heq
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hdvd : p ∣ k + 1 := (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (k + 1) p).mp heq
  have h1 : p ≤ k + 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
  omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], modInv p k lies in [1, p-2] (tighter than [1, p-1]).
    Specifically, modInv p k ≠ p - 1 because that would require k = -1 = p - 1,
    which contradicts k ≤ p - 2. -/
lemma modInv_in_range_tight (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    1 ≤ modInv p k ∧ modInv p k ≤ p - 2 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hk_ne : (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := k_ne_zero p k hk1 hk2
  have hinv_ne : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hk_ne
  have h_pos : 0 < ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹) := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_lt : modInv p k < p := ZMod.val_lt ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹)
  constructor
  ·
    exact h_pos
  ·
    by_contra h_eq
    push_neg at h_eq
    have h2 : modInv p k = p - 1 := by omega
    have h3 : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ = -1 := by
      have h3' : ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹) = p - 1 := h2
      rw [← pminus1_eq_neg1 p]
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h3', ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p)]
    have h4 : (k : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (k : ZMod p), h3]
      simp
    have h5 : ZMod.val (k : ZMod p) = p - 1 := by
      rw [h4, val_neg1 p]
    have hk_lt : k < p := by omega
    have h6 : ZMod.val (k : ZMod p) = k := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk_lt
    rw [h6] at h5
    omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], modInv p (k+1) lies in [2, p-1].
    Specifically, modInv p (k+1) ≠ 1 because that would require k + 1 = 1,
    which contradicts k ≥ 1. -/
lemma modInv_succ_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    2 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) ∧ modInv p (k + 1) ≤ p - 1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hk_succ_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := k_succ_ne_zero p k hk1 hk2
  have hinv_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hk_succ_ne
  have h_lt : modInv p (k + 1) < p := ZMod.val_lt (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹)
  have h_upper : modInv p (k + 1) ≤ p - 1 := by omega
  have h_pos : 0 < modInv p (k + 1) := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_ne_one : modInv p (k + 1) ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    have h1 : ZMod.val (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹) = 1 := heq
    have h2 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
      exact ZMod.val_one p
    have h3 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h1, h2]
    have h4 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)), h3]
      simp
    have h5 : ZMod.val ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) := by rw [h4]
    have h6 : k + 1 < p := by omega
    have h7 : ZMod.val ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = k + 1 := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt h6
    rw [h7, h2] at h5
    omega
  have h_lower : 2 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) := by omega
  exact ⟨h_lower, h_upper⟩

/-- The descent condition I(k+1) < I(k) is equivalent to u > v + 2
    where u = I(k) + 1 and v = I(k+1) - 1. -/
lemma descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k ↔ modInv p k + 1 > modInv p (k + 1) - 1 + 2 := by
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  omega

/-- The map k ↦ (I(k) + 1, I(k+1) - 1) is injective on [1, p-2]. -/
lemma phi_injective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    Function.Injective (fun k : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)} =>
      (modInv p k.val + 1, modInv p (k.val + 1) - 1)) := by
  intro k₁ k₂ heq
  have h_fst : modInv p k₁.val + 1 = modInv p k₂.val + 1 := by
    have := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    exact this
  have h_inv_eq : modInv p k₁.val = modInv p k₂.val := by omega
  have hk₁_mem := k₁.property
  have hk₂_mem := k₂.property
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hk₁_mem hk₂_mem
  have hk₁_lt_p : k₁.val < p := by omega
  have hk₂_lt_p : k₂.val < p := by omega
  have h_zmod_inv_eq : (k₁.val : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (k₂.val : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
    apply ZMod.val_injective p
    exact h_inv_eq
  have h_zmod_eq : (k₁.val : ZMod p) = (k₂.val : ZMod p) := by
    rw [← inv_inv (k₁.val : ZMod p), ← inv_inv (k₂.val : ZMod p)]
    rw [h_zmod_inv_eq]
  have h_val₁ : ZMod.val (k₁.val : ZMod p) = k₁.val := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk₁_lt_p
  have h_val₂ : ZMod.val (k₂.val : ZMod p) = k₂.val := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk₂_lt_p
  have h_val_eq : k₁.val = k₂.val := by
    have := congrArg ZMod.val h_zmod_eq
    rw [h_val₁, h_val₂] at this
    exact this
  exact Subtype.ext h_val_eq

/-- If v = p - 1 and uv = -1 in ZMod p with u in [1, p-1], then u = 1. -/
lemma v_eq_pminus1_imp_u_eq_1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v = p - 1)
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) : u = 1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [hv, pminus1_eq_neg1 p] at huv
  have h1 : (u : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    have hmul : (u : ZMod p) * (-1) = -1 := huv
    calc (u : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) * (-1) * (-1) := by ring
      _ = (-1) * (-1) := by rw [hmul]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have h2 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
  have h3 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
    exact ZMod.val_one p
  rw [← h2, h1, h3]

/-- If u ∈ [2, p-1], then u - 1 ∈ [1, p-2], so (u-1 : ZMod p) is nonzero. -/
lemma u_minus1_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    ((u : ZMod p) - 1) ≠ 0 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  intro heq
  have h1 : (u : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    have hsub : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = 0 := heq
    calc (u : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) - 1 + 1 := by ring
      _ = 0 + 1 := by rw [hsub]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have h2 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
  have h3 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
    exact ZMod.val_one p
  have h4 : u = 1 := by rw [← h2, h1, h3]
  omega

/-- v ≤ p - 2 when u ≥ 2 and uv = -1. -/
lemma v_le_pminus2 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) : v ≤ p - 2 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hv
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hv_eq : v = p - 1 := by omega
  have hu_eq_1 : u = 1 := v_eq_pminus1_imp_u_eq_1 p u v hu hv_eq huv
  omega

/-- Key algebraic identity: If (u : ZMod p) * v = -1, then (u-1)⁻¹ + 1 = (v+1)⁻¹ in ZMod p. -/
lemma key_identity (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (_ : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ + 1 = ((v : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
  set a : ZMod p := (u : ZMod p) - 1 with ha_def
  set b : ZMod p := (v : ZMod p) + 1 with hb_def
  have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := u_minus1_ne_zero p u hu hu2
  have hab_rel : (a + 1) * (b - 1) = -1 := by
    simp only [ha_def, hb_def]
    ring_nf
    have hcast : ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) = ((u : ℕ) * (v : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast]
    have hcast2 : ((u : ℕ) * (v : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast2]
    exact huv
  have hab_eq : a * b = a - b := by
    have h : (a + 1) * (b - 1) = a * b - a + b - 1 := by ring
    rw [h] at hab_rel
    have h2 : a * b - a + b - 1 = -1 := hab_rel
    have h3 : a * b - a + b = 0 := by
      calc a * b - a + b = (a * b - a + b - 1) + 1 := by ring
        _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [h2]
        _ = 0 := by ring
    calc a * b = (a * b - a + b) + a - b := by ring
      _ = 0 + a - b := by rw [h3]
      _ = a - b := by ring
  have hb_formula : b * (1 + a) = a := by
    calc b * (1 + a) = b + a * b := by ring
      _ = b + (a - b) := by rw [hab_eq]
      _ = a := by ring
  have ha1_ne : a + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have : b * (1 + a) = b * 0 := by rw [add_comm, heq]
    simp only [mul_zero] at this
    rw [hb_formula] at this
    exact ha_ne this
  have hb_eq : b = a * (a + 1)⁻¹ := by
    calc b = b * (1 + a) * (1 + a)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by rw [add_comm]; exact ha1_ne), mul_one]
      _ = a * (1 + a)⁻¹ := by rw [hb_formula]
      _ = a * (a + 1)⁻¹ := by rw [add_comm]
  have hbinv : b⁻¹ = (a + 1) * a⁻¹ := by
    rw [hb_eq]
    rw [mul_inv, inv_inv]
    ring
  calc a⁻¹ + 1 = 1 + a⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = a⁻¹ * a + a⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha_ne]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (a + 1) := by ring
    _ = (a + 1) * a⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = b⁻¹ := by rw [← hbinv]

/-- The inverse of (u-1) in ZMod p has value in [1, p-2] when u ∈ [2, p-1]. -/
lemma inv_u_minus1_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ p - 2 := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have ha_ne : ((u : ZMod p) - 1) ≠ 0 := u_minus1_ne_zero p u (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) hu2
  have hinv_ne : ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero ha_ne
  have h_pos : 0 < k := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_lt : k < p := ZMod.val_lt (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
  constructor
  · exact h_pos
  ·
    by_contra h_eq
    push_neg at h_eq
    have hk_eq : k = p - 1 := by omega
    have h1 : ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) = p - 1 := hk_eq
    have h2 : ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ = -1 := by
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h1, val_neg1 p]
    have h3 : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = -1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (((u : ZMod p) - 1)), h2]
      simp
    have h4 : (u : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      calc (u : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1) + 1 := by ring
        _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [h3]
        _ = 0 := by ring
    have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
    have h5 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
    have h7 : u = 0 := by
      have h6 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = ZMod.val (0 : ZMod p) := by rw [h4]
      simp only [ZMod.val_zero] at h6
      rw [h5] at h6
      exact h6
    omega

/-- Verify that modInv p k + 1 = u when k = val((u-1)⁻¹). -/
lemma verify_first_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    modInv p k + 1 = u := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have h1 : (k : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hval : k = ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) := rfl
    rw [hval]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have h2 : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (u : ZMod p) - 1 := by
    rw [h1, inv_inv]
  have h3 : modInv p k = ZMod.val ((u : ZMod p) - 1) := by
    simp only [modInv]
    rw [h2]
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have hu_sub_lt : u - 1 < p := by omega
  have h4 : ZMod.val ((u : ZMod p) - 1) = u - 1 := by
    have hu_ge : 1 ≤ u := by omega
    have hcast : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = ((u - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R := ZMod p), ← Nat.cast_sub hu_ge]
    rw [hcast, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_sub_lt]
  rw [h3, h4]
  omega

/-- Verify that modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v when k = val((u-1)⁻¹). -/
lemma verify_second_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu hv
  have hv_le : v ≤ p - 2 := v_le_pminus2 p u v (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hv) huv hu2
  have hkey := key_identity p u v (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hv) huv hu2
  have h1 : (k : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hval : k = ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) := rfl
    rw [hval]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have h2 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((v : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p) + 1 := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast, h1, hkey]
  have h3 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (v : ZMod p) + 1 := by
    rw [h2, inv_inv]
  have h4 : modInv p (k + 1) = ZMod.val ((v : ZMod p) + 1) := by
    simp only [modInv]
    rw [h3]
  have hv1_lt : v + 1 < p := by omega
  have h5 : ZMod.val ((v : ZMod p) + 1) = v + 1 := by
    have hcast : (v : ZMod p) + 1 = ((v + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hv1_lt]
  rw [h4, h5]
  omega

/-- Every pair (u, v) with uv = -1 in [1, p-1]² and u ≥ 2 is in the image of the map
    k ↦ (modInv p k + 1, modInv p (k+1) - 1). -/
lemma phi_surjective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (_ : 3 < p) :
    ∀ u v : ℕ, u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) → v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) →
    (u : ZMod p) * v = -1 → 2 ≤ u →
    ∃ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), modInv p k + 1 = u ∧ modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v := by
  intro u v hu hv huv hu2
  let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
  use k
  have hk_range := inv_u_minus1_in_range p u hu hu2
  constructor
  · rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact hk_range
  constructor
  · exact verify_first_eq p u hu hu2
  · exact verify_second_eq p u v hu hv huv hu2

/-- Helper: φ(k) lands in [1, p-1]² for k ∈ [1, p-2]. -/
lemma phi_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    modInv p k + 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ∧ modInv p (k + 1) - 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) := by
  have hu := modInv_in_range_tight p k hk1 hk2
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
  constructor <;> omega

/-- Helper: φ(k) satisfies the hyperbola condition u * v = -1 as natural numbers cast to ZMod p. -/
lemma phi_satisfies_hyperbola (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((modInv p k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * (modInv p (k + 1) - 1 : ℕ) = -1 := by
  have h := hyperbola_identity p k hk1 hk2
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  have hv1 : 1 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) := by omega
  have hsub : ((modInv p (k + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p) - 1 = ((modInv p (k + 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hv1]
    simp only [Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hsub] at h
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h ⊢
  exact h

/-- The bijection lemma: The set of k in [1, p-2] with I(k+1) < I(k) has the same
    cardinality as the set of (u, v) with uv = -1 and u > v + 2 in [1, p-1]². -/
lemma descent_count_eq_hyperbola_count (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) | modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k} =
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2 + 2} := by
  apply Finset.card_bij
    (fun k _ => (modInv p k + 1, modInv p (k + 1) - 1))
  · intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_product] at hk ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, hdesc⟩ := hk
    have hrange := phi_in_range p k hk1 hk2
    have hhyp := phi_satisfies_hyperbola p k hk1 hk2
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hrange
    refine ⟨⟨hrange.1, hrange.2⟩, hhyp, ?_⟩
    rwa [descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 p k hk1 hk2] at hdesc
  · intro k1 hk1 k2 hk2 heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hk1 hk2
    have hinj := phi_injective p hp3
    have hk1_mem : k1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) := by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hk1.1
    have hk2_mem : k2 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) := by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hk2.1
    have : (⟨k1, hk1_mem⟩ : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)}) =
           (⟨k2, hk2_mem⟩ : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)}) := by
      apply hinj
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq ⊢
      exact heq
    simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
    exact this
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_product] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hu1, hu2⟩, ⟨hv1, hv2⟩⟩, hhyp, hgap⟩ := hx
    have hu_ge_2 : 2 ≤ x.1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk_mem, hk_eq⟩ := phi_surjective p hp3 x.1 x.2
      (by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨hu1, hu2⟩)
      (by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨hv1, hv2⟩)
      hhyp hu_ge_2
    use k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hk_mem ⊢
    refine ⟨⟨hk_mem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    ·
      rw [descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 p k hk_mem.1 hk_mem.2]
      rw [hk_eq.1, hk_eq.2]
      exact hgap
    ·
      ext <;> simp only [hk_eq.1, hk_eq.2]

/-- The equation x(x-1) = -1 in ZMod p is equivalent to (2x-1)² = -3.
    This comes from completing the square: x² - x + 1 = 0 iff 4(x² - x + 1) = 0
    iff (2x-1)² = -3. -/
lemma near_diag_eq_transform (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (x : ZMod p) :
    x * (x - 1) = -1 ↔ (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 = -3 := by
  have hp2 : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    omega
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : x * (x - 1) + 1 = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
    have h2 : x * x - x + 1 = 0 := by ring_nf; ring_nf at h1; exact h1
    calc (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 = 4 * x * x - 4 * x + 1 := by ring
      _ = 4 * (x * x - x + 1) - 3 := by ring
      _ = 4 * 0 - 3 := by rw [h2]
      _ = -3 := by ring
  · intro h
    have h2 : (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 + 3 = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
    have h3 : 4 * (x * x - x + 1) = 0 := by calc
      4 * (x * x - x + 1) = (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 + 3 := by ring
      _ = 0 := h2
    have h4 : (4 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq]
      intro hf
      rw [show (4 : ZMod p) = 2 * 2 by ring] at hf
      have := mul_eq_zero.mp hf
      simp only [hp2, or_self] at this
    have h5 : x * x - x + 1 = 0 := by
      have := mul_eq_zero.mp (by rw [h3] : 4 * (x * x - x + 1) = 0)
      simp only [h4, false_or] at this
      exact this
    calc x * (x - 1) = x * x - x := by ring
      _ = -1 + (x * x - x + 1) := by ring
      _ = -1 + 0 := by rw [h5]
      _ = -1 := by ring

name: Lambda.LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv_eraseMetadata_congr
statement:
/-- `substFvarsFromEnv` preserves `eraseMetadata` equality. -/
theorem LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv_eraseMetadata_congr
    {T : LExprParams} [DecidableEq T.IDMeta]
    (env : Env T) (e₁ e₂ : LExpr T.mono)
    (h : e₁.eraseMetadata = e₂.eraseMetadata) :
    (LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv env e₁).eraseMetadata =
    (LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv env e₂).eraseMetadata
src:
/-- `substFvarsFromEnv` preserves `eraseMetadata` equality. -/
theorem LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv_eraseMetadata_congr
    {T : LExprParams} [DecidableEq T.IDMeta]
    (env : Env T) (e₁ e₂ : LExpr T.mono)
    (h : e₁.eraseMetadata = e₂.eraseMetadata) :
    (LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv env e₁).eraseMetadata =
    (LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv env e₂).eraseMetadata := by
  induction e₁ generalizing e₂ with
  | const m c =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    injection h; subst_vars; rfl
  | op m n t =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    injection h; subst_vars; rfl
  | bvar m i =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    injection h; subst_vars; rfl
  | fvar m x ty =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂; injection h with _ h_x h_ty; subst h_x h_ty
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv]
    split <;> (first | rfl | simp [LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata])
  | abs m n t b ih =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂ n₂ t₂ b₂; injection h with _ hn ht hb; subst hn ht
    have hb' : b.eraseMetadata = b₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hb
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv, LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata]
    congr 1; exact ih b₂ hb'
  | quant m qk n ty tr b ih_tr ih_b =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂ qk₂ n₂ ty₂ tr₂ b₂; injection h with _ hqk hn hty htr hb; subst hqk hn hty
    have htr' : tr.eraseMetadata = tr₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact htr
    have hb' : b.eraseMetadata = b₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hb
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv, LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata]
    congr 1
    · exact ih_tr tr₂ htr'
    · exact ih_b b₂ hb'
  | app m f a ihf iha =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂ f₂ a₂; injection h with _ hf ha
    have hf' : f.eraseMetadata = f₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hf
    have ha' : a.eraseMetadata = a₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact ha
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv, LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata]
    congr 1
    · exact ihf f₂ hf'
    · exact iha a₂ ha'
  | eq m l r ihl ihr =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂ l₂ r₂; injection h with _ hl hr
    have hl' : l.eraseMetadata = l₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hl
    have hr' : r.eraseMetadata = r₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hr
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv, LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata]
    congr 1
    · exact ihl l₂ hl'
    · exact ihr r₂ hr'
  | ite m c t f ihc iht ihf =>
    cases e₂ <;> delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata at h <;> try contradiction
    rename_i m₂ c₂ t₂ f₂; injection h with _ hc ht hf
    have hc' : c.eraseMetadata = c₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hc
    have ht' : t.eraseMetadata = t₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact ht
    have hf' : f.eraseMetadata = f₂.eraseMetadata := by delta LExpr.eraseMetadata LExpr.replaceMetadata; exact hf
    simp only [LExpr.substFvarsFromEnv, LExpr.eraseMetadata, LExpr.replaceMetadata]
    exact congr (congr (congrArg _ (ihc c₂ hc')) (iht t₂ ht')) (ihf f₂ hf')

name: ProximityGap.BW_homMatrix_det_submatrix_natDegree_le_e_add_one
statement:
open scoped BigOperators in
open Polynomial in
open Matrix in
theorem BW_homMatrix_det_submatrix_natDegree_le_e_add_one {F : Type} [Field F] {ι : Type}
    [Fintype ι] (e k : ℕ) (ωs : ι → F) (f0 f1 : ι → F)
    (r : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)) → ι) :
    (Matrix.det
        (Matrix.submatrix
          (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k
            (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
            (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (f1 i)))
          r id)).natDegree ≤ e + 1
src:
open scoped BigOperators in
open Polynomial in
open Matrix in
theorem BW_homMatrix_det_submatrix_natDegree_le_e_add_one {F : Type} [Field F] {ι : Type}
    [Fintype ι] (e k : ℕ) (ωs : ι → F) (f0 f1 : ι → F)
    (r : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)) → ι) :
    (Matrix.det
        (Matrix.submatrix
          (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k
            (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
            (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (f1 i)))
          r id)).natDegree ≤ e + 1 := by
  classical
  -- Name the matrices to keep subsequent expressions manageable.
  let M : Matrix ι (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k))) F[X] :=
    BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
      (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (f1 i))
  let A : Matrix (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k))) (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k))) F[X] :=
    Matrix.submatrix M r id
  change (Matrix.det A).natDegree ≤ e + 1
  -- Expand determinant as a sum over permutations.
  rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  refine
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
        (s :=
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k))))))
        (f := fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k))) =>
          Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
            ∏ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), A (σ i) i)
        (n := e + 1) ?_)
  intro σ hσ
  -- The permutation sign is a unit (±1), so it does not increase natDegree.
  have hsign :
      (Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
            ∏ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), A (σ i) i).natDegree ≤
        (∏ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), A (σ i) i).natDegree := by
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) with hs | hs <;> simp [hs]
  -- Degree of a product is bounded by the sum of degrees.
  have hprod :
      (∏ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), A (σ i) i).natDegree ≤
        ∑ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), (A (σ i) i).natDegree := by
    simpa using
      (Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)))))
        (f := fun i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)) => A (σ i) i))
  -- Only the first `e+1` columns can contribute degree (and each contributes at most 1).
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), (A (σ i) i).natDegree) ≤ e + 1 := by
    have hpoint :
        ∀ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)),
          (A (σ i) i).natDegree ≤ ite (i.1 < e + 1) (1 : ℕ) 0 := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i.1 < e + 1
      · -- In the first `e+1` columns, each entry has natDegree ≤ 1.
        have hle1 :
            (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
                (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (f1 i))
                (r (σ i)) i).natDegree ≤ 1 :=
          BW_homMatrix_entry_natDegree_le_one (ι := ι) (F := F) e k ωs f0 f1
            (r (σ i)) i
        simpa [A, M, Matrix.submatrix, hi] using hle1
      · -- After column `e+1`, the entry is constant in `X`, hence natDegree = 0.
        have hi' : e + 1 ≤ i.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hi
        have hzero :
            (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
                (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.C (f1 i) * Polynomial.X)
                (r (σ i)) i).natDegree = 0 :=
          BW_homMatrix_entry_natDegree_eq_zero_of_ge_comm (ι := ι) (F := F) e k ωs
            f0 f1 (r (σ i)) i hi'
        have hzero' :
            (BW_homMatrix (ι := ι) e k (fun i => (Polynomial.C (ωs i) : F[X]))
                (fun i => Polynomial.C (f0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (f1 i))
                (r (σ i)) i).natDegree = 0 := by
          -- For these columns, the definition of `BW_homMatrix` ignores the input `f`.
          simpa [BW_homMatrix, Nat.not_lt_of_ge hi'] using hzero
        have hA : (A (σ i) i).natDegree = 0 := by
          simpa [A, M, Matrix.submatrix] using hzero'
        simp [hi, hA]
    have hle :
        (∑ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), (A (σ i) i).natDegree)
          ≤
          ∑ i : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)), ite (i.1 < e + 1) (1 : ℕ) 0 := by
      simpa using
        (Finset.sum_le_sum
          (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)))))
          (fun i _ => hpoint i))
    -- `simp` rewrites this indicator sum into a cardinality, so rewrite the axiom the same way.
    have hcard :
        (#{x : Fin ((e + 1) + (e + k)) | (x.1 : ℕ) ≤ e} : ℕ) = e + 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using Fin_sum_ite_lt_e_add_one e k
    -- Conclude.
    simpa [hcard] using hle
  -- Assemble the inequalities.
  exact le_trans hsign (le_trans hprod hsum)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_layerConj_le_multi
statement:
/-- **Multi-jump flow through one layer.** For an arbitrary operator `O`, the high-weight norm
above rung `m` after a disjoint-support layer is at most its value before the layer, plus the
`j`-jump inflows `ε_j^{(m)}` from the positive rungs `m - j`, plus the entry factor `E_m` times
the Pauli norm of `O`. This derives the recurrence of `apd:rmk:multijump` from
`apd:thm:layer_inflow`: jumps with `j < m` are localized on rung `m - j`, and the finitely many
jumps with `j ≥ m` are bounded by the full norm and then by the infinite sum `E_m`. -/
theorem highNorm_layerConj_le_multi (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ)) {ko kh m : ℕ}
    (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hL : IsLayer kh (L.map Prod.fst))
    (hherm : ∀ g ∈ L, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsin : ∀ g ∈ L, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ a) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hb : betaOf (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a < 1)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (layerConj L O) ≤
      highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O +
        (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
          highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O) +
        entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a m * pauliNorm O
src:
/-- **Multi-jump flow through one layer.** For an arbitrary operator `O`, the high-weight norm
above rung `m` after a disjoint-support layer is at most its value before the layer, plus the
`j`-jump inflows `ε_j^{(m)}` from the positive rungs `m - j`, plus the entry factor `E_m` times
the Pauli norm of `O`. This derives the recurrence of `apd:rmk:multijump` from
`apd:thm:layer_inflow`: jumps with `j < m` are localized on rung `m - j`, and the finitely many
jumps with `j ≥ m` are bounded by the full norm and then by the infinite sum `E_m`. -/
theorem highNorm_layerConj_le_multi (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ)) {ko kh m : ℕ}
    (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hL : IsLayer kh (L.map Prod.fst))
    (hherm : ∀ g ∈ L, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsin : ∀ g ∈ L, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ a) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hb : betaOf (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a < 1)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (layerConj L O) ≤
      highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O +
        (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
          highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O) +
        entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a m * pauliNorm O := by
  have hkh1 : (0 : ℝ) < (kh - 1 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < kh - 1)
  have hc : 0 ≤ (ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ) := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hkh1.le
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
    ‖Lean4LPD.clm (layerInflowMatrix L (rungWeight ko kh m) j) (coeffVec O)‖
  have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by
    simp [f, layerInflowMatrix_zero, Lean4LPD.clm]
  have hfnonneg (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ f j := norm_nonneg _
  have hsmall (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Ico 1 m) :
      f j ≤ epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
        highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O := by
    have hj' := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hj
    have h := norm_layerInflowMatrix_clm_le_restr L hL ha hsin
      (rungWeight_sub_jump ko kh m j hj'.2).le (coeffVec O)
    rw [layer_factor_eq_epsJump hkh hm] at h
    exact h
  have hlarge (j : ℕ) :
      f j ≤ epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m * pauliNorm O := by
    have h := norm_layerInflowMatrix_clm_le L hL ha hsin
      (rungWeight ko kh m) j (coeffVec O)
    rw [layer_factor_eq_epsJump hkh hm, norm_coeffVec] at h
    exact h
  let K := max m (L.length + 1)
  have hmK : m ≤ K := le_max_left _ _
  have hlenK : L.length + 1 ≤ K := le_max_right _ _
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ range (L.length + 1), f j) ≤
      (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
        highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O) +
      entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a m * pauliNorm O := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ range (L.length + 1), f j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ range K, f j :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hlenK)
          (fun j _ _ => hfnonneg j)
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, f j) + ∑ j ∈ Ico m K, f j := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_eq_add_Ico f (by omega), hf0, zero_add,
          ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive f hm hmK]
      _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
          highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O) +
          ∑ j ∈ Ico m K, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
            pauliNorm O :=
        add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum hsmall) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hlarge j)
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        exact add_le_add le_rfl
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (sum_Ico_epsJump_le_entryFactor hkh1 hc ha hm hb K) (pauliNorm_nonneg O))
  calc
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (layerConj L O) =
        ‖restr (highSet n (rungWeight ko kh m)) (layerAct L (coeffVec O))‖ := by
      rw [highNorm, coeffVec_layerConj L hherm]
    _ ≤ highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O + ∑ j ∈ range (L.length + 1), f j :=
      norm_restr_layerAct_le_sum_inflow L hherm _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have h := add_le_add (le_refl (highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O)) hsum
      simpa only [add_assoc] using h

name: neighbor_iff_diff_in_set
statement:
/-- Translation between the cyclic neighbor condition (using mod arithmetic)
    and the |i - j| condition (using subtraction of Fin values).
    For i ≤ j in Fin 2025, j.val - i.val ∈ {0, 1, 2024} iff
    j = i, or j = i + 1 (not wrapping), or j.val - i.val = 2024 (i = 0, j = 2024). -/
lemma neighbor_iff_diff_in_set (i j : Fin 2025) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ)) ↔
    (i = j ∨ j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025)
src:
/-- Translation between the cyclic neighbor condition (using mod arithmetic)
    and the |i - j| condition (using subtraction of Fin values).
    For i ≤ j in Fin 2025, j.val - i.val ∈ {0, 1, 2024} iff
    j = i, or j = i + 1 (not wrapping), or j.val - i.val = 2024 (i = 0, j = 2024). -/
lemma neighbor_iff_diff_in_set (i j : Fin 2025) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ)) ↔
    (i = j ∨ j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
  have h_main : (j.val - i.val = 0 ∨ j.val - i.val = 1 ∨ j.val - i.val = 2024) ↔ (i = j ∨ j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
    constructor
    ·
      intro h
      rcases h with (h | h | h)
      ·
        have h₄ : i.val = j.val := by
          omega
        have h₅ : i = j := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp_all [Fin.ext_iff]
        exact Or.inl h₅
      ·
        have h₄ : j.val = i.val + 1 := by
          have h₄₃ : j.val = i.val + 1 := by
            omega
          exact h₄₃
        have h₅ : j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 := by
          have h₅₂ : (i.val + 1) % 2025 = i.val + 1 := by
            have h₅₃ : i.val + 1 < 2025 := by omega
            rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h₅₃]
          rw [h₄, h₅₂]
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₅)
      ·
        have h₄ : j.val = i.val + 2024 := by
          have h₄₃ : j.val = i.val + 2024 := by
            omega
          exact h₄₃
        have h₅ : i.val = 0 := by
          omega
        have h₆ : j.val = 2024 := by
          omega
        have h₇ : j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025 := by
          rw [h₅] at *
          norm_num [h₆] at *
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr h₇)
    ·
      intro h
      rcases h with (h | h | h)
      ·
        have h₅ : j.val - i.val = 0 := by
          omega
        exact Or.inl h₅
      ·
        have h₅ : i.val < 2024 := by
          by_contra h₅
          omega
        have h₆ : (i.val + 1) % 2025 = i.val + 1 := by
          have h₆₁ : i.val + 1 < 2025 := by omega
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h₆₁]
        have h₈ : j.val - i.val = 1 := by
          omega
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₈)
      ·
        have h₄ : j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025 := h
        have h₅ : i.val = 0 := by
          by_contra h₅
          have h₅₁ : i.val > 0 := by
            omega
          have h₅₂ : (i.val + 2024) % 2025 = i.val - 1 := by
            have h₅₃ : i.val + 2024 = 2025 + (i.val - 1) := by
              omega
            rw [h₅₃]
            have h₅₄ : (2025 + (i.val - 1)) % 2025 = (i.val - 1) % 2025 := by
              simp [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2025 < 2025 + (i.val - 1))]
            rw [h₅₄]
            have h₅₅ : i.val - 1 < 2025 := by
              omega
            rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h₅₅]
          omega
        have h₆ : j.val = 2024 := by
          rw [h₄]
          rw [h₅]
        have h₇ : j.val - i.val = 2024 := by
          rw [h₆, h₅]
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr h₇)

  have h_final : (j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ)) ↔ (i = j ∨ j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
    have h₁ : (j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ)) ↔ (j.val - i.val = 0 ∨ j.val - i.val = 1 ∨ j.val - i.val = 2024) := by
      simp [Set.mem_insert, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rw [h₁]
    exact h_main

  exact h_final
