import Mathlib

open Matrix

abbrev putnam_2025_a4_solution : ℕ := 3

/-- A 2×2 matrix is non-scalar iff it has a nonzero off-diagonal entry or distinct diagonal entries -/
lemma not_scalar_iff (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    (¬∃ c : ℝ, X = c • 1) ↔ (X 0 1 ≠ 0 ∨ X 1 0 ≠ 0 ∨ X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply h
    use X 0 0
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [smul_apply, one_apply, hcon.1, hcon.2.1, hcon.2.2]
  · intro h ⟨c, hc⟩
    have hc' := fun i j => congr_fun (congr_fun hc i) j
    simp only [smul_apply, one_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] at hc'
    rcases h with h01 | h10 | hdiag
    · have := hc' 0 1; simp at this; exact h01 this
    · have := hc' 1 0; simp at this; exact h10 this
    · have h00 := hc' 0 0
      have h11 := hc' 1 1
      simp only [↓reduceIte, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h00 h11
      rw [h00, h11] at hdiag
      exact hdiag rfl

/-- Key algebraic identity: y₀₁ · z₁₀ = z₀₁ · y₁₀ when Y and Z both commute with X and x₀₁ ≠ 0 -/
lemma off_diag_commute_case_x01_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (condY1 : X 0 1 * Y 1 0 = Y 0 1 * X 1 0)
    (condZ1 : X 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * X 1 0) :
    Y 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * Y 1 0 := by
  have h : X 0 1 * (Y 0 1 * Z 1 0) = X 0 1 * (Z 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by
    calc X 0 1 * (Y 0 1 * Z 1 0)
        = Y 0 1 * (X 0 1 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 0 1 * (Z 0 1 * X 1 0) := by rw [condZ1]
      _ = Z 0 1 * (Y 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * (X 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by rw [condY1]
      _ = X 0 1 * (Z 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX01 h

/-- Key algebraic identity: (y₀₀ - y₁₁) · z₀₁ = (z₀₀ - z₁₁) · y₀₁ when Y and Z both commute with X and x₀₁ ≠ 0 -/
lemma diag_diff_commute_01_case_x01_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (condY2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condZ2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1) :
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1 := by
  have h : X 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1) = X 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by
    calc X 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1)
        = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (X 0 1 * Z 0 1) := by ring
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (Z 0 1 * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by rw [condY2]
      _ = Y 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Y 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1) := by rw [condZ2]
      _ = X 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX01 h

/-- Key algebraic identity: (y₀₀ - y₁₁) · z₁₀ = (z₀₀ - z₁₁) · y₁₀ when Y and Z both commute with X and x₀₁ ≠ 0 -/
lemma diag_diff_commute_10_case_x01_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (condY2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0)
    (condZ2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condZ3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) :
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0 := by
  have h : X 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0) = X 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by
    calc X 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0)
        = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (X 0 1 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (Z 1 0 * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by rw [condY2]
      _ = Y 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) := by rw [condZ3]
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (Y 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (X 1 0 * Y 0 1) := by ring
      _ = X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by ring
      _ = X 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1) := by
          have h01 := diag_diff_commute_01_case_x01_ne_zero X Y Z hX01 condY2 condZ2
          rw [h01]
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (X 1 0 * Z 0 1) := by ring
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (Z 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by rw [condY3]
      _ = Y 1 0 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1) := by ring
      _ = Y 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1) := by rw [condZ2]
      _ = X 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX01 h

/-- Analogous lemmas for x₁₀ ≠ 0 case -/
lemma off_diag_commute_case_x10_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0)
    (condY1 : X 0 1 * Y 1 0 = Y 0 1 * X 1 0)
    (condZ1 : X 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * X 1 0) :
    Y 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * Y 1 0 := by
  have h : X 1 0 * (Y 0 1 * Z 1 0) = X 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by
    calc X 1 0 * (Y 0 1 * Z 1 0)
        = Y 0 1 * (X 1 0 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 0 1 * (Z 1 0 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * (Y 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * (X 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by rw [condY1]
      _ = X 0 1 * (Z 1 0 * Y 1 0) := by ring
      _ = X 0 1 * (Y 1 0 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 1 0 * (X 0 1 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * X 1 0) := by rw [condZ1]
      _ = X 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX10 h

lemma diag_diff_commute_01_case_x10_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0)
    (condY1 : X 0 1 * Y 1 0 = Y 0 1 * X 1 0)
    (condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0)
    (condZ1 : X 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * X 1 0)
    (condZ3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) :
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1 := by
  have auxZ : X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1) = X 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * (X 0 0 - X 1 1)) := by
    calc X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1)
        = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (X 1 0 * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (X 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = X 0 1 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = X 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0) := by rw [condZ3]
      _ = (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * (X 0 1 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * (Z 0 1 * X 1 0) := by rw [condZ1]
      _ = X 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * (X 0 0 - X 1 1)) := by ring
  have condZ_01 : (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1 = Z 0 1 * (X 0 0 - X 1 1) := mul_left_cancel₀ hX10 auxZ
  have h : X 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1) = X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by
    calc X 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1)
        = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (X 1 0 * Z 0 1) := by ring
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (Z 0 1 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 0 1 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by rw [condY3]
      _ = Y 1 0 * (Z 0 1 * (X 0 0 - X 1 1)) := by ring
      _ = Y 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1) := by rw [condZ_01]
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (Y 1 0 * X 0 1) := by ring
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (X 0 1 * Y 1 0) := by ring
      _ = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * (Y 0 1 * X 1 0) := by rw [condY1]
      _ = X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX10 h

lemma diag_diff_commute_10_case_x10_ne_zero
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0)
    (condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0)
    (condZ3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) :
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0 := by
  have h : X 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0) = X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by
    calc X 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0)
        = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (X 1 0 * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * (Z 1 0 * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * ((Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Z 1 0 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by rw [condY3]
      _ = Y 1 0 * ((X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0) := by ring
      _ = Y 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) := by rw [condZ3]
      _ = X 1 0 * ((Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0) := by ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hX10 h

/-- In the diagonal case with distinct eigenvalues, off-diagonal entries of commuting matrices are zero -/
lemma off_diag_zero_of_commute_with_diagonal
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX01 : X 0 1 = 0) (hX10 : X 1 0 = 0) (hXdiag : X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1)
    (condY2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0) :
    Y 0 1 = 0 ∧ Y 1 0 = 0 := by
  constructor
  ·
    rw [hX01] at condY2
    simp only [mul_zero] at condY2
    have h : X 0 0 - X 1 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hXdiag
    exact mul_eq_zero.mp condY2 |>.resolve_left h
  ·
    rw [hX10] at condY3
    simp only [mul_zero] at condY3
    have h : X 0 0 - X 1 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hXdiag
    exact mul_eq_zero.mp condY3 |>.resolve_left h

/-- All identities for diagonal case -/
lemma commute_case_diagonal
    (X Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hX01 : X 0 1 = 0) (hX10 : X 1 0 = 0) (hXdiag : X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1)
    (condY2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0)
    (condZ2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1)
    (condZ3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0) :
    Y 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * Y 1 0 ∧
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1 ∧
    (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0 := by
  have ⟨hY01, hY10⟩ := off_diag_zero_of_commute_with_diagonal X Y hX01 hX10 hXdiag condY2 condY3
  have ⟨hZ01, hZ10⟩ := off_diag_zero_of_commute_with_diagonal X Z hX01 hX10 hXdiag condZ2 condZ3
  simp [hY01, hY10, hZ01, hZ10]

/-- When all key algebraic conditions hold, Y*Z = Z*Y -/
lemma YZ_eq_ZY_of_conditions
    (Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (h1 : Y 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * Y 1 0)
    (h2 : (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 0 1)
    (h3 : (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * Y 1 0) :
    Y * Z = Z * Y := by
  ext i j
  simp only [mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  ·
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue]
    linarith
  ·
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue]
    linarith
  ·
    simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue]
    linarith
  ·
    simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue]
    linarith

/-- The main theorem: centralizer of a non-scalar 2×2 matrix is commutative -/
lemma centralizer_of_nonscalar_2x2_is_commutative
    (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hX : ¬∃ c : ℝ, X = c • 1)
    (Y Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hY : X * Y = Y * X) (hZ : X * Z = Z * X) :
    Y * Z = Z * Y := by
  rw [not_scalar_iff] at hX
  have hY' := fun i j => congr_fun (congr_fun hY i) j
  have hZ' := fun i j => congr_fun (congr_fun hZ i) j
  simp only [mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue] at hY' hZ'
  have condY1 : X 0 1 * Y 1 0 = Y 0 1 * X 1 0 := by linarith [hY' 0 0]
  have condY2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 0 1 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 0 1 := by ring_nf; linarith [hY' 0 1]
  have condY3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Y 1 0 = (Y 0 0 - Y 1 1) * X 1 0 := by ring_nf; linarith [hY' 1 0]
  have condZ1 : X 0 1 * Z 1 0 = Z 0 1 * X 1 0 := by linarith [hZ' 0 0]
  have condZ2 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 0 1 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 0 1 := by ring_nf; linarith [hZ' 0 1]
  have condZ3 : (X 0 0 - X 1 1) * Z 1 0 = (Z 0 0 - Z 1 1) * X 1 0 := by ring_nf; linarith [hZ' 1 0]
  apply YZ_eq_ZY_of_conditions
  ·
    by_cases hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0
    · exact off_diag_commute_case_x01_ne_zero X Y Z hX01 condY1 condZ1
    · by_cases hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0
      · exact off_diag_commute_case_x10_ne_zero X Y Z hX10 condY1 condZ1
      · push_neg at hX01 hX10
        have hXdiag : X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1 := by tauto
        exact (commute_case_diagonal X Y Z hX01 hX10 hXdiag condY2 condY3 condZ2 condZ3).1
  ·
    by_cases hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0
    · exact diag_diff_commute_01_case_x01_ne_zero X Y Z hX01 condY2 condZ2
    · by_cases hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0
      · exact diag_diff_commute_01_case_x10_ne_zero X Y Z hX10 condY1 condY3 condZ1 condZ3
      · push_neg at hX01 hX10
        have hXdiag : X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1 := by tauto
        exact (commute_case_diagonal X Y Z hX01 hX10 hXdiag condY2 condY3 condZ2 condZ3).2.1
  ·
    by_cases hX01 : X 0 1 ≠ 0
    · exact diag_diff_commute_10_case_x01_ne_zero X Y Z hX01 condY2 condY3 condZ2 condZ3
    · by_cases hX10 : X 1 0 ≠ 0
      · exact diag_diff_commute_10_case_x10_ne_zero X Y Z hX10 condY3 condZ3
      · push_neg at hX01 hX10
        have hXdiag : X 0 0 ≠ X 1 1 := by tauto
        exact (commute_case_diagonal X Y Z hX01 hX10 hXdiag condY2 condY3 condZ2 condZ3).2.2

/-- In any proposed solution with k = 2, every matrix must be non-scalar
    (since scalar matrices commute with everything, violating the "only if" direction).
    But then if A_i commutes with both A_{i-1} and A_{i+1}, then A_{i-1} and A_{i+1}
    must commute (by the centralizer lemma). This contradicts the requirement that
    non-adjacent pairs don't commute.

    Specifically: for n = 2025, we need A₁ and A₃ to NOT commute (since |1-3| = 2 ∉ {0,1,2024}),
    but A₂ commutes with both A₁ and A₃, so by centralizer commutativity A₁ and A₃ must commute. -/
lemma no_solution_for_k_eq_2 :
    ¬∃ A : Fin 2025 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
      ∀ i j : Fin 2025, i ≤ j →
        (A i * A j = A j * A i ↔ j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ)) := by
  intro ⟨A, hA⟩

  have h02 : ¬Commute (A 0) (A 2) := by
    have : ¬(A 0 * A 2 = A 2 * A 0) := by
      intro heq
      have := (hA 0 2 (by decide : (0 : Fin 2025) ≤ 2)).mp heq
      simp at this
    exact this

  have h12 : Commute (A 1) (A 2) := by
    have := (hA 1 2 (by decide : (1 : Fin 2025) ≤ 2)).mpr (by decide : (2 : ℕ) - 1 ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ))
    exact this

  have h23 : Commute (A 2) (A 3) := by
    have := (hA 2 3 (by decide : (2 : Fin 2025) ≤ 3)).mpr (by decide : (3 : ℕ) - 2 ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ))
    exact this

  have h13_not : ¬Commute (A 1) (A 3) := by
    have : ¬(A 1 * A 3 = A 3 * A 1) := by
      intro heq
      have := (hA 1 3 (by decide : (1 : Fin 2025) ≤ 3)).mp heq
      simp at this
    exact this

  have hA2_nonscalar : ¬∃ c : ℝ, A 2 = c • 1 := by
    intro hscalar
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hscalar
    have : Commute (A 0) (A 2) := by
      rw [hc]
      unfold Commute SemiconjBy
      ext i j
      simp only [mul_apply, smul_apply, one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> ring
    exact h02 this

  have h13 : Commute (A 1) (A 3) := by
    unfold Commute SemiconjBy
    exact centralizer_of_nonscalar_2x2_is_commutative (A 2) hA2_nonscalar (A 1) (A 3) h12.eq.symm h23.eq

  exact h13_not h13

/-- Any k in the solution set must satisfy k ≥ 3.
    This follows from no_solution_for_k_eq_1 and no_solution_for_k_eq_2. -/
lemma three_le_of_mem_solution_set (k : ℕ)
    (hk : ∃ A : Fin 2025 → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ,
      ∀ i j : Fin 2025, i ≤ j →
        (A i * A j = A j * A i ↔ j.val - i.val ∈ ({0, 1, 2024} : Set ℕ))) :
    3 ≤ k := by
  by_contra h
  interval_cases k
  · obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hk
    have h02 : (0 : Fin 2025) ≤ (2 : Fin 2025) := by decide
    have hcomm : A 0 * A 2 = A 2 * A 0 := by ext i j; fin_cases i
    specialize hA 0 2 h02
    rw [hA] at hcomm
    simp at hcomm
  · obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hk
    have h02 : (0 : Fin 2025) ≤ (2 : Fin 2025) := by decide
    have hcomm : A 0 * A 2 = A 2 * A 0 := by
      ext i j; fin_cases i; fin_cases j
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]; ring
    specialize hA 0 2 h02
    rw [hA] at hcomm
    simp at hcomm
  · exact no_solution_for_k_eq_2 hk

/-- The vector u_m = (m², m, 1) on the moment curve. We use m as a natural number
    and coerce to ℝ. These vectors are in "homogeneous coordinates" for points
    on the parabola y = x² in the projective plane. -/
def momentVector (m : ℕ) : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![((m : ℝ)^2), (m : ℝ), 1]

/-- For index i in Fin 2025, we define the "neighbor cross product"
    w_i = u_{i-1} ×₃ u_{i+1} where indices are taken cyclically.
    Here we use i.val with arithmetic mod 2025 to handle the cyclic structure. -/
def neighborCrossProduct (i : Fin 2025) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  let prev := (i.val + 2024) % 2025
  let next := (i.val + 1) % 2025
  crossProduct (momentVector prev) (momentVector next)

/-- The matrix A_i = u_i ⊗ w_i (outer product), which is a rank-one 3×3 matrix.
    We use vecMulVec for the outer product: (vecMulVec u w) i j = u i * w j. -/
def constructedMatrix (i : Fin 2025) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  vecMulVec (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct i)

/-- The Vandermonde determinant for three values a, b, c equals (a-b)(a-c)(b-c).
    Applied to our moment vectors: det [u_a, u_b, u_c] = (a-b)(a-c)(b-c)
    where u_m = (m², m, 1).

    This uses the fact that the matrix with rows (a², a, 1), (b², b, 1), (c², c, 1)
    has determinant equal to the Vandermonde determinant (with appropriate sign/order). -/
lemma vandermonde_det_momentVectors (a b c : ℕ) :
    det ![momentVector a, momentVector b, momentVector c] =
    ((a : ℝ) - b) * ((a : ℝ) - c) * ((b : ℝ) - c) := by
  have h₀ : det ![momentVector a, momentVector b, momentVector c] =
    ((a : ℝ)^2 * ( (b : ℝ) - (c : ℝ))) -
    ((b : ℝ)^2 * ( (a : ℝ) - (c : ℝ))) +
    ((c : ℝ)^2 * ( (a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ))) := by
    simp [det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, momentVector, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    ring_nf

  have h₂ : det ![momentVector a, momentVector b, momentVector c] =
    ((a : ℝ) - b) * ((a : ℝ) - c) * ((b : ℝ) - c) := by
    rw [h₀]
    linarith

  rw [h₂]

/-- The triple product u_j ⬝ᵥ (u_{i-1} ×₃ u_{i+1}) equals det [u_j, u_{i-1}, u_{i+1}].
    By Vandermonde, this is (j - (i-1)) * (j - (i+1)) * ((i-1) - (i+1)) =
    (j - i + 1) * (j - i - 1) * (-2) = -2 * (j - i + 1) * (j - i - 1).
    This is zero iff j = i-1 or j = i+1 (cyclically). -/
lemma tripleProduct_neighborCross (i j : Fin 2025) :
    momentVector j.val ⬝ᵥ neighborCrossProduct i =
    det ![momentVector j.val, momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025),
          momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)] := by
  have h_general : ∀ (v₁ v₂ v₃ : Fin 3 → ℝ), v₁ ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct v₂ v₃) = det ![v₁, v₂, v₃] := by
    intro v₁ v₂ v₃
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero]
    simp [crossProduct, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring_nf

  have h_main : momentVector j.val ⬝ᵥ neighborCrossProduct i = det ![momentVector j.val, momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025), momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)] := by
    dsimp [neighborCrossProduct]
    have h₁ : (momentVector j.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) = det ![momentVector j.val, momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025), momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)] := by
      apply h_general
    simpa using h₁

  apply h_main

/-- The cyclic predecessor and successor of any index are distinct.
    That is, (i + 2024) % 2025 ≠ (i + 1) % 2025 for all i < 2025. -/
lemma prev_ne_next (i : Fin 2025) :
    (i.val + 2024) % 2025 ≠ (i.val + 1) % 2025 := by
  have hi : i.val < 2025 := i.isLt
  omega

/-- The triple product is zero iff j is a cyclic neighbor of i.
    For 0 ≤ i, j < 2025, this means j = (i + 1) % 2025 or j = (i + 2024) % 2025. -/
lemma tripleProduct_eq_zero_iff_neighbor (i j : Fin 2025) :
    momentVector j.val ⬝ᵥ neighborCrossProduct i = 0 ↔
    (j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
  rw [tripleProduct_neighborCross]
  rw [vandermonde_det_momentVectors]
  set prev := (i.val + 2024) % 2025 with hprev
  set next := (i.val + 1) % 2025 with hnext
  have h_prev_ne_next : (prev : ℝ) ≠ next := by
    intro h
    have h2 : prev = next := Nat.cast_injective h
    exact prev_ne_next i h2
  constructor
  ·
    intro h
    have h_mul : ((j.val : ℝ) - prev) * ((j.val : ℝ) - next) * ((prev : ℝ) - next) = 0 := h
    rw [mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h_mul
    rcases h_mul with ((h1 | h2) | h3)
    ·
      right
      have : (j.val : ℝ) = prev := sub_eq_zero.mp h1
      exact Nat.cast_injective this
    ·
      left
      have : (j.val : ℝ) = next := sub_eq_zero.mp h2
      exact Nat.cast_injective this
    ·
      exfalso
      exact h_prev_ne_next (sub_eq_zero.mp h3)
  ·
    intro h
    rcases h with h_next | h_prev
    ·
      have h2 : (j.val : ℝ) = next := by
        rw [h_next]
      rw [h2]
      ring
    ·
      have h2 : (j.val : ℝ) = prev := by
        rw [h_prev]
      rw [h2]
      ring

/-- The product of two rank-one matrices follows the formula:
    (u ⊗ w) * (v ⊗ z) = (w ⬝ᵥ v) • (u ⊗ z)
    where ⊗ denotes outer product (vecMulVec). -/
lemma rankOne_mul_rankOne (u w v z : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec u w * vecMulVec v z = (w ⬝ᵥ v) • vecMulVec u z := by
  have h_main : ∀ (i j : Fin 3), (vecMulVec u w * vecMulVec v z) i j = ((w ⬝ᵥ v) • vecMulVec u z) i j := by
    intro i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, vecMulVec, Matrix.smul_apply]
    simp [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    ring_nf

  have h_final : vecMulVec u w * vecMulVec v z = (w ⬝ᵥ v) • vecMulVec u z := by
    apply Matrix.ext
    intro i j
    apply h_main

  exact h_final

/-- For adjacent indices (cyclic neighbors), the constructed matrices commute.
    This is because both products A_i * A_j and A_j * A_i equal zero when
    the relevant triple products are zero. -/
lemma adjacent_commute (i j : Fin 2025)
    (h : j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025 ∨ i = j) :
    constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i := by
  have h_main : ∀ (u w u' w' : Fin 3 → ℝ), (vecMulVec u w : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) * (vecMulVec u' w' : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = (∑ m : Fin 3, w m * u' m) • (vecMulVec u w') := by
    intro u w u' w'
    ext k l
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, vecMulVec, Pi.smul_apply]
    ring_nf

  have h_cross_ortho : ∀ (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ), (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct a b m) * a m) = 0 ∧ (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct a b m) * b m) = 0 := by
    intro a b
    constructor
    ·
      simp [crossProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      ring_nf
    ·
      simp [crossProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      ring_nf

  have h_case1 : (j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 → (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i)) := by
    intro hj
    have h₁ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = 0) := by
      have h₂ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct i m) * (momentVector j.val m)) = 0 := by
        have h₃ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector j.val m)) = 0 := by
          have h₄ : (j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025) := hj
          have h₅ : (momentVector j.val = momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) := by
            rw [h₄]
          have h₆ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025) m)) = 0 := by
            have h₇ := h_cross_ortho (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025))
            simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h₇ ⊢
            ring_nf at *
            simp_all [Fin.sum_univ_succ, momentVector]
          rw [h₅] at *
          simpa [h₄] using h₆
        have h₈ : (neighborCrossProduct i = crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025))) := by
          rfl
        rw [h₈] at *
        simpa [hj] using h₃
      have h₉ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct i m) * (momentVector j.val m)) • (vecMulVec (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct j))) := by
        have h₁₀ := h_main (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct i) (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct j)
        simpa [constructedMatrix] using h₁₀
      rw [h₉]
      simp [h₂]
    have h₂ : (constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i = 0) := by
      have h₃ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct j m) * (momentVector i.val m)) = 0 := by
        have h₄ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector i.val m)) = 0 := by
          have h₆ : (i.val = (j.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
            have h₉ : (j.val + 2024) % 2025 = i.val := by
              omega
            omega
          have h₇ : (momentVector i.val = momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) := by
            rw [h₆]
          have h₈ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025) m)) = 0 := by
            have h₉ := h_cross_ortho (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025))
            simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h₉ ⊢
            linarith
          rw [h₇] at *
          simpa [h₆] using h₈
        have h₉ : (neighborCrossProduct j = crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025))) := by
          rfl
        rw [h₉] at *
        simpa [hj] using h₄
      have h₁₀ : (constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i = (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct j m) * (momentVector i.val m)) • (vecMulVec (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct i))) := by
        have h₁₁ := h_main (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct j) (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct i)
        simpa [constructedMatrix] using h₁₁
      rw [h₁₀]
      simp [h₃]
    rw [h₁, h₂]

  have h_case2 : (j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025 → (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i)) := by
    intro hj
    have h₁ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = 0) := by
      have h₂ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct i m) * (momentVector j.val m)) = 0 := by
        have h₃ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector j.val m)) = 0 := by
          have h₄ : (j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) := hj
          have h₅ : (momentVector j.val = momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) := by
            rw [h₄]
          have h₆ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025) m)) = 0 := by
            have h₇ := h_cross_ortho (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025))
            simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h₇ ⊢
            ring_nf at *
            simp_all [Fin.sum_univ_succ, momentVector]
          rw [h₅] at *
          simpa [h₄] using h₆
        have h₈ : (neighborCrossProduct i = crossProduct (momentVector ((i.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((i.val + 1) % 2025))) := by
          rfl
        rw [h₈] at *
        simpa [hj] using h₃
      have h₉ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct i m) * (momentVector j.val m)) • (vecMulVec (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct j))) := by
        have h₁₀ := h_main (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct i) (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct j)
        simpa [constructedMatrix] using h₁₀
      rw [h₉]
      simp [h₂]
    have h₂ : (constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i = 0) := by
      have h₃ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct j m) * (momentVector i.val m)) = 0 := by
        have h₄ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector i.val m)) = 0 := by
          have h₆ : (i.val = (j.val + 1) % 2025) := by
            have h₉ : (j.val + 1) % 2025 = i.val := by
              omega
            omega
          have h₇ : (momentVector i.val = momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025)) := by
            rw [h₆]
          have h₈ : (∑ m : Fin 3, (crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025)) m) * (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025) m)) = 0 := by
            have h₉ := h_cross_ortho (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025))
            simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h₉ ⊢
            linarith
          rw [h₇] at *
          simpa [h₆] using h₈
        have h₉ : (neighborCrossProduct j = crossProduct (momentVector ((j.val + 2024) % 2025)) (momentVector ((j.val + 1) % 2025))) := by
          rfl
        rw [h₉] at *
        simpa [hj] using h₄
      have h₁₀ : (constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i = (∑ m : Fin 3, (neighborCrossProduct j m) * (momentVector i.val m)) • (vecMulVec (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct i))) := by
        have h₁₁ := h_main (momentVector j.val) (neighborCrossProduct j) (momentVector i.val) (neighborCrossProduct i)
        simpa [constructedMatrix] using h₁₁
      rw [h₁₀]
      simp [h₃]
    rw [h₁, h₂]

  have h_case3 : (i = j → (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i)) := by
    intro h_eq
    rw [h_eq]

  have h_final : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i) := by
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      have h₁ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i) := by
        apply h_case1
        exact h
      exact h₁
    | inr h =>
      cases h with
      | inl h =>
        have h₁ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i) := by
          apply h_case2
          exact h
        exact h₁
      | inr h =>
        have h₁ : (constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i) := by
          apply h_case3
          exact h
        exact h₁

  exact h_final

/-- The neighbor relation is symmetric: j is a neighbor of i iff i is a neighbor of j. -/
lemma neighbor_symmetric (i j : Fin 2025) :
    (j.val = (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ j.val = (i.val + 2024) % 2025) ↔
    (i.val = (j.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ i.val = (j.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
  have hi : i.val < 2025 := i.isLt
  have hj : j.val < 2025 := j.isLt
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h1 | h2
    · right; omega
    · left; omega
  · intro h
    rcases h with h1 | h2
    · right; omega
    · left; omega

/-- Helper: the third component of momentVector is 1 -/
lemma momentVector_third (m : ℕ) : momentVector m 2 = 1 := by
  simp [momentVector, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]

/-- Helper: the second component of momentVector is m -/
lemma momentVector_second (m : ℕ) : momentVector m 1 = (m : ℝ) := by
  simp [momentVector, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]

/-- For distinct natural numbers i ≠ j, the moment vectors u_i and u_j are not parallel. -/
lemma momentVector_not_parallel_of_ne {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ¬∃ c : ℝ, momentVector i = c • momentVector j := by
  intro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h_eq : ∀ k, momentVector i k = c * momentVector j k := by
    intro k
    have : (c • momentVector j) k = c * momentVector j k := Pi.smul_apply c (momentVector j) k
    rw [← this, ← hc]
  have h_third := h_eq 2
  rw [momentVector_third, momentVector_third] at h_third
  have hc_eq_one : c = 1 := by linarith
  have h_second := h_eq 1
  rw [momentVector_second, momentVector_second, hc_eq_one, one_mul] at h_second
  have heq : i = j := Nat.cast_injective h_second
  exact hij heq

/-- Key lemma: If α • (u ⊗ v) = β • (w ⊗ z) where α, β ≠ 0 and both matrices are nonzero,
    then u and w must be parallel (scalar multiples of each other). -/
lemma smul_vecMulVec_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_ne_zero
    {u v w z : Fin 3 → ℝ} {α β : ℝ} (hα : α ≠ 0) (_hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (_hz : z ≠ 0)
    (heq : α • vecMulVec u v = β • vecMulVec w z) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, u = c • w := by
  have ⟨k, hvk⟩ : ∃ k, v k ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hv
    ext i
    simp [h i]
  have ⟨m, hzm⟩ : ∃ m, z m ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply _hz
    ext i
    simp [h i]
  have h_col : ∀ i, α * u i * v k = β * w i * z k := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (α • vecMulVec u v) i k = α * (u i * v k) := by
      simp [Matrix.smul_apply, vecMulVec]
    have h2 : (β • vecMulVec w z) i k = β * (w i * z k) := by
      simp [Matrix.smul_apply, vecMulVec]
    have h3 : (α • vecMulVec u v) i k = (β • vecMulVec w z) i k := by
      rw [heq]
    rw [h1, h2] at h3
    ring_nf at h3 ⊢
    exact h3
  by_cases hzk : z k = 0
  · have hu_zero : ∀ i, u i = 0 := by
      intro i
      have h_eq := h_col i
      simp only [hzk, mul_zero] at h_eq
      have h1 : α * v k ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hα hvk
      have h2 : α * u i * v k = 0 := h_eq
      have h3 : (α * v k) * u i = 0 := by linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left h1
    use 0
    ext i
    simp [hu_zero i]
  · use (β * z k) / (α * v k)
    ext i
    have h_eq := h_col i
    have h1 : α * v k ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hα hvk
    field_simp at h_eq ⊢
    ring_nf at h_eq ⊢
    linarith

/-- The cross product of two vectors is zero iff they are parallel. -/
lemma crossProduct_ne_zero_of_not_parallel {u v : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (_hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hnp : ¬∃ c : ℝ, u = c • v) :
    crossProduct u v ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  apply hnp
  have h_cp : crossProduct u v = 0 := h
  have hcp0 : (crossProduct u v) 0 = 0 := by rw [h_cp]; simp
  have hcp1 : (crossProduct u v) 1 = 0 := by rw [h_cp]; simp
  have hcp2 : (crossProduct u v) 2 = 0 := by rw [h_cp]; simp
  simp only [crossProduct, LinearMap.mk₂_apply] at hcp0 hcp1 hcp2
  have h0 : u 1 * v 2 = u 2 * v 1 := by
    have : (![u 1 * v 2 - u 2 * v 1, u 2 * v 0 - u 0 * v 2, u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 0 = 0 := hcp0
    simp at this
    linarith
  have h1 : u 2 * v 0 = u 0 * v 2 := by
    have : (![u 1 * v 2 - u 2 * v 1, u 2 * v 0 - u 0 * v 2, u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 = 0 := hcp1
    simp at this
    linarith
  have h2 : u 0 * v 1 = u 1 * v 0 := by
    have : (![u 1 * v 2 - u 2 * v 1, u 2 * v 0 - u 0 * v 2, u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 2 = 0 := hcp2
    simp at this
    linarith
  have ⟨k, hvk⟩ : ∃ k, v k ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h'
    push_neg at h'
    apply hv
    ext i
    simp [h' i]
  use u k / v k
  ext j
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hvk' : v k ≠ 0 := hvk
  field_simp
  fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k
  all_goals (
    first
    | (simp at hvk'; linarith)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h0)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h0.symm)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h1)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h1.symm)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h2)
    | (simp at hvk'; exact h2.symm)
  )

/-- Moment vectors are nonzero. -/
lemma momentVector_ne_zero (m : ℕ) : momentVector m ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have : momentVector m 2 = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  rw [momentVector_third] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

/-- neighborCrossProduct is nonzero for all indices. -/
lemma neighborCrossProduct_ne_zero (i : Fin 2025) : neighborCrossProduct i ≠ 0 := by
  unfold neighborCrossProduct
  apply crossProduct_ne_zero_of_not_parallel
  · exact momentVector_ne_zero _
  · exact momentVector_ne_zero _
  · have h_prev_ne_next : (i.val + 2024) % 2025 ≠ (i.val + 1) % 2025 := prev_ne_next i
    exact momentVector_not_parallel_of_ne h_prev_ne_next

lemma nonadjacent_dont_commute (i j : Fin 2025) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hnotadj : j.val ≠ (i.val + 1) % 2025 ∧ j.val ≠ (i.val + 2024) % 2025) :
    constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j ≠ constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i := by
  let ui := momentVector i.val
  let uj := momentVector j.val
  let wi := neighborCrossProduct i
  let wj := neighborCrossProduct j

  have hα : wi ⬝ᵥ uj ≠ 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm]
    intro h
    have h_iff := (tripleProduct_eq_zero_iff_neighbor i j).mp h
    rcases h_iff with h1 | h2
    · exact hnotadj.1 h1
    · exact hnotadj.2 h2

  have hβ : wj ⬝ᵥ ui ≠ 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm]
    intro h
    have hne : ¬(i.val = (j.val + 1) % 2025 ∨ i.val = (j.val + 2024) % 2025) := by
      rw [← neighbor_symmetric]
      push_neg
      exact hnotadj
    have h_iff := (tripleProduct_eq_zero_iff_neighbor j i).mp h
    exact hne h_iff

  intro hcomm

  have hexp_ij : constructedMatrix i * constructedMatrix j = (wi ⬝ᵥ uj) • vecMulVec ui wj := by
    unfold constructedMatrix
    exact rankOne_mul_rankOne ui wi uj wj

  have hexp_ji : constructedMatrix j * constructedMatrix i = (wj ⬝ᵥ ui) • vecMulVec uj wi := by
    unfold constructedMatrix
    exact rankOne_mul_rankOne uj wj ui wi

  rw [hexp_ij, hexp_ji] at hcomm

  have hwj_ne : wj ≠ 0 := neighborCrossProduct_ne_zero j
  have hwi_ne : wi ≠ 0 := neighborCrossProduct_ne_zero i

  have hpar : ∃ c : ℝ, ui = c • uj := by
    exact smul_vecMulVec_eq_smul_vecMulVec_of_ne_zero hα hβ hwj_ne hwi_ne hcomm

  have hne_nat : i.val ≠ j.val := by
    intro heq
    have : i = j := Fin.ext heq
    exact hij this

  exact momentVector_not_parallel_of_ne hne_nat hpar

name: Lambda.eval_env_congr
statement:
/-- `eval` respects store agreement on free variables: if two stores agree on
    all free variables of an expression, `eval` produces the same result.
    Requires a well-formed factory, environments mapping only to closed
    expressions, identifiers determined by their name, and a `concreteEval`
    introducing no fresh free variables. -/
theorem eval_env_congr
    (hIdent : ∀ a b : Tbase.Identifier, a.name = b.name → a = b)
    (n : Nat) (F : @Factory Tbase) (env₁ env₂ : Env Tbase) (hWF : FactoryWF F) (hClosed : FactoryClosed F)
    (henv₂ : ∀ x v, env₂ x = some v → LExpr.LExpr.getVars v = [])
    (e : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ LExpr.LExpr.getVars e, env₁ x = env₂ x) :
    LExpr.eval n F env₁ e = LExpr.eval n F env₂ e
src:
/-- `eval` respects store agreement on free variables: if two stores agree on
    all free variables of an expression, `eval` produces the same result.
    Requires a well-formed factory, environments mapping only to closed
    expressions, identifiers determined by their name, and a `concreteEval`
    introducing no fresh free variables. -/
theorem eval_env_congr
    (hIdent : ∀ a b : Tbase.Identifier, a.name = b.name → a = b)
    (n : Nat) (F : @Factory Tbase) (env₁ env₂ : Env Tbase) (hWF : FactoryWF F) (hClosed : FactoryClosed F)
    (henv₂ : ∀ x v, env₂ x = some v → LExpr.LExpr.getVars v = [])
    (e : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ LExpr.LExpr.getVars e, env₁ x = env₂ x) :
    LExpr.eval n F env₁ e = LExpr.eval n F env₂ e := by
  suffices H : ∀ (n : Nat) (e : LExpr Tbase.mono),
      (∀ x ∈ LExpr.LExpr.getVars e, env₁ x = env₂ x) →
      LExpr.eval n F env₁ e = LExpr.eval n F env₂ e from H n e hagree
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro e hag; simp only [LExpr.eval]
  | succ n' ih =>
    intro e hag
    simp only [LExpr.eval, LExpr.List_map_fst_map_eval,
      LExpr.List_all_snd_isValueTrue_map_eval, LExpr.combineEvalResValueFlag_eq_pair]
    split
    · rfl
    · split
      · -- callOfLFunc = some
        rename_i op_expr args lfunc h_call
        have h_mem := callOfLFunc_func_mem F _ _ _ lfunc false h_call
        have h_wf := hWF.lfuncs_wf lfunc h_mem
        have h_closed := hClosed.lfuncs_closed lfunc h_mem
        obtain ⟨mo, no, to, hop_eq, _, h_arity⟩ := callOfLFunc_eq_some h_call
        have hmap : (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a).fst)) =
            (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).fst)) := by
          apply List.map_congr_left
          intro a ha
          have hae : LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a := by
            apply ih a
            intro x hx
            exact hag x (callOfLFunc_getVars_args F e op_expr args lfunc h_call a ha x hx)
          rw [hae]
        simp only [hmap]
        -- The argsAllFull expression depends on `env`, so it's not automatically
        -- unified.  We need to establish it separately.
        have h_argsFull : (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a).snd.isValueTrue) =
                          (args.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).snd.isValueTrue) := by
          have h_all_mem : ∀ a ∈ args, LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a := by
            intro a ha
            apply ih a
            intro x hx
            exact hag x (callOfLFunc_getVars_args F e op_expr args lfunc h_call a ha x hx)
          have h_aux : ∀ (l : List (LExpr Tbase.mono)),
              (∀ a ∈ l, LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a) →
              (l.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a).snd.isValueTrue) =
              (l.all fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).snd.isValueTrue) := by
            intro l hl
            induction l with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons a as ih_as =>
              simp only [List.all_cons]
              have h_a : LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a :=
                hl a (by simp)
              rw [h_a]
              have h_rest : ∀ a' ∈ as, LExpr.eval n' F env₁ a' = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a' :=
                fun a' ha' => hl a' (by simp [ha'])
              rw [ih_as h_rest]
          exact h_aux args h_all_mem
        simp only [h_argsFull]
        split
        · -- inline
          rename_i h_cond
          split
          · -- computeTypeSubst some → eval env new_e
            rename_i tySubst h_ts
            generalize h_new_e :
              LExpr.substFvarsLifting
                ((lfunc.body.get (by simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond; exact h_cond.1)).applySubst tySubst)
                (lfunc.inputs.keys.zip
                  (List.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).fst) args)) = new_e
            have h_ih_new : LExpr.eval n' F env₁ new_e = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ new_e := by
              apply ih
              intro x hx
              rw [← h_new_e] at hx
              rcases getVars_substFvarsLifting_mem _ _ x hx with ⟨hin, hnone⟩ | ⟨k, v, hk, hv⟩
              · exfalso
                rw [getVars_applySubst] at hin
                have hsome : lfunc.body.isSome = true := by
                  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond; exact h_cond.1
                have hbody_eq : lfunc.body = some (lfunc.body.get hsome) := by
                  simp [Option.some_get]
                have hy_key := lfunc_body_getVars_subset_keys hIdent lfunc h_closed _ hbody_eq x hin
                have h_len : lfunc.inputs.keys.length =
                    (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).fst)).length := by
                  rw [ListMap.keys_eq_map_fst]; simp [h_arity]
                have h_mem_keys : x ∈ Map.keys (lfunc.inputs.keys.zip
                    (args.map (fun a => (LExpr.eval n' F env₂ a).fst))) := by
                  rw [Map.keys_eq_map_fst, List.map_fst_zip (by omega)]
                  exact hy_key
                exact Map_find?_ne_none_of_mem_keys _ x h_mem_keys hnone
              · have hv_mem := Map_find?_some_mem_values _ k v hk
                have hv_args' := List.mem_map_snd_zip _ _ v hv_mem
                rw [List.mem_map] at hv_args'
                obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, ha_eq⟩ := hv_args'
                have hxa : x ∈ LExpr.LExpr.getVars a := by
                  apply eval_getVars_subset hIdent F env₂ hWF hClosed henv₂ n' a x
                  rw [ha_eq]; exact hv
                exact hag x (callOfLFunc_getVars_args F e op_expr args lfunc h_call a ha_mem x hxa)
            rw [h_ih_new]
          · -- computeTypeSubst none
            rfl
        · -- non-inline
          cases h_fEC : Strata.DL.Util.FuncAttr.findEvalIfConstr lfunc.attr <;>
          cases h_fEV : Strata.DL.Util.FuncAttr.findEvalIfCanonical lfunc.attr <;> (
            simp only []
            split
            · -- canonical/constr cond holds
              split
              · -- concreteEval none
                rfl
              · -- concreteEval some ceval
                rename_i ceval h_ce
                split
                · -- ceval succeeds → eval env e'
                  rename_i e'c h_ceval_eq
                  have h_ih_new : LExpr.eval n' F env₁ e'c = LExpr.eval n' F env₂ e'c := by
                    apply ih
                    intro x hx
                    have hexists := h_wf.concreteEval_freeVars ceval h_ce _ _ e'c h_ceval_eq x hx
                    obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, hxa'⟩ := hexists
                    rw [List.mem_map] at ha_mem
                    obtain ⟨a0, ha0_mem, ha0_eq⟩ := ha_mem
                    have hxa : x ∈ LExpr.LExpr.getVars a0 := by
                      apply eval_getVars_subset hIdent F env₂ hWF hClosed henv₂ n' a0 x
                      rw [ha0_eq]; exact hxa'
                    exact hag x (callOfLFunc_getVars_args F e op_expr args lfunc h_call a0 ha0_mem x hxa)
                  rw [h_ih_new]
                · -- ceval fails
                  rfl
            · -- symbolic args
              rfl
          )
      · -- callOfLFunc none → evalCore
        rename_i h_nocall
        exact evalCore_env_congr hIdent F env₁ env₂ hWF hClosed henv₂ n' e ih hag

name: RationalFunctions.weight_monicize_le
statement:
omit [IsDomain F] in
/-- The `Λ`-weight of `monicize H` is bounded by `d_H · m`, where `d_H = H.natDegree`. -/
lemma weight_monicize_le {H : F[X][Y]} {D : ℕ}
    (hD : Bivariate.totalDegree H ≤ D) (hH : 0 < H.natDegree) :
    weight (monicize H) H D ≤
      (WithBot.some (H.natDegree * (D + 1 - Bivariate.natDegreeY H)) : WithBot ℕ)
src:
omit [IsDomain F] in
/-- The `Λ`-weight of `monicize H` is bounded by `d_H · m`, where `d_H = H.natDegree`. -/
lemma weight_monicize_le {H : F[X][Y]} {D : ℕ}
    (hD : Bivariate.totalDegree H ≤ D) (hH : 0 < H.natDegree) :
    weight (monicize H) H D ≤
      (WithBot.some (H.natDegree * (D + 1 - Bivariate.natDegreeY H)) : WithBot ℕ) := by
  classical
  have hbY : Bivariate.natDegreeY H = H.natDegree := rfl
  have hH_ne : H ≠ 0 := Polynomial.ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hH
  have hH_in : H.natDegree ∈ H.support :=
    Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH_ne)
  have hd_le_D : H.natDegree ≤ D := by
    have : (H.coeff H.natDegree).natDegree + H.natDegree ≤ Bivariate.totalDegree H :=
      Bivariate.coeff_totalDegree_le H hH_in
    omega
  rw [monicize, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hH)]
  refine (weight_add_le _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine max_le ?_ ?_
  · -- weight Y^d ≤ d · m
    refine (weight_X_pow_le H D _).trans ?_
    rw [WithBot.coe_le_coe]
  · -- weight (∑ ... · Y^i) ≤ d · m
    refine (weight_sum_le _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sup_le (fun i hi => ?_)
    have hi_lt : i < H.natDegree := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    refine (weight_C_mul_X_pow_le H D _ _).trans ?_
    -- Goal: WithBot.some (i·m + (H.coeff i · W^(d-1-i)).natDegree) ≤ WithBot.some (d·m)
    rw [WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    rw [hbY]
    have hcoeff_natDeg :
        (H.coeff i * H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree ≤
          (D - i) + (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (D - H.natDegree) := by
      have h1 :
          (H.coeff i * H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree ≤
            (H.coeff i).natDegree +
              (H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      have h2 :
          (H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree ≤
            (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (H.coeff H.natDegree).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le
      have hi_deg : (H.coeff i).natDegree ≤ D - i :=
        natDegree_coeff_le_of_totalDegree_le H hD i
      have hd_deg : (H.coeff H.natDegree).natDegree ≤ D - H.natDegree :=
        natDegree_coeff_le_of_totalDegree_le H hD H.natDegree
      calc (H.coeff i * H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree
          ≤ (H.coeff i).natDegree +
              (H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree := h1
        _ ≤ (D - i) + (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (H.coeff H.natDegree).natDegree := by
            exact Nat.add_le_add hi_deg h2
        _ ≤ (D - i) + (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (D - H.natDegree) :=
            Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hd_deg) _
    -- numeric bound: i·m + (D-i) + (d-1-i)(D-d) = d·m
    have hadd : i * (D + 1 - H.natDegree) +
        (H.coeff i * H.coeff H.natDegree ^ (H.natDegree - 1 - i)).natDegree ≤
          i * (D + 1 - H.natDegree) +
            ((D - i) + (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (D - H.natDegree)) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left hcoeff_natDeg _
    refine hadd.trans ?_
    -- Numeric identity: i*(D+1-d) + (D-i) + (d-1-i)(D-d) = d*(D+1-d)
    have hkey : i * (D + 1 - H.natDegree) +
        ((D - i) + (H.natDegree - 1 - i) * (D - H.natDegree)) =
        H.natDegree * (D + 1 - H.natDegree) := by
      have hi_le : i ≤ H.natDegree - 1 := by omega
      have hi_le_D : i ≤ D := by omega
      have hd_le_D1 : H.natDegree ≤ 1 + D := by omega
      have hd_le_D' : H.natDegree ≤ D + 1 := by omega
      zify [hd_le_D, hd_le_D', hi_le, hi_le_D, hH]
      ring
    omega

name: Config.hasInterweavedLaced_hasNGon_ff
statement:
theorem Config.hasInterweavedLaced_hasNGon_ff {n : ℕ} {S : Finset α} (cap4_free : ¬C.HasNCap 4 S)
    {p q r s : α} (label : C.Label S) (q_lt_r : q < r) (sqr : ¬label.Slope q r) :
    C.HasInterweavedLaced (n + 2) S p q r s → C.HasNGon (n + 3) S
src:
theorem Config.hasInterweavedLaced_hasNGon_ff {n : ℕ} {S : Finset α} (cap4_free : ¬C.HasNCap 4 S)
    {p q r s : α} (label : C.Label S) (q_lt_r : q < r) (sqr : ¬label.Slope q r) :
    C.HasInterweavedLaced (n + 2) S p q r s → C.HasNGon (n + 3) S :=
  by
  intro h; rcases h with ⟨⟨p_lt_q, q_le_r, r_lt_s⟩, ⟨pr_laced, qs_laced⟩⟩
  rcases pr_laced with
    ⟨a, b, cp, c1, cr, hcp, hc1, hcr,
      ⟨⟨cp_in_S, c1_in_S, cr_in_S⟩, eq_ab, cp_last, c1_head, c1_last, cr_head⟩⟩
  rcases qs_laced with
    ⟨c, d, cq, c2, cs, hcq, hc2, hcs,
      ⟨⟨cq_in_S, c2_in_S, cs_in_S⟩, eq_cd, cq_last, c2_head, c2_last, cs_head⟩⟩
  have p_in_S : p ∈ S := c1_in_S _ (List.mem_of_mem_head? c1_head)
  have q_in_S : q ∈ S := c2_in_S _ (List.mem_of_mem_head? c2_head)
  have r_in_S : r ∈ S := c1_in_S _ (List.mem_of_mem_getLast? c1_last)
  have s_in_S : s ∈ S := c2_in_S _ (List.mem_of_mem_getLast? c2_last)
  have label := cap4FreeLabel cap4_free
  by_cases spq : label.Slope p q
  swap
  · apply ncup_is_ngon (by omega)
    refine ⟨p :: c2, hc2.extend_left spq p_in_S p_lt_q c2_in_S c2_head, ?_⟩
    simp_all
  -- (spq : label.Slope p q) from now on
  have cp_nnil : cp ≠ [] := by
    rintro rfl
    exact absurd cp_last (Option.not_mem_none p)
  rcases List.takeLast cp_nnil with ⟨p', cp', eq_cp⟩
  rw [eq_cp, List.getLast?_concat, Option.mem_some_iff] at cp_last
  subst p'
  have cr_nnil : cr ≠ [] := by
    rintro rfl
    exact absurd cr_head (Option.not_mem_none r)
  rcases List.takeHead cr_nnil with ⟨r', cr', eq_cr⟩
  rw [eq_cr, List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at cr_head
  subst r'
  have cp_last' : p ∈ cp.getLast? := by rw [eq_cp, List.getLast?_concat]; rfl
  have cr_head' : r ∈ cr.head? := by rw [eq_cr, List.head?_cons]; rfl
  by_cases cpqr : C.Cup3 p q r
  · apply ncup_is_ngon (by omega)
    refine ⟨cp ++ q :: cr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Config.NCup]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [eq_cp, eq_cr,
          show (cp' ++ [p]) ++ q :: r :: cr' = cp' ++ p :: q :: r :: cr' by simp,
          Config.Cup.append_cons3]
        refine ⟨?_, cpqr, ?_⟩
        · rw [show cp' ++ [p, q] = (cp' ++ [p]) ++ [q] by simp, ← eq_cp]
          exact hcp.left.extend_right spq p_lt_q q_in_S cp_in_S cp_last'
        · rw [← eq_cr]
          exact hcr.left.extend_left sqr q_in_S q_lt_r cr_in_S cr_head'
      · rw [List.length_append, List.length_cons, hcp.2, hcr.2]
        omega
    · simp_all
  · refine ⟨[p, q, r], c1, ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_, c1_in_S⟩
    · simp
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp_all
      · rw [show ([p, q, r] : List α) = [] ++ p :: q :: r :: [] by simp,
          List.chain3'_append_cons3]
        exact ⟨List.chain3'_pair p q, cpqr, List.chain3'_pair q r⟩
    · rw [hc1.2]; omega
    · exact hc1.left
    · rw [List.head?_cons]; exact c1_head.symm
    · simp_all
    · simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      rw [hc1.2]; omega
    · simp_all

name: Space.schwartzMap_slice_bound
statement:
lemma schwartzMap_slice_bound {n m} {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d.succ) :
    ∃ rt, ∀ (η : 𝓢(Space d.succ, ℝ)), ∃ k,
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖((1 + ‖x‖) ^ rt)⁻¹‖) volume ∧
    (∀ (x : Space d), ∀ r, ‖(slice i).symm (r, x)‖ ^ m *
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ⇑η ((slice i).symm (r, x))‖ ≤ k * ‖(1 + ‖r‖) ^ (rt)‖⁻¹)
      ∧ k = (2 ^ (rt + m, n).1 * ((Finset.Iic (rt + m, n)).sup
        fun m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m.1 m.2) η)
src:
lemma schwartzMap_slice_bound {n m} {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d.succ) :
    ∃ rt, ∀ (η : 𝓢(Space d.succ, ℝ)), ∃ k,
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖((1 + ‖x‖) ^ rt)⁻¹‖) volume ∧
    (∀ (x : Space d), ∀ r, ‖(slice i).symm (r, x)‖ ^ m *
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ⇑η ((slice i).symm (r, x))‖ ≤ k * ‖(1 + ‖r‖) ^ (rt)‖⁻¹)
      ∧ k = (2 ^ (rt + m, n).1 * ((Finset.Iic (rt + m, n)).sup
        fun m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m.1 m.2) η) := by
  obtain ⟨rt, hrt⟩ : ∃ r, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖((1 + ‖x‖) ^ r)⁻¹‖) volume := by
      obtain ⟨r, h⟩ := Measure.HasTemperateGrowth.exists_integrable (μ := volume (α := ℝ))
      use r
      convert h using 1
      funext x
      simp only [norm_inv, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.rpow_neg_natCast, zpow_neg,
        zpow_natCast, inv_inj]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  use rt
  intro η
  have h0 := one_add_le_sup_seminorm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (m := (rt + m, n))
      (k := rt + m) (n := n) le_rfl (le_rfl) η
  simp at h0
  let k := 2 ^ (rt + m, n).1 *
    ((Finset.Iic (rt + m, n)).sup fun m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m.1 m.2) η
  refine ⟨k, ⟨hrt, fun x r => ?_, by rfl⟩⟩
  trans k * ‖(1 + ‖((slice i).symm (r, x))‖) ^ rt‖⁻¹; swap
  · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (by rfl) ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    by_cases rt = 0
    · subst rt
      simp
    refine inv_anti₀ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [norm_eq_abs, norm_pow]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      positivity
    simp only [norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ rt
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    conv_rhs => rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    simp only [add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact abs_right_le_norm_slice_symm i r x
  refine (le_mul_inv_iff₀ ?_).mpr (le_trans ?_ (h0 ((slice i).symm (r, x))))
  · simp
    by_cases hr : rt = 0
    · subst rt
      simp
    positivity
  trans (‖((slice i).symm (r, x))‖ ^ m * ‖(1 + ‖((slice i).symm (r, x))‖) ^ rt‖) *
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ⇑η (((slice i).symm (r, x)))‖
  · apply le_of_eq
    simp [mul_assoc]
    left
    ring
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg _ (by rfl) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  trans (1 + ‖((slice i).symm (r, x))‖) ^ m * (1 + ‖((slice i).symm (r, x))‖) ^ rt
  · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg ?_ ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ m
      simp
    · simp
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  apply le_of_eq
  ring_nf

name: psi_support_pos
statement:
/-- The support of psi intersected with I × I has positive measure.
    Specifically, psi is positive where x ≠ y and f(x), f(y) > 0. -/
lemma psi_support_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1))
    (hf_mono : StrictMonoOn f (Icc 0 1))
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 < (volume.prod volume) (Function.support (psi f) ∩ (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1))
src:
/-- The support of psi intersected with I × I has positive measure.
    Specifically, psi is positive where x ≠ y and f(x), f(y) > 0. -/
lemma psi_support_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 1))
    (hf_mono : StrictMonoOn f (Icc 0 1))
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 < (volume.prod volume) (Function.support (psi f) ∩ (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le, hf_pos⟩ := f_pos_near_one f hf_cont hf_mono hf_nonneg
  set S := Ioo (1 - δ) (1 - δ/2) ×ˢ Ioo (1 - δ/2) 1 with hS_def
  have hS_subset_support : S ⊆ Function.support (psi f) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    simp only [psi, ne_eq]
    have hp1 : p.1 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ) (1 - δ/2) := (mem_prod.mp hp).1
    have hp2 : p.2 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ/2) 1 := (mem_prod.mp hp).2
    have hp1' : p.1 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ) 1 := ⟨hp1.1, by linarith [hp1.2]⟩
    have hp2' : p.2 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hp2.1, hδ_pos], hp2.2⟩
    have hfp1 : 0 < f p.1 := hf_pos p.1 hp1'
    have hfp2 : 0 < f p.2 := hf_pos p.2 hp2'
    have hxy : p.1 < p.2 := by linarith [hp1.2, hp2.1]
    have hp1_mem : p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hp1.1, hδ_le], le_of_lt (by linarith [hp1.2])⟩
    have hp2_mem : p.2 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hp2.1, hδ_le, hδ_pos], le_of_lt hp2.2⟩
    have hfxy : f p.1 < f p.2 := hf_mono hp1_mem hp2_mem hxy
    have h1 : f p.1 * f p.2 > 0 := mul_pos hfp1 hfp2
    have h2 : (p.1 - p.2) * (f p.1 - f p.2) > 0 := by
      have : p.1 - p.2 < 0 := sub_neg_of_lt hxy
      have : f p.1 - f p.2 < 0 := sub_neg_of_lt hfxy
      have : -(p.1 - p.2) * -(f p.1 - f p.2) = (p.1 - p.2) * (f p.1 - f p.2) := by ring
      rw [← this]
      apply mul_pos <;> linarith
    have : f p.1 * f p.2 * (p.1 - p.2) * (f p.1 - f p.2) > 0 := by
      calc f p.1 * f p.2 * (p.1 - p.2) * (f p.1 - f p.2)
          = (f p.1 * f p.2) * ((p.1 - p.2) * (f p.1 - f p.2)) := by ring
        _ > 0 := mul_pos h1 h2
    linarith
  have hS_subset_I : S ⊆ Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : p.1 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ) (1 - δ/2) := (mem_prod.mp hp).1
    have hp2 : p.2 ∈ Ioo (1 - δ/2) 1 := (mem_prod.mp hp).2
    exact mem_prod.mpr ⟨⟨by linarith [hp1.1, hδ_le], le_of_lt (by linarith [hp1.2])⟩,
                         ⟨by linarith [hp2.1, hδ_le, hδ_pos], le_of_lt hp2.2⟩⟩
  have hS_subset : S ⊆ Function.support (psi f) ∩ (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1) :=
    subset_inter hS_subset_support hS_subset_I
  have hS_meas : (volume.prod volume) S = ENNReal.ofReal (δ/2) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ/2) := by
    rw [Measure.prod_prod]
    congr 1
    · rw [volume_Ioo]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [volume_Ioo]
      congr 1
      ring
  have hpos : 0 < δ/2 := by linarith
  have hne : ENNReal.ofReal (δ/2) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]
    linarith
  have hS_pos : 0 < (volume.prod volume) S := by
    rw [hS_meas]
    exact ENNReal.mul_pos hne hne
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hS_pos (measure_mono hS_subset)
