lemma matchingSucc_inj {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s t : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) (ht : t.oddParity)
    (heq : matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s = matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t) :
    s = t := by
  have hs_eq : s = GameString.cons s.head s.tail := (GameString.cons_head_tail s).symm
  have ht_eq : t = GameString.cons t.head t.tail := (GameString.cons_head_tail t).symm
  rcases Fin3_trichotomy s.head with hs0 | hs1 | hs2
  all_goals rcases Fin3_trichotomy t.head with ht0 | ht1 | ht2

  · have hs_tail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even s hs (Or.inl hs0)
    have ht_tail_odd : t.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even t ht (Or.inl ht0)
    rw [matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs0,
        matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht0] at heq
    have htail_eq : M_n s.tail = M_n t.tail := by
      have h := congrArg GameString.tail heq; simp at h; exact h
    have stail_eq := hM_inj s.tail t.tail hs_tail_odd ht_tail_odd htail_eq
    rw [hs_eq, ht_eq, hs0, ht0, stail_eq]

  · have ht_tail_even : t.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 t ht ht1
    rw [matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs0] at heq
    by_cases htinit : t.tail = initialState n
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit ht_tail_even] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · rw [matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs0,
        matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht2] at heq
    have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · have hs_tail_even : s.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 s hs hs1
    rw [matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht0] at heq
    by_cases hsinit : s.tail = initialState n
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit hs_tail_even] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · have hs_tail_even : s.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 s hs hs1
    have ht_tail_even : t.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 t ht ht1
    by_cases hsinit : s.tail = initialState n
    · by_cases htinit : t.tail = initialState n
      · rw [hs_eq, ht_eq, hs1, ht1, hsinit, htinit]
      · rw [matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit,
            matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit ht_tail_even] at heq
        have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead
    · by_cases htinit : t.tail = initialState n
      · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit hs_tail_even,
            matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit] at heq
        have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead
      · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit hs_tail_even,
            matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit ht_tail_even] at heq
        have hpre_eq : Classical.choose (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
            s.tail hs_tail_even hsinit) = Classical.choose (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
            t.tail ht_tail_even htinit) := by
          have h := congrArg GameString.tail heq; simp at h; exact h
        have hspec_s := Classical.choose_spec (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
          s.tail hs_tail_even hsinit)
        have hspec_t := Classical.choose_spec (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
          t.tail ht_tail_even htinit)
        have stail_eq : s.tail = t.tail := by
          rw [← hspec_s.2, ← hspec_t.2, hpre_eq]
        rw [hs_eq, ht_eq, hs1, ht1, stail_eq]

  · have hs_tail_even : s.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 s hs hs1
    have ht_tail_odd : t.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even t ht (Or.inr ht2)
    rw [matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht2] at heq
    by_cases hsinit : s.tail = initialState n
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit] at heq
      have htail := congrArg GameString.tail heq; simp at htail
      exact absurd htail.symm (hM_not_init t.tail ht_tail_odd)
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs1 hsinit hs_tail_even] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · rw [matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs2,
        matchingSucc_head0 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht0] at heq
    have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · have hs_tail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even s hs (Or.inr hs2)
    have ht_tail_even : t.tail.evenParity := tail_even_of_head_1 t ht ht1
    rw [matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs2] at heq
    by_cases htinit : t.tail = initialState n
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit] at heq
      have htail := congrArg GameString.tail heq; simp at htail
      exact absurd htail (hM_not_init s.tail hs_tail_odd)
    · rw [matchingSucc_head1_not_init M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht1 htinit ht_tail_even] at heq
      have hhead := congrArg GameString.head heq; simp at hhead

  · have hs_tail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even s hs (Or.inr hs2)
    have ht_tail_odd : t.tail.oddParity := tail_odd_of_head_even t ht (Or.inr ht2)
    rw [matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s hs2,
        matchingSucc_head2 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj t ht2] at heq
    have htail_eq : M_n s.tail = M_n t.tail := by
      have h := congrArg GameString.tail heq; simp at h; exact h
    have stail_eq := hM_inj s.tail t.tail hs_tail_odd ht_tail_odd htail_eq
    rw [hs_eq, ht_eq, hs2, ht2, stail_eq]
header:
import Mathlib

open Finset Function

abbrev GameString (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin 3

abbrev initialState (n : ℕ) : GameString n := fun _ => 0

abbrev isValidMove {n : ℕ} (s1 s2 : GameString n) : Prop :=
  (∃! i : Fin n, s1 i ≠ s2 i) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, s1 i ≠ s2 i →
    ((s1 i).val + 1 = (s2 i).val ∨ (s2 i).val + 1 = (s1 i).val)

abbrev IsValidGamePlay {n : ℕ} (play : List (GameString n)) : Prop :=
  play.Chain isValidMove (initialState n) ∧
  (initialState n :: play).Nodup

abbrev IsMaximalPlay {n : ℕ} (play : List (GameString n)) : Prop :=
  IsValidGamePlay play ∧
  ∀ s, ¬IsValidGamePlay (play ++ [s])

inductive HasWinningStrategy (n : ℕ) : List (GameString n) → Prop where
  | win (play : List (GameString n)) (s : GameString n) :
      IsValidGamePlay (play ++ [s]) →
      (∀ s', IsValidGamePlay (play ++ [s, s']) → HasWinningStrategy n (play ++ [s, s'])) →
      HasWinningStrategy n play

abbrev AliceHasWinningStrategy (n : ℕ) : Prop := HasWinningStrategy n []

abbrev putnam_2025_a3_solution : ℕ → Bool := fun _ => false

def GameString.parity {n : ℕ} (s : GameString n) : ℕ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, (s i).val

def GameString.evenParity {n : ℕ} (s : GameString n) : Prop :=
  s.parity % 2 = 0

def GameString.oddParity {n : ℕ} (s : GameString n) : Prop :=
  s.parity % 2 = 1

instance {n : ℕ} : DecidablePred (@GameString.evenParity n) := fun s =>
  decidable_of_iff (s.parity % 2 = 0) Iff.rfl

instance {n : ℕ} : DecidablePred (@GameString.oddParity n) := fun s =>
  decidable_of_iff (s.parity % 2 = 1) Iff.rfl

noncomputable instance {n : ℕ} (s1 s2 : GameString n) : Decidable (isValidMove s1 s2) :=
  Classical.propDecidable _

/-- The initial state (all zeros) has even parity since sum of zeros is 0.
    Direct computation: parity = Σᵢ 0 = 0, and 0 % 2 = 0. -/
lemma initialState_evenParity (n : ℕ) : (initialState n).evenParity := by
  unfold GameString.evenParity GameString.parity initialState
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Nat.zero_mod]

/-- A valid move changes exactly one coordinate by ±1, which changes the parity.
    If s1 has even parity and s1 → s2 is valid, then s2 has odd parity.
    This follows from the fact that the sum changes by ±1, hence parity flips. -/
lemma isValidMove_changes_parity {n : ℕ} (s1 s2 : GameString n) (h : isValidMove s1 s2) :
    s1.evenParity ↔ s2.oddParity := by
  obtain ⟨⟨i, hi_diff, hi_unique⟩, hdiff⟩ := h
  have heq : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1 j = s2 j := by
    intro j hj
    by_contra hne
    exact hj (hi_unique j hne)
  unfold GameString.evenParity GameString.oddParity GameString.parity
  have hsum : ∑ j : Fin n, (s2 j).val = ∑ j : Fin n, (s1 j).val + 1 ∨
              ∑ j : Fin n, (s1 j).val = ∑ j : Fin n, (s2 j).val + 1 := by
    have eq1 : ∑ j : Fin n, (s1 j).val = (s1 i).val + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s1 j).val := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have eq2 : ∑ j : Fin n, (s2 j).val = (s2 i).val + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s2 j).val := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have heq_sum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s1 j).val = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s2 j).val := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_erase] at hj
      congr 1
      exact heq j hj.1
    rw [eq1, eq2, heq_sum]
    cases hdiff i hi_diff with
    | inl h => left; omega
    | inr h => right; omega
  cases hsum with
  | inl h => omega
  | inr h => omega

/-- The set of all game strings with even parity -/
def evenParityStrings (n : ℕ) : Finset (GameString n) :=
  Finset.univ.filter GameString.evenParity

/-- The set of all game strings with odd parity -/
def oddParityStrings (n : ℕ) : Finset (GameString n) :=
  Finset.univ.filter GameString.oddParity

/-- The union of even and odd parity strings is all strings -/
lemma evenParityStrings_union_oddParityStrings (n : ℕ) :
    evenParityStrings n ∪ oddParityStrings n = Finset.univ := by
  ext s
  simp only [evenParityStrings, oddParityStrings, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  unfold GameString.evenParity GameString.oddParity
  constructor
  · intro _; trivial
  · intro _
    have h : s.parity % 2 = 0 ∨ s.parity % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one s.parity
    exact h

/-- Even and odd parity strings are disjoint -/
lemma evenParityStrings_disjoint_oddParityStrings (n : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (evenParityStrings n) (oddParityStrings n) := by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro s hs_even hs_odd
  simp only [evenParityStrings, oddParityStrings, Finset.mem_filter] at hs_even hs_odd
  have he := hs_even.2
  have ho := hs_odd.2
  unfold GameString.evenParity at he
  unfold GameString.oddParity at ho
  omega

/-- Key lemma: parity of cons equals first digit plus tail parity -/
lemma parity_cons (n : ℕ) (v : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    GameString.parity (Fin.cons v t) = v.val + t.parity := by
  unfold GameString.parity
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]

/-- The equivalence between Fin 3 × GameString n and GameString (n + 1) -/
def consEquivConst (n : ℕ) : Fin 3 × GameString n ≃ GameString (n + 1) :=
  Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => Fin 3)

lemma consEquivConst_apply (n : ℕ) (p : Fin 3 × GameString n) :
    consEquivConst n p = Fin.cons p.1 p.2 := rfl

/-- The recurrence relation for even parity strings:
    E(n+1) = 2 * E(n) + O(n)
    because strings with first digit 0 or 2 (even) have same parity as tail,
    while strings with first digit 1 (odd) have opposite parity -/
lemma card_evenParity_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (evenParityStrings (n + 1)).card =
      2 * (evenParityStrings n).card + (oddParityStrings n).card := by
  simp only [evenParityStrings, oddParityStrings, card_filter]
  have eq1 : ∑ i : GameString (n + 1), (if i.evenParity then 1 else 0) =
             ∑ p : Fin 3 × GameString n, (if GameString.evenParity (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) then 1 else 0) := by
    symm
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (consEquivConst n)
    intro p
    simp only [consEquivConst_apply]
  rw [eq1]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have key : ∀ v : Fin 3, ∀ t : GameString n,
      GameString.evenParity (Fin.cons v t) ↔
        ((v.val % 2 = 0 ∧ t.evenParity) ∨ (v.val % 2 = 1 ∧ t.oddParity)) := by
    intro v t
    unfold GameString.evenParity GameString.oddParity
    rw [parity_cons]
    have := Nat.add_mod v.val t.parity 2
    omega
  simp_rw [key]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.isValue, Nat.zero_mod, Fin.val_one, Nat.one_mod, Fin.val_two,
    true_and, one_ne_zero, false_and, or_false, false_or]
  norm_num
  ring

/-- The recurrence relation for odd parity strings:
    O(n+1) = 2 * O(n) + E(n) -/
lemma card_oddParity_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (oddParityStrings (n + 1)).card =
      2 * (oddParityStrings n).card + (evenParityStrings n).card := by
  simp only [evenParityStrings, oddParityStrings, card_filter]
  have eq1 : ∑ i : GameString (n + 1), (if i.oddParity then 1 else 0) =
             ∑ p : Fin 3 × GameString n, (if GameString.oddParity (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) then 1 else 0) := by
    symm
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (consEquivConst n)
    intro p
    simp only [consEquivConst_apply]
  rw [eq1]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have key : ∀ v : Fin 3, ∀ t : GameString n,
      GameString.oddParity (Fin.cons v t) ↔
        ((v.val % 2 = 0 ∧ t.oddParity) ∨ (v.val % 2 = 1 ∧ t.evenParity)) := by
    intro v t
    unfold GameString.oddParity GameString.evenParity
    rw [parity_cons]
    have := Nat.add_mod v.val t.parity 2
    omega
  simp_rw [key]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.isValue, Nat.zero_mod, Fin.val_one, Nat.one_mod, Fin.val_two,
    true_and, one_ne_zero, false_and, or_false, false_or]
  norm_num
  ring

/-- Base case: E(0) = 1 (the unique empty function has parity 0) -/
lemma card_evenParity_zero : (evenParityStrings 0).card = 1 := by
  simp only [evenParityStrings, card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (fun _ : Fin 0 => (0 : Fin 3))]
  · simp only [GameString.evenParity, GameString.parity, Fintype.sum_empty, Nat.zero_mod, ↓reduceIte]
  · intro b _ hb
    exfalso
    apply hb
    ext i
    exact i.elim0
  · intro h
    exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim

/-- Base case: O(0) = 0 -/
lemma card_oddParity_zero : (oddParityStrings 0).card = 0 := by
  simp only [oddParityStrings, card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (fun _ : Fin 0 => (0 : Fin 3))]
  · simp only [GameString.oddParity, GameString.parity, Fintype.sum_empty, Nat.zero_mod]
    decide
  · intro b _ hb
    exfalso
    apply hb
    ext i
    exact i.elim0
  · intro h
    exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim

/-- The number of even parity strings is (3^n + 1)/2 and odd is (3^n - 1)/2.
    Thus |even| = |odd| + 1.
    Proof by induction: E(1)=2, O(1)=1.
    Recurrence: E(n+1) = 2E(n) + O(n), O(n+1) = 2O(n) + E(n).
    So E(n) - O(n) = E(n-1) - O(n-1) = 1 for all n ≥ 0. -/
lemma card_even_minus_odd (n : ℕ) :
    (evenParityStrings n).card = (oddParityStrings n).card + 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [card_evenParity_zero, card_oddParity_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [card_evenParity_succ, card_oddParity_succ]
    omega

/-- The set of even parity strings excluding the initial state -/
def evenParityStrings' (n : ℕ) : Finset (GameString n) :=
  (evenParityStrings n).erase (initialState n)

/-- Cardinality of evenParityStrings' equals oddParityStrings.
    Since origin is in evenParityStrings, removing it gives |E| - 1 = |O|. -/
lemma card_evenParityStrings'_eq_oddParityStrings (n : ℕ) :
    (evenParityStrings' n).card = (oddParityStrings n).card := by
  unfold evenParityStrings'
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
  · have h := card_even_minus_odd n
    omega
  · simp only [evenParityStrings, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    exact initialState_evenParity n

def GameString.head {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) : Fin 3 := s 0
def GameString.tail {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) : GameString n := fun i => s i.succ
def GameString.cons {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) : GameString (n + 1) := Fin.cons d t

@[simp] lemma GameString.head_cons {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    (GameString.cons d t).head = d := by simp [head, cons, Fin.cons_zero]

@[simp] lemma GameString.tail_cons {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    (GameString.cons d t).tail = t := by ext i; simp [tail, cons, Fin.cons_succ]

@[simp] lemma GameString.cons_head_tail {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) :
    GameString.cons s.head s.tail = s := by
  ext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp [cons, head, tail, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]

lemma GameString.parity_cons' {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    (GameString.cons d t).parity = d.val + t.parity := by
  unfold parity cons; rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]; simp [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]

lemma GameString.oddParity_cons_iff {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    (GameString.cons d t).oddParity ↔
    (d.val % 2 = 0 ∧ t.oddParity) ∨ (d.val % 2 = 1 ∧ t.evenParity) := by
  unfold oddParity evenParity; rw [parity_cons']
  have hd : d.val % 2 = 0 ∨ d.val % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one d.val
  constructor <;> intro h <;> cases hd <;> omega

lemma GameString.evenParity_cons_iff {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) :
    (GameString.cons d t).evenParity ↔
    (d.val % 2 = 0 ∧ t.evenParity) ∨ (d.val % 2 = 1 ∧ t.oddParity) := by
  unfold oddParity evenParity; rw [parity_cons']
  have hd : d.val % 2 = 0 ∨ d.val % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one d.val
  constructor <;> intro h <;> cases hd <;> omega

lemma initialState_cons (n : ℕ) : initialState (n + 1) = GameString.cons 0 (initialState n) := by
  ext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp [initialState, GameString.cons, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]

lemma initialState_mem_evenParityStrings (n : ℕ) : initialState n ∈ evenParityStrings n := by
  simp [evenParityStrings, initialState_evenParity]

/-- isValidMove is symmetric. -/
lemma isValidMove_symm {n : ℕ} (s1 s2 : GameString n) (h : isValidMove s1 s2) : isValidMove s2 s1 := by
  obtain ⟨⟨i, hi_diff, hi_unique⟩, hdiff⟩ := h
  constructor
  · use i; constructor; exact hi_diff.symm; intro j hj; exact hi_unique j hj.symm
  · intro j hj; have := hdiff j hj.symm; omega

/-- Valid move when changing head digit only. -/
lemma isValidMove_head_change {n : ℕ} (d1 d2 : Fin 3) (t : GameString n)
    (hd : d1.val + 1 = d2.val ∨ d2.val + 1 = d1.val) (hne : d1 ≠ d2) :
    isValidMove (GameString.cons d1 t) (GameString.cons d2 t) := by
  constructor
  · use 0; constructor; simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_zero, hne]
    intro j hj; cases' j using Fin.cases with j; rfl; simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_succ] at hj
  · intro i hi; cases' i using Fin.cases with i
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_zero] at hi ⊢; exact hd
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_succ] at hi

/-- Valid move when changing tail only. -/
lemma isValidMove_tail_change {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t1 t2 : GameString n) (h : isValidMove t1 t2) :
    isValidMove (GameString.cons d t1) (GameString.cons d t2) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨i, hi_diff, hi_unique⟩, hdiff⟩ := h
  constructor
  · use i.succ; constructor; simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_succ, hi_diff]
    intro j hj; cases' j using Fin.cases with j
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_zero] at hj
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_succ] at hj; exact congrArg Fin.succ (hi_unique j hj)
  · intro j hj; cases' j using Fin.cases with j
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_zero] at hj
    · simp [GameString.cons, Fin.cons_succ] at hj ⊢; exact hdiff j hj

lemma oddParity_of_head_tail {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n+1)) :
    s.oddParity ↔
    (s.head.val % 2 = 0 ∧ s.tail.oddParity) ∨ (s.head.val % 2 = 1 ∧ s.tail.evenParity) := by
  have h := GameString.oddParity_cons_iff s.head s.tail; simp at h; exact h

lemma evenParity_of_head_tail {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n+1)) :
    s.evenParity ↔
    (s.head.val % 2 = 0 ∧ s.tail.evenParity) ∨ (s.head.val % 2 = 1 ∧ s.tail.oddParity) := by
  have h := GameString.evenParity_cons_iff s.head s.tail; simp at h; exact h

lemma Fin3_trichotomy (d : Fin 3) : d = 0 ∨ d = 1 ∨ d = 2 := by fin_cases d <;> simp

/-- M_n restricted to odd strings is surjective onto E'_n (even strings minus origin).
    This follows from cardinality: M_n is injective, |O_n| = |E'_n|, so M_n is bijective. -/
lemma exists_odd_preimage {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (t : GameString n) (ht_even : t.evenParity) (ht_ne_init : t ≠ initialState n) :
    ∃ s, s.oddParity ∧ M_n s = t := by
  let imageSet : Finset (GameString n) := (oddParityStrings n).image M_n
  have himage_sub : imageSet ⊆ evenParityStrings' n := by
    intro x hx; rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx; obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [oddParityStrings, Finset.mem_filter] at hs_mem
    rw [evenParityStrings', evenParityStrings, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨hM_not_init s hs_mem.2, Finset.mem_univ _, hM_even s hs_mem.2⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn M_n (oddParityStrings n : Set (GameString n)) := by
    intro s hs t ht heq; rw [oddParityStrings, Finset.coe_filter] at hs ht
    exact hM_inj s t hs.2 ht.2 heq
  have hcard_image : imageSet.card = (oddParityStrings n).card := Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj
  have hcard_eq : imageSet.card = (evenParityStrings' n).card := by
    rw [hcard_image, card_evenParityStrings'_eq_oddParityStrings]
  have heq_sets : imageSet = evenParityStrings' n :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le himage_sub (le_of_eq hcard_eq.symm)
  have ht_mem : t ∈ evenParityStrings' n := by
    rw [evenParityStrings', evenParityStrings, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨ht_ne_init, Finset.mem_univ _, ht_even⟩
  rw [← heq_sets] at ht_mem; rw [Finset.mem_image] at ht_mem
  obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_eq⟩ := ht_mem
  rw [oddParityStrings, Finset.mem_filter] at hs_mem
  exact ⟨s, hs_mem.2, hs_eq⟩

lemma oddParity_one_iff (s : GameString 1) : s.oddParity ↔ s 0 = 1 := by
  unfold GameString.oddParity GameString.parity
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcase : (s 0).val = 0 ∨ (s 0).val = 1 ∨ (s 0).val = 2 := by omega
    rcases hcase with h0 | h1 | h2; simp [h0] at h; exact Fin.ext h1; simp [h2] at h
  · intro h; simp only [h]; rfl

def const2 : GameString 1 := fun _ => 2
def const1 : GameString 1 := fun _ => 1

lemma const2_evenParity : const2.evenParity := by
  unfold GameString.evenParity GameString.parity const2; simp

lemma const2_ne_initial : const2 ≠ initialState 1 := by
  intro h; have h0 := congrFun h 0; simp [initialState, const2] at h0

lemma isValidMove_const1_const2 : isValidMove const1 const2 := by
  unfold const1 const2; constructor
  · use 0; constructor; simp; intro j _; exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp j.isLt)
  · intro i _; left; rfl

/-- Base case: For n=1, the only odd string is (1), and M(1) = (2). -/
lemma exists_matching_base :
    ∃ M : GameString 1 → GameString 1,
      (∀ s, s.oddParity → isValidMove s (M s)) ∧
      (∀ s, s.oddParity → (M s).evenParity) ∧
      (∀ s, s.oddParity → M s ≠ initialState 1) ∧
      (∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M s = M t → s = t) := by
  use fun _ => const2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    have h1 : s 0 = 1 := (oddParity_one_iff s).mp hs
    have hs_eq : s = const1 := by
      ext i; have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp i.isLt); simp only [hi, h1, const1]
    rw [hs_eq]; exact isValidMove_const1_const2
  · intro _ _; exact const2_evenParity
  · intro _ _; exact const2_ne_initial
  · intro s t hs ht _
    have h1s : s 0 = 1 := (oddParity_one_iff s).mp hs
    have h1t : t 0 = 1 := (oddParity_one_iff t).mp ht
    ext i; have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp i.isLt); simp only [hi, h1s, h1t]

/-- For a string (1, tail) with tail even and tail ≠ init, there exists an odd preimage. -/
lemma exists_preimage_for_case3 {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (tail : GameString n) (htail_even : tail.evenParity) (htail_ne_init : tail ≠ initialState n) :
    ∃ pre, pre.oddParity ∧ M_n pre = tail :=
  exists_odd_preimage M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj tail htail_even htail_ne_init

/-- The matching function for the inductive step. -/
noncomputable def matchingSucc {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) : GameString (n + 1) :=
  let d := s.head
  let tail := s.tail
  if d = 0 then GameString.cons 0 (M_n tail)
  else if d = 2 then GameString.cons 2 (M_n tail)
  else
    if htail_init : tail = initialState n then GameString.cons 2 (initialState n)
    else
      if htail_even : tail.evenParity then
        GameString.cons 1 (Classical.choose (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
          tail htail_even htail_init))
      else s

lemma head_0_oddParity_iff' {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n+1)) (hhead : s.head = 0) :
    s.oddParity ↔ s.tail.oddParity := by rw [oddParity_of_head_tail]; simp [hhead]

lemma head_2_oddParity_iff' {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n+1)) (hhead : s.head = 2) :
    s.oddParity ↔ s.tail.oddParity := by rw [oddParity_of_head_tail]; simp [hhead]

lemma head_1_oddParity_iff' {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n+1)) (hhead : s.head = 1) :
    s.oddParity ↔ s.tail.evenParity := by rw [oddParity_of_head_tail]; simp [hhead]

lemma matchingSucc_valid {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_valid : ∀ s, s.oddParity → isValidMove s (M_n s))
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) :
    isValidMove s (matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s) := by
  rcases Fin3_trichotomy s.head with hhead0 | hhead1 | hhead2
  · have htail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := (head_0_oddParity_iff' s hhead0).mp hs
    unfold matchingSucc
    simp only [hhead0, ↓reduceIte]
    have hvalid_tail := hM_valid s.tail htail_odd
    have := isValidMove_tail_change 0 s.tail (M_n s.tail) hvalid_tail
    conv_lhs => rw [← GameString.cons_head_tail s, hhead0]
    exact this
  · have htail_even : s.tail.evenParity := (head_1_oddParity_iff' s hhead1).mp hs
    unfold matchingSucc
    simp only [hhead1]
    have hne01 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    have hne12 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
    simp only [hne01, ↓reduceIte, hne12]
    by_cases htail_init : s.tail = initialState n
    · simp only [htail_init, ↓reduceDIte]
      conv_lhs => rw [← GameString.cons_head_tail s, hhead1, htail_init]
      exact isValidMove_head_change 1 2 (initialState n) (Or.inl rfl) (by decide)
    · simp only [htail_init, ↓reduceDIte, htail_even, ↓reduceIte]
      let pre := Classical.choose (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s.tail htail_even htail_init)
      have hpre_spec := Classical.choose_spec (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s.tail htail_even htail_init)
      have hpre_odd : pre.oddParity := hpre_spec.1
      have hpre_eq : M_n pre = s.tail := hpre_spec.2
      have hvalid_pre := hM_valid pre hpre_odd
      rw [hpre_eq] at hvalid_pre
      have hvalid_sym := isValidMove_symm pre s.tail hvalid_pre
      have := isValidMove_tail_change 1 s.tail pre hvalid_sym
      conv_lhs => rw [← GameString.cons_head_tail s, hhead1]
      exact this
  · have htail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := (head_2_oddParity_iff' s hhead2).mp hs
    unfold matchingSucc
    simp only [hhead2]
    have hne20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    simp only [hne20, ↓reduceIte]
    have hvalid_tail := hM_valid s.tail htail_odd
    have := isValidMove_tail_change 2 s.tail (M_n s.tail) hvalid_tail
    conv_lhs => rw [← GameString.cons_head_tail s, hhead2]
    exact this

lemma matchingSucc_even {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) :
    (matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s).evenParity := by
  unfold matchingSucc
  simp only []
  rcases Fin3_trichotomy s.head with h0 | h1 | h2
  · simp only [h0, ↓reduceIte]
    have htail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := by
      rw [oddParity_of_head_tail] at hs
      simp [h0] at hs
      exact hs
    rw [GameString.evenParity_cons_iff]
    left
    exact ⟨rfl, hM_even s.tail htail_odd⟩
  · simp only [h1]
    have hne0 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    simp only [hne0, ↓reduceIte]
    have hne2 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
    simp only [hne2, ↓reduceIte]
    have htail_even : s.tail.evenParity := by
      rw [oddParity_of_head_tail] at hs
      simp [h1] at hs
      exact hs
    split_ifs with htail_init
    · rw [GameString.evenParity_cons_iff]
      left
      exact ⟨rfl, initialState_evenParity n⟩
    · have hpre_spec := Classical.choose_spec (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
        s.tail htail_even htail_init)
      rw [GameString.evenParity_cons_iff]
      right
      exact ⟨rfl, hpre_spec.1⟩
  · simp only [h2]
    have hne0 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    simp only [hne0, ↓reduceIte]
    have htail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := by
      rw [oddParity_of_head_tail] at hs
      simp [h2] at hs
      exact hs
    rw [GameString.evenParity_cons_iff]
    left
    exact ⟨rfl, hM_even s.tail htail_odd⟩

lemma cons_eq_cons_iff {n : ℕ} (d1 d2 : Fin 3) (t1 t2 : GameString n) :
    GameString.cons d1 t1 = GameString.cons d2 t2 ↔ d1 = d2 ∧ t1 = t2 := by
  simp only [GameString.cons]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · have := congrFun h 0
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero] at this
      exact this
    · funext i
      have := congrFun h i.succ
      simp only [Fin.cons_succ] at this
      exact this
  · intro ⟨hd, ht⟩
    rw [hd, ht]

lemma cons_ne_initialState_of_head_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (d : Fin 3) (t : GameString n) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    GameString.cons d t ≠ initialState (n + 1) := by
  rw [initialState_cons]
  intro h
  rw [cons_eq_cons_iff] at h
  exact hd h.1

lemma cons_ne_initialState_of_tail_ne_init {n : ℕ} (t : GameString n) (ht : t ≠ initialState n) :
    GameString.cons 0 t ≠ initialState (n + 1) := by
  rw [initialState_cons]
  intro h
  rw [cons_eq_cons_iff] at h
  exact ht h.2

lemma odd_head_0_tail_odd {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) (hhead : s.head = 0) :
    s.tail.oddParity := by
  have key := s.cons_head_tail
  rw [← key] at hs
  unfold GameString.oddParity at hs ⊢
  rw [GameString.parity_cons'] at hs
  simp [hhead] at hs
  exact hs

lemma odd_head_1_tail_even {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) (hhead : s.head = 1) :
    s.tail.evenParity := by
  have key := s.cons_head_tail
  rw [← key] at hs
  unfold GameString.oddParity at hs
  rw [GameString.parity_cons'] at hs
  unfold GameString.evenParity
  simp [hhead] at hs
  omega

lemma matchingSucc_not_init {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity) :
    matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s ≠ initialState (n + 1) := by
  unfold matchingSucc
  simp only
  rcases Fin3_trichotomy s.head with hd0 | hd1 | hd2
  · simp only [hd0, ite_true]
    have htail_odd : s.tail.oddParity := odd_head_0_tail_odd s hs hd0
    have hMtail_ne_init : M_n s.tail ≠ initialState n := hM_not_init s.tail htail_odd
    exact cons_ne_initialState_of_tail_ne_init (M_n s.tail) hMtail_ne_init
  · have h1_ne_0 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    have h1_ne_2 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
    simp only [hd1, h1_ne_0, ite_false, h1_ne_2]
    have htail_even : s.tail.evenParity := odd_head_1_tail_even s hs hd1
    split_ifs with htail_init
    · exact cons_ne_initialState_of_head_ne_zero 2 (initialState n) (by decide)
    · exact cons_ne_initialState_of_head_ne_zero 1 _ (by decide)
  · have h2_ne_0 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
    simp only [hd2, h2_ne_0, ite_false, ite_true]
    exact cons_ne_initialState_of_head_ne_zero 2 (M_n s.tail) (by decide)

lemma tail_odd_of_head_even {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity)
    (hhead : s.head = 0 ∨ s.head = 2) : s.tail.oddParity := by
  rw [oddParity_of_head_tail] at hs
  rcases hhead with h0 | h2
  · simp [h0] at hs; exact hs
  · simp [h2] at hs; exact hs

lemma tail_even_of_head_1 {n : ℕ} (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs : s.oddParity)
    (hhead : s.head = 1) : s.tail.evenParity := by
  rw [oddParity_of_head_tail] at hs
  simp [hhead] at hs; exact hs

lemma matchingSucc_head0 {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs0 : s.head = 0) :
    matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s = GameString.cons 0 (M_n s.tail) := by
  unfold matchingSucc; simp only [hs0, ↓reduceIte]

lemma matchingSucc_head2 {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs2 : s.head = 2) :
    matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s = GameString.cons 2 (M_n s.tail) := by
  unfold matchingSucc
  have h0 : ¬(2 : Fin 3) = 0 := by decide
  simp only [hs2, h0, ↓reduceIte]

lemma matchingSucc_head1_init {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs1 : s.head = 1) (hinit : s.tail = initialState n) :
    matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s = GameString.cons 2 (initialState n) := by
  unfold matchingSucc
  have h0 : ¬(1 : Fin 3) = 0 := by decide
  have h2 : ¬(1 : Fin 3) = 2 := by decide
  simp only [hs1, h0, h2, hinit, ↓reduceIte, dite_true]

lemma matchingSucc_head1_not_init {n : ℕ}
    (M_n : GameString n → GameString n)
    (hM_even : ∀ s, s.oddParity → (M_n s).evenParity)
    (hM_not_init : ∀ s, s.oddParity → M_n s ≠ initialState n)
    (hM_inj : ∀ s t, s.oddParity → t.oddParity → M_n s = M_n t → s = t)
    (s : GameString (n + 1)) (hs1 : s.head = 1) (hninit : s.tail ≠ initialState n)
    (htail_even : s.tail.evenParity) :
    matchingSucc M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj s =
      GameString.cons 1 (Classical.choose (exists_preimage_for_case3 M_n hM_even hM_not_init hM_inj
        s.tail htail_even hninit)) := by
  unfold matchingSucc
  have h0 : ¬(1 : Fin 3) = 0 := by decide
  have h2 : ¬(1 : Fin 3) = 2 := by decide
  simp only [hs1, h0, h2, ↓reduceIte, hninit, dite_false, htail_even, dite_true]

statement:
omit [Inhabited Tbase.IDMeta] in
/-- One-directional core for the `evalApp` value-true sync. Both runs share the
    same metadata `m` and comparand-application structure; they differ only by
    store (`env₁`/`env₂`) and by the fact that the left operands are renamed
    (`substFvars`) while the guard comparand `AL` is `substFvars`-related to `AR`.
    The directional transfers `h1`/`h2` (operand value-true sync, from the IH) and
    store-independence on closed inner terms (`hev`) close it.

    All four operand results, and the closed residuals they force, are the concrete
    `eval` calls; `A`gL/`A`gR are the guard comparands. -/
theorem app_dir
    (r1L r1R r2L r2R : LExpr Tbase.mono × LExpr.EvalResult)
    (AgL AgR : LExpr Tbase.mono) (v : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    -- operand value-true transfers (from the IH)
    (h1 : ∀ w, r1L = (w, .value true) → r1R = (w, .value true))
    (h2 : ∀ w, r2L = (w, .value true) → r2R = (w, .value true))
    -- value-true residuals are closed
    (hcl1 : ∀ w, r1L = (w, .value true) → LExpr.LExpr.getVars w = [])
    (hcl2 : ∀ w, r2L = (w, .value true) → LExpr.LExpr.getVars w = [])
    -- guard comparands agree once the compared body is closed (from the rename)
    (hguard : ∀ (X : LExpr Tbase.mono), LExpr.LExpr.getVars X = [] →
        LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL X = LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR X)
    -- inner eval agrees on closed terms (store independence)
    (evL evR : LExpr Tbase.mono → LExpr Tbase.mono × LExpr.EvalResult)
    (hev : ∀ e, LExpr.LExpr.getVars e = [] → evL e = evR e)
    (hL : (match r1L.fst with
        | .abs mAbs _ _ body =>
          let e' := LExpr.subst (fun mv => LExpr.replaceMetadata1
            (LExpr.mergeMetadataForSubst mAbs r2L.fst.metadata mv) r2L.fst) body
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true then (AgL, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evL e').fst, (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue))
        | _ =>
          let e' := LExpr.app AgL.metadata r1L.fst r2L.fst
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true then (AgL, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evL e').fst, (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue)))
      = (v, LExpr.EvalResult.value true))
    (hmeta : AgL.metadata = AgR.metadata) :
    (match r1R.fst with
        | .abs mAbs _ _ body =>
          let e' := LExpr.subst (fun mv => LExpr.replaceMetadata1
            (LExpr.mergeMetadataForSubst mAbs r2R.fst.metadata mv) r2R.fst) body
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR e' = true then (AgR, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evR e').fst, (evR e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1R.snd.isValueTrue && r2R.snd.isValueTrue))
        | _ =>
          let e' := LExpr.app AgR.metadata r1R.fst r2R.fst
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR e' = true then (AgR, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evR e').fst, (evR e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1R.snd.isValueTrue && r2R.snd.isValueTrue)))
      = (v, LExpr.EvalResult.value true)

omit [Inhabited Tbase.IDMeta] in
/-- One-directional core for the `evalApp` value-true sync. Both runs share the
    same metadata `m` and comparand-application structure; they differ only by
    store (`env₁`/`env₂`) and by the fact that the left operands are renamed
    (`substFvars`) while the guard comparand `AL` is `substFvars`-related to `AR`.
    The directional transfers `h1`/`h2` (operand value-true sync, from the IH) and
    store-independence on closed inner terms (`hev`) close it.

    All four operand results, and the closed residuals they force, are the concrete
    `eval` calls; `A`gL/`A`gR are the guard comparands. -/
theorem app_dir
    (r1L r1R r2L r2R : LExpr Tbase.mono × LExpr.EvalResult)
    (AgL AgR : LExpr Tbase.mono) (v : LExpr Tbase.mono)
    -- operand value-true transfers (from the IH)
    (h1 : ∀ w, r1L = (w, .value true) → r1R = (w, .value true))
    (h2 : ∀ w, r2L = (w, .value true) → r2R = (w, .value true))
    -- value-true residuals are closed
    (hcl1 : ∀ w, r1L = (w, .value true) → LExpr.LExpr.getVars w = [])
    (hcl2 : ∀ w, r2L = (w, .value true) → LExpr.LExpr.getVars w = [])
    -- guard comparands agree once the compared body is closed (from the rename)
    (hguard : ∀ (X : LExpr Tbase.mono), LExpr.LExpr.getVars X = [] →
        LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL X = LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR X)
    -- inner eval agrees on closed terms (store independence)
    (evL evR : LExpr Tbase.mono → LExpr Tbase.mono × LExpr.EvalResult)
    (hev : ∀ e, LExpr.LExpr.getVars e = [] → evL e = evR e)
    (hL : (match r1L.fst with
        | .abs mAbs _ _ body =>
          let e' := LExpr.subst (fun mv => LExpr.replaceMetadata1
            (LExpr.mergeMetadataForSubst mAbs r2L.fst.metadata mv) r2L.fst) body
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true then (AgL, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evL e').fst, (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue))
        | _ =>
          let e' := LExpr.app AgL.metadata r1L.fst r2L.fst
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true then (AgL, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evL e').fst, (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue)))
      = (v, LExpr.EvalResult.value true))
    (hmeta : AgL.metadata = AgR.metadata) :
    (match r1R.fst with
        | .abs mAbs _ _ body =>
          let e' := LExpr.subst (fun mv => LExpr.replaceMetadata1
            (LExpr.mergeMetadataForSubst mAbs r2R.fst.metadata mv) r2R.fst) body
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR e' = true then (AgR, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evR e').fst, (evR e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1R.snd.isValueTrue && r2R.snd.isValueTrue))
        | _ =>
          let e' := LExpr.app AgR.metadata r1R.fst r2R.fst
          if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgR e' = true then (AgR, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
          else ((evR e').fst, (evR e').snd.combineValueFlag
            (r1R.snd.isValueTrue && r2R.snd.isValueTrue)))
      = (v, LExpr.EvalResult.value true) := by
  -- A closer that, from a value-true else-branch, extracts guard-false, both
  -- operands value-true, and the inner eval value-true.
  have closer : ∀ (e' : LExpr Tbase.mono)
      (hbr : (if LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true then (AgL, LExpr.EvalResult.nonvalue)
              else ((evL e').fst, (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag
                (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue)))
            = (v, LExpr.EvalResult.value true)),
      LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = false ∧ r1L.snd = .value true ∧ r2L.snd = .value true ∧
      (evL e').fst = v ∧ (evL e').snd = .value true := by
    intro e' hbr
    by_cases hg : LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = true
    · rw [if_pos hg] at hbr
      exfalso; have := congrArg Prod.snd hbr
      exact absurd this (by simp)
    · have hgf : LExpr.eqModuloMeta AgL e' = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hg
      rw [if_neg hg] at hbr
      have hfst : (evL e').fst = v := congrArg Prod.fst hbr
      have hsnd : (evL e').snd.combineValueFlag (r1L.snd.isValueTrue && r2L.snd.isValueTrue)
          = .value true := congrArg Prod.snd hbr
      obtain ⟨hinner, hsub⟩ := (andValue_eq_valueTrue_iff _ _).mp hsnd
      have hs1 : r1L.snd.isValueTrue = true := by
        rcases hbb : r1L.snd.isValueTrue with _ | _ <;> simp [hbb] at hsub ⊢
      have hs2 : r2L.snd.isValueTrue = true := by
        rcases hbb : r2L.snd.isValueTrue with _ | _ <;> simp [hbb] at hsub ⊢
      exact ⟨hgf, (isValueTrue_eq_true_iff _).mp hs1, (isValueTrue_eq_true_iff _).mp hs2,
        hfst, hinner⟩
  -- The residuals `r1L.fst`, `r2L.fst` at value-true are closed.
  have r2Lnil : r2L.snd = .value true → LExpr.LExpr.getVars r2L.fst = [] := by
    intro h; apply hcl2; rw [← h, Prod.eta]
  split at hL
  · -- left discriminant `r1L.fst = .abs ...`
    rename_i mAbs prettyName ty body hLabs
    obtain ⟨hgf, hs1, hs2, hfst, hinner⟩ := closer _ hL
    have hr1R : r1R = (LExpr.abs mAbs prettyName ty body, .value true) := by
      apply h1; rw [← hLabs, ← hs1, Prod.eta]
    have hr2R : r2R = (r2L.fst, .value true) := by apply h2; rw [← hs2, Prod.eta]
    have hw1nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars (LExpr.abs mAbs prettyName ty body) = [] := by
      apply hcl1; rw [← hLabs, ← hs1, Prod.eta]
    have hw2nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars r2L.fst = [] := r2Lnil hs2
    obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ : ∃ e', e' = LExpr.subst (fun mv => LExpr.replaceMetadata1
      (LExpr.mergeMetadataForSubst mAbs r2L.fst.metadata mv) r2L.fst) body := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← he'] at hgf hinner hfst
    have he'nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars e' = [] := by
      rw [he']
      apply List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro y hy
      rcases getVars_substK_mem 0 _ body y hy with hb | ⟨mv, hmv⟩
      · rw [show LExpr.LExpr.getVars body = LExpr.LExpr.getVars
            (LExpr.abs mAbs prettyName ty body) from rfl, hw1nil] at hb; simp at hb
      · rw [getVars_replaceMetadata1, hw2nil] at hmv; simp at hmv
    rw [hr1R, hr2R]
    simp only
    rw [← he']
    exact app_reduct_transfer AgL AgR v e' he'nil hgf hguard evL evR hev hfst hinner
  · -- left discriminant not `.abs`
    rename_i hnotabs
    obtain ⟨hgf, hs1, hs2, hfst, hinner⟩ := closer _ hL
    have hr1R : r1R = (r1L.fst, .value true) := by apply h1; rw [← hs1, Prod.eta]
    have hr2R : r2R = (r2L.fst, .value true) := by apply h2; rw [← hs2, Prod.eta]
    have hw1nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars r1L.fst = [] := by apply hcl1; rw [← hs1, Prod.eta]
    have hw2nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars r2L.fst = [] := r2Lnil hs2
    obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ : ∃ e', e' = LExpr.app AgL.metadata r1L.fst r2L.fst := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← he'] at hgf hinner hfst
    have he'nil : LExpr.LExpr.getVars e' = [] := by
      rw [he']; simp only [LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_eq_nil_iff]; exact ⟨hw1nil, hw2nil⟩
    rw [hr1R, hr2R]
    -- The right discriminant `r1L.fst` is also not `.abs`, so the default arm fires.
    split
    · rename_i mAbs' pn' ty' body' habs'
      exact absurd habs' (hnotabs mAbs' pn' ty' body')
    · have he'R : LExpr.app AgR.metadata r1L.fst r2L.fst = e' := by rw [he', hmeta]
      rw [he'R]
      exact app_reduct_transfer AgL AgR v e' he'nil hgf hguard evL evR hev hfst hinner

name: ProximityGap.card_RS_goodCoeffs_gt_of_prob_gt_n_div_q
statement:
omit [Nonempty ι] in
theorem card_RS_goodCoeffs_gt_of_prob_gt_n_div_q
    {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0} (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι)
    (hprob :
      Pr_{ let z ← $ᵖ F}[δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, ReedSolomon.code domain deg) ≤ δ]
        > (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) :
    (RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ).card > Fintype.card ι
src:
omit [Nonempty ι] in
theorem card_RS_goodCoeffs_gt_of_prob_gt_n_div_q
    {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0} (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι)
    (hprob :
      Pr_{ let z ← $ᵖ F}[δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, ReedSolomon.code domain deg) ≤ δ]
        > (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) :
    (RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ).card > Fintype.card ι := by
  classical
  -- predicate defining the good coefficients
  let P : F → Prop := fun z : F =>
    δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, ReedSolomon.code domain deg) ≤ δ
  -- uniform probability equals (card of filter) / (card of the field)
  have hPr :
      Pr_{ let z ← $ᵖ F }[ P z ] =
        ((Finset.filter (α := F) P Finset.univ).card : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) := by
    classical
    -- Expand the probability mass at `True`
    simp only [Bind.bind, PMF.bind, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, pure, PMF.pure_apply, eq_iff_iff,
      mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ENNReal.coe_natCast]
    simp only [DFunLike.coe, true_iff]
    -- Reduce the infinite sum to the finite support
    rw [
      tsum_eq_sum (α := ENNReal) (β := F)
        (f := fun a => if P a then (↑(Fintype.card F))⁻¹ else 0)
        (s := Finset.filter P Finset.univ)
        (hf := fun b => by
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          intro hb
          simp only [hb, if_false])
    ]
    -- Evaluate the resulting finite sum
    rw [Finset.sum_ite]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_const]
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul']
    rw [mul_comm]
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    -- Filtering twice is the same as filtering once
    have h_card_eq : {x ∈ filter P univ | P x} = filter P univ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      rw [and_self_iff]
    rw [h_card_eq]
  -- restate the hypothesis using `P`
  have hprobP :
      Pr_{ let z ← $ᵖ F }[ P z ] > (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) := by
    simpa [P] using hprob
  -- rewrite the probability lower bound as a ratio comparison
  have hprobQ := hprobP
  rw [hPr] at hprobQ
  -- switch to `<` form
  have hlt :
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal)
        <
          (((Finset.filter (α := F) P Finset.univ).card : ℝ≥0) /
            (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) :=
    (gt_iff_lt).1 hprobQ
  have hq0 : (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by
    simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]
  have hqtop : (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top (Fintype.card F)
  have hcard_cast :
      (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal) <
        ((Finset.filter (α := F) P Finset.univ).card : ENNReal) := by
    -- rewrite both sides of `hlt` as ENNReal divisions and cancel
    have hlt' :
        (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal)
          < ((Finset.filter (α := F) P Finset.univ).card : ENNReal) /
              (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
      have hq0' : (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0 := by
        simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]
      simpa [ENNReal.coe_div (r := (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) hq0', ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hlt
    exact (ENNReal.div_lt_div_iff_left (hc₀ := hq0) (hc := hqtop)).1 hlt'
  have hcard_nat : Fintype.card ι < (Finset.filter (α := F) P Finset.univ).card := by
    exact Nat.cast_lt.mp hcard_cast
  -- identify the filtered finset with `RS_goodCoeffs`
  simpa [RS_goodCoeffs, P, gt_iff_lt] using hcard_nat

name: GenLimit.FiniteWitness.normalized_locks
statement:
/-- A single target-free bounded search locks on every successful infinite target. -/
theorem normalized_locks [Encodable α] [DecidableEq α]
    (F : List α → α) (hF : Fresh F) {L : Set α}
    (hL : L.Infinite) (hvalid : EventuallyValid F L) : Locks (normalized F) L
src:
/-- A single target-free bounded search locks on every successful infinite target. -/
theorem normalized_locks [Encodable α] [DecidableEq α]
    (F : List α → α) (hF : Fresh F) {L : Set α}
    (hL : L.Infinite) (hvalid : EventuallyValid F L) : Locks (normalized F) L := by
  classical
  let hexstop := trueRun_stops hvalid
  let m := Nat.find hexstop
  have hstop : ¬∃ q, BadExtension F L (trueRun F L m) m q := Nat.find_spec hexstop
  have hbefore : ∀ k < m, ∃ q, BadExtension F L (trueRun F L k) k q := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hbad
    exact Nat.find_min hexstop hk hbad
  obtain ⟨T, hTL, hcpT, hcontentT, hsizeT, hconfT⟩ := exists_confirming_witness F hL m
  refine ⟨T, hTL, ?_⟩
  intro S hTS hSL
  let n := S.card
  have hsize : (trueRun F L m).length + m + 1 ≤ n :=
    hsizeT.trans (Finset.card_le_card hTS)
  have hmn : m + 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hlength : (trueRun F L m).length ≤ n := by omega
  have hseen : checkpoint L (m + 1) ⊆ S := hcpT.trans hTS
  have hcontents : (trueRun F L m).toFinset ⊆ S := hcontentT.trans hTS
  have hconfirm : ∀ k < m, ∀ q : List α,
      Encodable.encode q < Encodable.encode (trueRun F L (k + 1)) →
      F q ∈ L → F q ∈ S := by
    intro k hk q hq hqL
    exact hTS (hconfT k hk q hq hqL)
  have hmatches := sampleRun_matches_true hSL hseen hcontents hlength hbefore hconfirm
  have hm : sampleRun F S n m = trueRun F L m := hmatches m le_rfl
  -- Appending the entire actual sample forces a step past the last genuine error.
  let q := trueRun F L m ++ S.toList
  have hqcontent : q.toFinset = S := by
    simp [q, Finset.union_eq_right.mpr hcontents]
  have hqfresh : F q ∉ S := by
    rw [← hqcontent, List.mem_toFinset]
    exact hF q
  have hcand : Candidate F S n (sampleRun F S n m) m q := by
    rw [hm]
    refine ⟨List.prefix_append _ _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hqfresh⟩
    · simp only [q, List.length_append, Finset.length_toList]
      dsimp [n] at hmn
      omega
    · rw [hqcontent]
    · simp only [q, List.length_append, Finset.length_toList]
      dsimp [n] at hlength ⊢
      omega
    · rw [hqcontent]
      intro x hx
      exact (mem_checkpoint.mp hx).2
  have hex : ∃ q, Candidate F S n (sampleRun F S n m) m q := ⟨q, hcand⟩
  have hnext := sampleRun_next hex
  have hp := history_prefix_mono (sampleRun_prefix F S n) hmn
  have hprefix : trueRun F L m <+: sampleRun F S n n := by
    rw [← hm]
    exact hnext.1.trans hp
  have hstrict : (trueRun F L m).length < (sampleRun F S n n).length := by
    have hs := hnext.2.1
    rw [hm] at hs
    exact hs.trans_le hp.length_le
  have hlegal : (↑(sampleRun F S n n).toFinset : Set α) ⊆ L := by
    intro x hx
    exact hSL (sampleRun_content F S n n hx)
  have hcheckpoint : checkpoint L (m + 1) ⊆ (sampleRun F S n n).toFinset := by
    have hc := hnext.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [checkpoint_agrees hSL hseen le_rfl] at hc
    exact hc.trans (content_mono hp)
  have hcorrect : F (sampleRun F S n n) ∈ L := by
    by_contra hbad
    exact hstop ⟨_, hprefix, hstrict, hlegal, hcheckpoint, hbad⟩
  have hfresh : F (sampleRun F S n n) ∉ S :=
    sampleRun_preserves_fresh hnext.2.2.2.2.2 hmn
  exact ⟨hcorrect, hfresh⟩

theorem upper_bound_of_lower_set (a' : ℝ)

theorem upper_bound_of_lower_set (a' : ℝ)
    (ha' : a' ∈ {a : ℝ | ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 π, a * x * (π - x) ≤ sin x}) :
    a' ≤ 1 / π := by
  have h_main : a' ≤ 1 / π := by
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : a' > 1 / π := by linarith
    have h₂ : a' > 0 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) / π > 0 := by positivity
      linarith
    have h₃ : 0 < π - 1 / a' := by
      have h₄ : 1 / a' < π := by
        have h₁₀ : 1 / a' < π := by
          calc
            1 / a' < 1 / (1 / π) := by
              apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt
              · positivity
              · linarith
            _ = π := by field_simp
        exact h₁₀
      linarith
    have h₅ : (π - 1 / a') / 2 < π / 2 := by
      have h₇ : 0 < 1 / a' := by
        have : 0 < a' := h₂
        positivity
      linarith
    have h₆ : (π - 1 / a') / 2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 π := by
      constructor
      ·
        linarith
      ·
        linarith
    have h₇ : a' * ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2) > ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := by
      have h₁₀ : π - (π - 1 / a') / 2 = (π + 1 / a') / 2 := by
        ring
      have h₁₁ : a' * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2) = (a' * π + 1) / 2 := by
        rw [h₁₀]
        field_simp
        ring
      have h₁₂ : (a' * π + 1) / 2 > 1 := by
        have h₁₃ : a' * π > 1 := by
          have h₁₅ : 0 < π := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
          have h₁₆ : a' * π > 1 := by
            calc
              a' * π > (1 / π) * π := by gcongr
              _ = 1 := by field_simp [h₁₅.ne']
          exact h₁₆
        linarith
      calc
        a' * ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2) = ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (a' * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2)) := by ring
        _ = ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * ((a' * π + 1) / 2) := by rw [h₁₁]
        _ > ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * 1 := by
          nlinarith
        _ = ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := by ring
    have h₈ : a' * ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2) ≤ Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := by
      have h₉ : a' * ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (π - (π - 1 / a') / 2) ≤ Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := by
        have h₁₀ : ((π - 1 / a') / 2) ∈ Set.Icc 0 π := h₆
        have h₁₁ : a' * ((π - 1 / a') / 2) * (π - ((π - 1 / a') / 2)) ≤ Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := ha' (((π - 1 / a') / 2)) h₁₀
        exact h₁₁
      exact h₉
    have h₉ : Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) < ((π - 1 / a') / 2) := by
      have h₁₂ : Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) < (π - 1 / a') / 2 := by
        have h₁₃ : Real.sin ((π - 1 / a') / 2) < (π - 1 / a') / 2 := by
          apply Real.sin_lt
          linarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_div_two_pos]
        exact h₁₃
      exact h₁₂
    linarith

import Mathlib

open Real

open Real Set

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2025_a2_solution : ℝ × ℝ := (1 / π, 4 / π ^ 2)

theorem lower_bound_of_upper_set (b' : ℝ)
    (hb' : b' ∈ {b : ℝ | ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 π, sin x ≤ b * x * (π - x)}) :
    4 / π ^ 2 ≤ b' := by
  have h_pi_div_two_in_Icc : (Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi := by
    constructor
    ·
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    ·
      linarith [Real.pi_pos, Real.pi_gt_three]

  have h_sin_pi_div_two : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) = 1 := by
    norm_num [Real.sin_pi_div_two]

  have h_main_ineq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b' * (Real.pi / 2) * (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2) := by
    have h₁ : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) ≤ b' * (Real.pi / 2) * (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2) := by
      have h₂ : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi, Real.sin x ≤ b' * x * (Real.pi - x) := hb'
      have h₃ : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2) ≤ b' * (Real.pi / 2) * (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2) :=
        h₂ (Real.pi / 2) h_pi_div_two_in_Icc
      exact h₃
    linarith

  have h_simplify : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b' * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4) := by
    have h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b' * (Real.pi / 2) * (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2) := h_main_ineq
    have h₂ : b' * (Real.pi / 2) * (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2) = b' * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4) := by
      have h₃ : (Real.pi - Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) = Real.pi / 2 := by
        ring
      rw [h₃]
      ring_nf
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    linarith

  have h_final : 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 ≤ b' := by
    have h₄ : 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 ≤ b' := by
      calc
        4 / Real.pi ^ 2 = (4 : ℝ) / Real.pi ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ b' := by
          have h₈ : (4 : ℝ) / Real.pi ^ 2 ≤ b' := by
            calc
              (4 : ℝ) / Real.pi ^ 2 = 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 := by ring
              _ = 1 / (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4) := by
                field_simp
              _ ≤ b' := by
                have h₉ : 0 < Real.pi ^ 2 / 4 := by positivity
                calc
                  1 / (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4) ≤ (b' * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4)) / (Real.pi ^ 2 / 4) := by
                    gcongr
                  _ = b' := by
                    field_simp [h₉.ne']
          exact h₈
    exact h₄

  exact h_final

name: Lambda.substK_denote
statement:
/-- Generalized substitution lemma: `substK k` at depth `k` in a context
    `Δ₁ ++ [aty]` with `|Δ₁| = k`. The substituted value `v` must be locally
    closed and well-typed in the empty context. -/
theorem substK_denote
    {body : LExpr T.mono} {s : T.mono.base.Metadata → LExpr T.mono}
    {aty τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ : List LMonoTy}
    {val : TyDenote tcInterp vt aty}
    (bvarVal₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (h_body : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ [aty]) body τ)
    (h_v : ∀ m, LExpr.HasTypeA [] (s m) aty)
    (h_subst : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ₁ (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s body) τ)
    (h_lc : ∀ m, LExpr.lcAt 0 (s m) = true)
    (h_denote_eq : ∀ m, LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil (s m) aty (h_v m) = val)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal₁
        (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s body) τ h_subst =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt
        (HList.append bvarVal₁ (.cons val .nil))
        body τ h_body
src:
/-- Generalized substitution lemma: `substK k` at depth `k` in a context
    `Δ₁ ++ [aty]` with `|Δ₁| = k`. The substituted value `v` must be locally
    closed and well-typed in the empty context. -/
theorem substK_denote
    {body : LExpr T.mono} {s : T.mono.base.Metadata → LExpr T.mono}
    {aty τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ : List LMonoTy}
    {val : TyDenote tcInterp vt aty}
    (bvarVal₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (h_body : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ [aty]) body τ)
    (h_v : ∀ m, LExpr.HasTypeA [] (s m) aty)
    (h_subst : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ₁ (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s body) τ)
    (h_lc : ∀ m, LExpr.lcAt 0 (s m) = true)
    (h_denote_eq : ∀ m, LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil (s m) aty (h_v m) = val)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal₁
        (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s body) τ h_subst =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt
        (HList.append bvarVal₁ (.cons val .nil))
        body τ h_body := by
  induction body generalizing Δ₁ τ with
  | const m c =>
    have h1 := HasTypeA.const_inv h_subst
    have h2 := HasTypeA.const_inv h_body
    subst h1
    exact (Denotes_denote (Denotes.const bvarVal₁)).symm.trans
          (Denotes_denote (Denotes.const _))
  | op m o ty =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_body) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some ty =>
      have h1 := HasTypeA.op_inv h_subst; subst h1
      exact (Denotes_denote (Denotes.op bvarVal₁)).symm.trans
            (Denotes_denote (Denotes.op _))
  | fvar m x ty =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_body) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some ty =>
      have h1 := HasTypeA.fvar_inv h_subst; subst h1
      exact (Denotes_denote (Denotes.fvar bvarVal₁)).symm.trans
            (Denotes_denote (Denotes.fvar _))
  | bvar m i =>
    simp only [LExpr.substK]
    split
    · rename_i h_eq
      have h_ieq : i = Δ₁.length := by grind
      subst h_ieq
      simp [LExpr.substK] at h_subst
      have h_lookup := HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_body
      simp at h_lookup; subst h_lookup
      rw [denote_irrel_of_lcAt tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (h_lc m) h_subst (h_v m) bvarVal₁ .nil]
      rw [h_denote_eq m]
      rw [denote_bvar tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt _ h_body]
      exact (HList.get_append_cons_self bvarVal₁
        val .nil
        (HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_body)).symm
    · rename_i h_ne
      simp [LExpr.substK, h_ne] at h_subst
      rw [denote_bvar tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal₁ h_subst,
          denote_bvar tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt _ h_body]
      exact (HList.get_append_left bvarVal₁ _ i (HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_body) (HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_subst)).symm
  | app m fn arg ih_fn ih_arg =>
    simp only [LExpr.substK] at h_subst ⊢
    let ⟨aty_b, h_fn_b, h_arg_b⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h_body
    let ⟨aty_s, h_fn_s, h_arg_s⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h_subst
    have h_aty : aty_s = aty_b := by
      have h1 := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_fn_s
      rw [substK_typeCheck h_v] at h1
      have h2 := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_fn_b
      rw [h1] at h2; cases h2; rfl
    subst h_aty
    rw [denote_app bvarVal₁ h_fn_s h_arg_s h_subst,
        denote_app _ h_fn_b h_arg_b h_body,
        ih_fn bvarVal₁ h_fn_b h_fn_s,
        ih_arg bvarVal₁ h_arg_b h_arg_s]
  | abs m name ty sub_body ih =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_body) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some aty' =>
      simp only [LExpr.substK] at h_subst ⊢
      let ⟨rty_b, h_eq_b, h_body_b⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h_body
      let ⟨rty_s, h_eq_s, h_body_s⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h_subst
      subst h_eq_b
      cases h_eq_s
      rw [denote_abs bvarVal₁ h_body_s h_subst,
          denote_abs _ h_body_b h_body]
      funext x
      exact ih (.cons x bvarVal₁) h_body_b h_body_s
  | ite m c t e ih_c ih_t ih_e =>
    simp only [LExpr.substK] at h_subst ⊢
    let ⟨h_c_b, h_t_b, h_e_b⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h_body
    let ⟨h_c_s, h_t_s, h_e_s⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h_subst
    rw [denote_ite bvarVal₁ h_c_s h_t_s h_e_s h_subst,
        denote_ite _ h_c_b h_t_b h_e_b h_body,
        ih_c bvarVal₁ h_c_b h_c_s,
        ih_t bvarVal₁ h_t_b h_t_s,
        ih_e bvarVal₁ h_e_b h_e_s]
  | eq m e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [LExpr.substK] at h_subst ⊢
    let ⟨ty_b, h_τ_b, h_1_b, h_2_b⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h_body
    let ⟨ty_s, h_τ_s, h_1_s, h_2_s⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h_subst
    subst h_τ_b
    have h_ty : ty_s = ty_b := by
      have h1 := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_1_s
      rw [substK_typeCheck h_v] at h1
      have h2 := LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_1_b
      rw [h1] at h2; cases h2; rfl
    subst h_ty
    by_cases heq : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal₁
        (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s e1) ty_s h_1_s =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal₁
        (LExpr.substK Δ₁.length s e2) ty_s h_2_s
    · rw [denote_eq_true bvarVal₁ h_1_s h_2_s h_subst heq,
          denote_eq_true _ h_1_b h_2_b h_body
            (by rw [← ih1 bvarVal₁ h_1_b h_1_s, ← ih2 bvarVal₁ h_2_b h_2_s]; exact heq)]
    · rw [denote_eq_false bvarVal₁ h_1_s h_2_s h_subst heq,
          denote_eq_false _ h_1_b h_2_b h_body
            (by rw [← ih1 bvarVal₁ h_1_b h_1_s, ← ih2 bvarVal₁ h_2_b h_2_s]; exact heq)]
  | quant m qk name qty tr sub_body ih_tr ih_body =>
    cases qty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h_body) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some qty' =>
      simp only [LExpr.substK] at h_subst ⊢
      let ⟨_, h_τ_b, h_tr_b, h_body_b⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h_body
      let ⟨_, h_τ_s, h_tr_s, h_body_s⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h_subst
      subst h_τ_b
      exact denote_quant_congr h_body_s h_body_b h_subst h_body fun x => by
        specialize ih_body (.cons x bvarVal₁) h_body_b h_body_s
        simp at ih_body
        exact ih_body

/-- When `dH = d` the top coefficient `P_{d-1} / W` is a constant, so the top term contributes no
`Z`-degree. -/
theorem xiPreTop_coeff_natDegree_zero_of_H_natDegree_eq_R_natDegree (x₀ : F) (hH : 0 < H.natDegree)
    (hHyp : Hypotheses x₀ R H)
    (hRdeg : 2 ≤ R.natDegree) (heq : H.natDegree = R.natDegree) :
    ((Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R.derivative).coeff (R.natDegree - 1) /
      H.leadingCoeff).natDegree = 0 := by
  classical
  set P : F[X][Y] := Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R with hP_def
  rcases hHyp.dvd_evalX with ⟨Q, hQ⟩
  have hP_ne : P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hP_def]
    exact evalX_ne_zero_of_hypotheses hHyp
  have hQ_ne : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hP_ne
    rw [hP_def, hQ, h0, mul_zero]
  have hH_ne : H ≠ 0 := Polynomial.ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hH
  have hdegP : P.natDegree ≤ R.natDegree := by
    rw [hP_def]
    exact evalX_natDegree_le (Polynomial.C x₀) R
  have hQdeg : Q.natDegree = 0 := by
    have hmuldeg : (H * Q).natDegree = H.natDegree + Q.natDegree := by
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_mul hH_ne hQ_ne
    have hPdeg_eq : P.natDegree = (H * Q).natDegree := by
      rw [hP_def, hQ]
    omega
  let q : F[X] := Q.coeff 0
  have hQ_C : Q = Polynomial.C q := by
    exact Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero (p := Q) (by omega)
  have hsepHQ : (H * Polynomial.C q).Separable := by
    rw [← hQ_C]
    rw [← hQ, ← hP_def]
    exact hHyp.separable_evalX
  have hq_unit : IsUnit q := by
    rw [Polynomial.separable_def'] at hsepHQ
    rcases hsepHQ with ⟨A, B, hAB⟩
    have hderiv : (H * Polynomial.C q).derivative = H.derivative * Polynomial.C q := by
      simp [Polynomial.derivative_mul]
    have hfactor : (A * H + B * H.derivative) * Polynomial.C q = (1 : F[X][Y]) := by
      calc
        (A * H + B * H.derivative) * Polynomial.C q
            = A * (H * Polynomial.C q) + B * (H.derivative * Polynomial.C q) := by ring
        _ = A * (H * Polynomial.C q) + B * (H * Polynomial.C q).derivative := by rw [hderiv]
        _ = 1 := hAB
    have hCunit : IsUnit (Polynomial.C q : F[X][Y]) := by
      exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (A * H + B * H.derivative) (by simpa [mul_comm] using hfactor)
    exact (Polynomial.isUnit_C.mp hCunit)
  have hsucc : R.natDegree - 1 + 1 = R.natDegree := by omega
  have hPtop : (Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R).coeff R.natDegree = H.leadingCoeff * q := by
    rw [hQ, hQ_C]
    rw [← heq]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
  have htop_coeff :
      (Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R.derivative).coeff (R.natDegree - 1) =
        H.leadingCoeff * (q * (R.natDegree : F[X])) := by
    rw [derivative_evalX_coeff, hsucc, hPtop]
    ring
  have hW_ne : H.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH_ne
  have hdiv : H.leadingCoeff ∣
      (Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R.derivative).coeff (R.natDegree - 1) :=
    leadingCoeff_dvd_evalX_derivative_coeff_pred hHyp

      (Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R.derivative).coeff (R.natDegree - 1) /
          H.leadingCoeff = q * (R.natDegree : F[X]) := by
    exact (EuclideanDomain.div_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_dvd
      ((Bivariate.evalX (Polynomial.C x₀) R.derivative).coeff (R.natDegree - 1))
      H.leadingCoeff (q * (R.natDegree : F[X])) hW_ne hdiv).2 htop_coeff

    rw [← Polynomial.C_eq_natCast, Polynomial.natDegree_C]

    calc
      (q * (R.natDegree : F[X])).natDegree ≤ q.natDegree + ((R.natDegree : F[X]).natDegree) :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      _ = 0 := by rw [hqdeg0, hndeg0, Nat.zero_add]
  omega

    Tendsto

theorem tendsto_logb_ambientDimension {a b : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b < a) (ha : a ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ =>
        Real.logb 2
          (ambientDimension n
            (transverseDegree b n) (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (MetricCodes.binaryEntropy a)) := by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_lt hb hba
  have ha1 : a < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt ha (by norm_num)
  have hchoose := tendsto_logb_choose_longitudinal ha0 ha1
  have hpoly := tendsto_logb_succ_div
  have hupperlim :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          Real.logb 2 ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) +
            Real.logb 2
              (n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (nhds (MetricCodes.binaryEntropy a)) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, zero_add] using hpoly.add hchoose
  have hfit := eventually_transverse_add_le_longitudinal hb hba 0
  have hlower :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        Real.logb 2
            (n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤
          Real.logb 2
            (ambientDimension n (transverseDegree b n)
              (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hfit, eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with n hkn hn
    have hkL : transverseDegree b n ≤ longitudinalDegree a n := by omega
    have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hnreal).2
    apply Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos
        (longitudinalDegree_le_dimension ha1.le n)
    · exact_mod_cast choose_le_ambientDimension n
        (transverseDegree b n) (longitudinalDegree a n) hkL
  have hupper :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        Real.logb 2
            (ambientDimension n (transverseDegree b n)
              (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤
          Real.logb 2 ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) +
            Real.logb 2
              (n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hfit, eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with n hkn hn
    have hkL : transverseDegree b n ≤ longitudinalDegree a n := by omega
    have hhalf := longitudinalDegree_le_half ha n
    have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hchoosepos :
        0 < (n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos
        (longitudinalDegree_le_dimension ha1.le n)
    have hambientpos :
        0 < (ambientDimension n (transverseDegree b n)
          (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) := by
      have hle := choose_le_ambientDimension n
        (transverseDegree b n) (longitudinalDegree a n) hkL
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hchoosepos (by exact_mod_cast hle)
    calc
      Real.logb 2
          (ambientDimension n (transverseDegree b n)
            (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤
        Real.logb 2
          (((n + 1) * n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℕ) : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) := by
          apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hnreal).2
          apply Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
            hambientpos
          exact_mod_cast ambientDimension_le_mul_choose n
            (transverseDegree b n) (longitudinalDegree a n) hkL hhalf
      _ = Real.logb 2 ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) +
            Real.logb 2
              (n.choose (longitudinalDegree a n) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := by
          push_cast
          rw [Real.logb_mul (by positivity) hchoosepos.ne']
          ring
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
    hchoose hupperlim hlower hupper

    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_one.mp hbcard

    grind
  case W1 =>
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, ⟨⟨⟨ha, hacard⟩, ⟨hb, hbcard⟩⟩, hsum⟩, rfl⟩, _⟩ := hx

  case W4 =>

  case K2 =>

statement:
theorem iterated_squaring_bound (g : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (_hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ m n : ℕ, M ≤ m → m < n → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g n : ℝ)
src:
theorem iterated_squaring_bound (g : ℕ → ℕ) (M : ℕ)
    (hM_pos : 0 < M)
    (_hgM_ge_2 : 2 ≤ g M)
    (hsquare : ∀ n : ℕ, M ≤ n → 0 < n → (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    ∀ m n : ℕ, M ≤ m → m < n → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g n : ℝ) := by
  have h_main : ∀ (m : ℕ), M ≤ m → ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) < (g (m + k) : ℝ) := by
    intro m hm k hk
    have h₁ : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) < (g (m + k) : ℝ) := by
      intro k hk
      induction' hk with k _ IH
      ·
        have h₂ : M ≤ m := hm
        have h₃ : 0 < m := by
          omega
        have h₄ : (g m : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
          have h₅ : M ≤ m := hm
          have h₆ : 0 < m := by omega
          have h₇ : (g m : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
            exact hsquare m h₅ h₆
          exact h₇
        norm_num at h₄ ⊢
        try simp_all [pow_succ]
      ·
        have h₂ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) < (g (m + (k + 1)) : ℝ) := by
          have h₃ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) = ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 := by
            calc
              (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) = (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k * 2) := by
                rw [show 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k * 2 by
                  ring_nf]
              _ = ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 := by
                rw [show (2 ^ k * 2 : ℕ) = 2 ^ k + 2 ^ k by ring]
                rw [pow_add]
                ring_nf
          rw [h₃]
          have h₄ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            have h₅ : 0 ≤ (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k) := by positivity
            have h₈ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith
            exact h₈
          have h₅ : (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := by
            have h₆ : M ≤ (m + k : ℕ) := by
              omega
            have h₇ : 0 < (m + k : ℕ) := by
              omega
            have h₈ : (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g ((m + k) + 1) : ℝ) := by
              exact hsquare (m + k) h₆ (by exact_mod_cast h₇)
            simpa [add_assoc] using h₈
          have h₆ : ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := by
            calc
              ((g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2 < (g (m + k) : ℝ) ^ 2 := h₄
              _ < (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) := h₅
          have h₇ : (g (m + k + 1) : ℝ) = (g (m + (k + 1)) : ℝ) := by
            ring_nf
          rw [h₇] at h₆
          exact h₆
        exact h₂
    exact h₁ k hk
  have h_final : ∀ m n : ℕ, M ≤ m → m < n → (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g n : ℝ) := by
    intro m n hm hmn
    have h₁ : 0 < n - m := by
      omega
    have h₂ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g (m + (n - m)) : ℝ) := by
      have h₃ : 0 < n - m := h₁
      have h₄ : (g m : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (n - m)) < (g (m + (n - m)) : ℝ) := h_main m hm (n - m) h₃
      exact h₄
    have h₃ : m + (n - m) = n := by
      omega
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  exact h_final

import Mathlib

open Real

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2025_b6_solution : ℝ := 1 / 4

/-- The set of valid exponents r: those for which there exists g : ℕ → ℕ satisfying
    the functional inequality g(n+1) - g(n) ≥ (g(g(n)))^r for all positive n.

    This is the target set in the IsGreatest statement. -/
def validExponentSet : Set ℝ :=
  {r : ℝ | ∃ g : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g (g n) : ℝ) ^ r) ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ)}

theorem g_ge_n (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hg_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n)
    (hg_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n < g (n + 1)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n := by
  have h_base : 1 ≤ g 1 := by
    have h₁ : 0 < g 1 := hg_pos 1 (by norm_num)
    have h₂ : 1 ≤ g 1 := by
      by_contra h
      omega
    exact h₂

  have h_inductive_step : ∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → k ≤ g k → k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk h_ik
    have h₁ : g k < g (k + 1) := hg_mono k (by omega)
    have h₂ : k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
      have h₃ : k < g (k + 1) := by
        omega
      have h₄ : k + 1 ≤ g (k + 1) := by
        omega
      exact h₄
    exact h₂

  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → n ≤ g n := by
    intro n hn
    induction' hn with n hn IH
    ·
      exact h_base
    ·
      exact h_inductive_step n hn IH

  exact h_main

theorem g_succ_gt_sq (g : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hgn_pos : 0 < g n)
    (hdiff : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (g (n + 1) : ℝ) - (g n : ℝ)) :
    (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
  have h_lt_sum : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 + (g n : ℝ) := by
    have h₁ : 0 < (g n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgn_pos
    have h₃ : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 + (g n : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    exact h₃

  have h_main : (g n : ℝ) ^ 2 < (g (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    linarith

  exact h_main

open Lambda in

theorem eval_boolNot_value_iff
    (f : Expression.Factory) (σ : CoreStore) (e : Expression.Expr) (n : Nat) (v : Expression.Expr)
    (hBN : f["Bool.Not"]? = some (Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).func) :
    Lambda.LExpr.eval (n + 1) f σ (.app () (Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).opExpr e)
        = (v, .value true)
      ↔ ∃ β : Bool, Lambda.LExpr.eval n f σ e = (Lambda.LExpr.boolConst () β, .value true) ∧
          v = Lambda.LExpr.boolConst () (!β) := by
  have hcall : Lambda.Factory.callOfLFunc (T := CoreLParams) f
      (Lambda.LExpr.app () (Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).opExpr e)
      = some ((Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).opExpr, [e],
              (Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).func) := by
    simp only [Lambda.Factory.callOfLFunc, Lambda.getLFuncCall, Lambda.getLFuncCall.go,
      Lambda.WFLFunc.opExpr, Lambda.LFunc.opExpr, Lambda.LFuncDefined.opExpr,
      Lambda.boolNotFunc, Lambda.unaryOp]
    rw [hBN]
    simp [Lambda.boolNotFunc, Lambda.unaryOp]
  have hcan : Lambda.LExpr.isCanonicalValue f
      (Lambda.LExpr.app () (Lambda.boolNotFunc (T := CoreLParams)).opExpr e) = false := by
    simp only [Lambda.LExpr.isCanonicalValue, Lambda.Factory.callOfLFunc, Lambda.getLFuncCall,
      Lambda.getLFuncCall.go, Lambda.WFLFunc.opExpr, Lambda.LFunc.opExpr, Lambda.LFuncDefined.opExpr,
      Lambda.boolNotFunc, Lambda.unaryOp]
    rw [hBN]
    simp [Lambda.boolNotFunc, Lambda.unaryOp]

  rw [if_neg (by simp [hcan]), hcall]
  simp only [Lambda.boolNotFunc, Lambda.unaryOp]

  have hf2 : Strata.DL.Util.FuncAttr.findEvalIfCanonical #[] = none := by decide

  have hcev : Lambda.LambdaLeanType.cevalTy (ty := Lambda.LMonoTy.bool) (ValTy := Bool) CoreLParams
      = Lambda.LExpr.denoteBool := rfl
  have hmk : Lambda.LambdaLeanType.mkConst (ty := Lambda.LMonoTy.bool) (ValTy := Bool) CoreLParams
      = @Lambda.LExpr.boolConst CoreLParams.mono := rfl
  simp only [hcev, hmk]
  have hdbc : ∀ (m : Unit) (b : Bool),
      Lambda.LExpr.denoteBool (Lambda.LExpr.boolConst m b : Expression.Expr) = some b := by
    intro m b; rfl
