import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

abbrev modInv (p : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ := ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹)

abbrev descentCount (p : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  #{k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) | modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k}

theorem prime_gt_3_mod_12 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
  have h_not_even : p % 2 = 1 := by
    have h₁ : p % 2 = 1 := by
      have h₂ := hp.1.eq_two_or_odd
      cases h₂ with
      | inl h₂ =>
        exfalso
        omega
      | inr h₂ =>
        omega
    exact h₁

  have h_not_div_3 : p % 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h₁ : p % 3 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have h₃ : 3 ∣ p := by
        omega
      have h₄ : p.Prime := hp.1
      have h₅ : p = 3 := by
        have h₆ := h₄.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 3 h₃
        omega
      omega
    exact h₁

  have h_mod_12 : p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
    have h₁ : p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
      have h₂ : p % 12 = 0 ∨ p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 2 ∨ p % 12 = 3 ∨ p % 12 = 4 ∨ p % 12 = 5 ∨ p % 12 = 6 ∨ p % 12 = 7 ∨ p % 12 = 8 ∨ p % 12 = 9 ∨ p % 12 = 10 ∨ p % 12 = 11 := by
        omega
      rcases h₂ with (h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂ | h₂)
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inl h₂
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        have h₃ : p % 3 = 0 := by
          omega
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₂)
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h₂))
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        have h₃ : p % 3 = 0 := by
          omega
        omega
      ·
        exfalso
        omega
      ·
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h₂))
    exact h₁

  exact h_mod_12

/-- The key hyperbola identity: For k in the valid range, (I(k)+1)(I(k+1)-1) ≡ -1 (mod p).
    This follows from the fact that if k·I(k) ≡ 1 and (k+1)·I(k+1) ≡ 1, then
    subtracting and rearranging gives (I(k)+1)(I(k+1)-1) ≡ -1.
    The proof uses that 1/I(k) - 1/I(k+1) = 1, so I(k+1) - I(k) = I(k)·I(k+1),
    which can be rearranged to the hyperbola form. -/
theorem hyperbola_identity (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((modInv p k : ZMod p) + 1) * ((modInv p (k + 1) : ZMod p) - 1) = -1 := by
  have hval_k : (modInv p k : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have hval_k1 : (modInv p (k + 1) : ZMod p) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  rw [hval_k, hval_k1]
  have hp_two_le : 2 ≤ p := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.out
  have hk_lt : k < p := by omega
  have hk1_lt : k + 1 < p := by omega
  have hk_ne : (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < k) hdvd
    omega
  have hk1_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < k + 1) hdvd
    omega
  have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p) + 1 := by norm_cast
  rw [hcast]
  have hk1_add_ne : (k : ZMod p) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    convert hk1_ne using 1
    norm_cast
  have key : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  calc ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + 1) * (((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1)
      = (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1 := by ring
    _ = ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹ - ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹) - (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ + ((k : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ - 1 := by rw [key]
    _ = -1 := by ring

/-- There are no solutions (u, v) to uv ≡ -1 (mod p) with u, v ∈ {1,...,p-1} and u = v + 2.
    This is because if u = v + 2, then (v+2)v ≡ -1 (mod p), so v² + 2v + 1 ≡ 0,
    i.e., (v+1)² ≡ 0 (mod p). Since p is prime, v = p - 1. Then u = v + 2 = p + 1,
    which is not in {1,...,p-1}. So the hypotheses lead to a contradiction. -/
theorem no_gap_two_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p)
    (u v : ℕ) (hu : 1 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ p - 1) (_ : 1 ≤ v ∧ v ≤ p - 1)
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hgap : u = v + 2) :
    False := by
  have h1 : ((v : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have eq1 : ((v + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * v = -1 := by rw [← hgap]; exact huv
    calc ((v : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 2 = (v : ZMod p)^2 + 2 * v + 1 := by ring
      _ = ((v : ZMod p) + 2) * v + 1 := by ring
      _ = ((v + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * v + 1 := by simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [eq1]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  have h2 : (v : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
    rwa [sq_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  have h3 : v = p - 1 := by
    have hv1 : (v : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      calc (v : ZMod p) = (v : ZMod p) + 1 - 1 := by ring
        _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [h2]
        _ = -1 := by ring
    have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.Prime.pos hp.out
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
    have hvlt : v < p := by omega
    have hpm1lt : p - 1 < p := Nat.sub_lt hp0 (by omega)
    have h_neg1_val : (-1 : ZMod p).val = p - 1 := by
      have hp_zero : (p : ZMod p) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (ZMod p) p
      have h_pm1_eq_neg1 : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
        rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
        calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = ((p - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) := by
              simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          _ = (p : ℕ) := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hp1]
          _ = (0 : ZMod p) := hp_zero
      calc (-1 : ZMod p).val = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p).val := by rw [← h_pm1_eq_neg1]
        _ = p - 1 := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hpm1lt
    have h_v_val : (v : ZMod p).val = v := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hvlt
    rw [hv1] at h_v_val
    rw [h_neg1_val] at h_v_val
    exact h_v_val.symm
  omega

/-- For u ∈ {1,...,p-1} with p prime, the val of -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ is in {1,...,p-1}.
    Since u ≠ 0 in ZMod p, its inverse is nonzero, so -u⁻¹ is also nonzero,
    hence its val is in {1,...,p-1}. -/
lemma neg_inv_val_mem_Icc (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) :
    ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) := by
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu ⊢
  constructor
  · have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
      have hp1 : p > u := by omega
      have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
      omega
    have hinv_ne : (u : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hu_ne
    have hneg_ne : (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr hinv_ne
    have hval_ne : ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)).mpr hneg_ne
    omega
  · have hval_lt : ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) < p := ZMod.val_lt _
    omega

/-- The product (u : ZMod p) * (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)) equals -1 in ZMod p. -/
lemma neg_inv_val_mul_eq_neg_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) :
    (u : ZMod p) * (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
  have h1 : (ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹) : ZMod p) = -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  rw [h1]
  ring_nf
  have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
    rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
    have hp1 : p > u := by omega
    have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
    omega
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hu_ne]

/-- The filtered set of solutions equals the image of u ↦ (u, ZMod.val(-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)). -/
lemma hyperbola_eq_image (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    {x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1} =
    (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).image (fun (u : ℕ) => (u, ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹))) := by
  ext ⟨u, v⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  ·
    intro ⟨⟨hu, hv⟩, huv_eq⟩
    use u, hu
    constructor
    · rfl
    ·
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hv hu
      have hv_lt : v < p := by omega
      have hu_ne : (u : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
        have hp1 : p > u := by omega
        have : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp1
        omega
      have hv_eq : (v : ZMod p) = -(u : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
        have : (v : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu_ne, one_mul]
        rw [huv_eq] at this
        simp only [mul_neg, mul_one] at this
        exact this
      have hv_cast : (v : ZMod p).val = v := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hv_lt
      rw [hv_eq] at hv_cast
      exact hv_cast
  ·
    intro ⟨u', hu', hu'_eq, hv_eq⟩
    subst hu'_eq hv_eq
    constructor
    · constructor
      · exact hu'
      · exact neg_inv_val_mem_Icc p u' hu'
    · exact neg_inv_val_mul_eq_neg_one p u' hu'

/-- The function u ↦ (u, ZMod.val(-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹)) is injective. -/
lemma hyperbola_map_injective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    Function.Injective (fun (u : ℕ) => (u, ZMod.val (-(u : ZMod p)⁻¹))) := by
  intro u₁ u₂ h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  exact h.1

/-- The number of solutions (u,v) to uv ≡ -1 (mod p) with u,v ∈ {1,...,p-1} is exactly p-1. -/
theorem count_hyperbola_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1} = p - 1 := by
  rw [hyperbola_eq_image p hp3]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (hyperbola_map_injective p)]
  rw [Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

/-- When p % 4 = 1, there are exactly 2 solutions to x² = -1 in {1,...,p-1} -/
lemma count_diagonal_solutions_mod_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (hmod : p % 4 = 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card = 2 := by
  have hs : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) := by
    rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, ZMod.card p]
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hs
  have hr' : r * r = -1 := hr.symm
  have hr_ne_zero : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq, mul_zero] at hr'
    exact one_ne_zero (neg_eq_zero.mp hr'.symm)
  have hnr : (-r) ^ 2 = -1 := by
    rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  have hr_ne_neg : r ≠ -r := by
    intro heq
    have h2r : r + r = 0 := by
      calc r + r = r - (-r) := by ring
           _ = r - r := by rw [← heq]
           _ = 0 := by ring
    have : (2 : ZMod p) * r = 0 := by
      rw [show (2 : ZMod p) * r = r + r from by ring, h2r]
    have h2_ne : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      have : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
      exact ZMod.prime_ne_zero p 2 (by omega : p ≠ 2)
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp this with
    | inl h => exact h2_ne h
    | inr h => exact hr_ne_zero h
  have hsol : ∀ x : ZMod p, x ^ 2 = -1 ↔ x = r ∨ x = -r := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [sq] at hx
      have heq_sq : x ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by rw [sq, sq, hx, hr']
      rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp heq_sq with h | h
      · left; exact h
      · right; exact h
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · rw [sq, hr']
      · rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.out.pos
  have hne : NeZero p := ⟨hp_pos.ne'⟩
  have hr_val_pos : 0 < r.val := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h
    rw [ZMod.val_eq_zero] at h
    exact hr_ne_zero h
  have hr_val_lt : r.val < p := ZMod.val_lt r
  have hnr_val_pos : 0 < (-r).val := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h
    rw [ZMod.val_eq_zero] at h
    have : -r = 0 := h
    rw [neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact hr_ne_zero this
  have hnr_val_lt : (-r).val < p := ZMod.val_lt (-r)
  have hvals_ne : r.val ≠ (-r).val := by
    intro h
    have hinj := ZMod.val_injective p
    exact hr_ne_neg (hinj h)
  have hfilter : (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1) = {r.val, (-r).val} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hx_range, hx_sq⟩
      have hx_lt : x < p := by omega
      rw [hsol (x : ZMod p)] at hx_sq
      rcases hx_sq with h | h
      · left
        have : (x : ZMod p).val = r.val := by rw [h]
        rwa [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx_lt] at this
      · right
        have : (x : ZMod p).val = (-r).val := by rw [h]
        rwa [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx_lt] at this
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · constructor
        · exact ⟨hr_val_pos, by omega⟩
        · simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, sq, hr']
      · constructor
        · exact ⟨hnr_val_pos, by omega⟩
        · simp only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
          rw [neg_sq, sq, hr']
  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_pair hvals_ne]

/-- When p % 4 ≠ 1, there are 0 solutions to x² = -1 in {1,...,p-1} -/
lemma count_diagonal_solutions_not_mod_one (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (hmod : p % 4 ≠ 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card = 0 := by
  have hp_odd : Odd p := hp.out.odd_of_ne_two (by omega : p ≠ 2)
  have hp_mod_two : p % 2 = 1 := Nat.odd_iff.mp hp_odd
  have hp_mod4 : p % 4 = 1 ∨ p % 4 = 3 := Nat.odd_mod_four_iff.mp hp_mod_two
  have hmod3 : p % 4 = 3 := by omega
  have hns : ¬IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) := by
    rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, ZMod.card p]
    omega
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_false_of_mem]
  intro x _
  intro hx
  rw [sq] at hx
  exact hns ⟨x, hx.symm⟩

/-- For a prime p, the equation x² ≡ -1 (mod p) has exactly 2 solutions if p ≡ 1 (mod 4),
    and 0 solutions if p ≡ 3 (mod 4). More precisely, the number of x ∈ {1,...,p-1}
    with x² ≡ -1 (mod p) equals 2 if p % 4 = 1, and 0 otherwise.
    This uses FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff from Mathlib. -/
theorem count_diagonal_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = -1)).card =
      if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0 := by
  by_cases hmod : p % 4 = 1
  ·
    simp only [hmod, ↓reduceIte]
    exact count_diagonal_solutions_mod_one p hp3 hmod
  ·
    simp only [hmod, ↓reduceIte]
    exact count_diagonal_solutions_not_mod_one p hp3 hmod

/-- Helper: p - 1 = -1 in ZMod p -/
lemma pminus1_eq_neg1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have h2 : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
    have h3 : (p - 1 + 1 : ℕ) = p := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
    calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = (((p - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
      _ = ((p : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by rw [h3]
      _ = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self p
  calc ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 + (-1) := by ring
    _ = 0 + (-1) := by rw [h2]
    _ = -1 := by ring

/-- Helper: val of -1 is p - 1 -/
lemma val_neg1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] : (-1 : ZMod p).val = p - 1 := by
  rw [← pminus1_eq_neg1 p]
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p)]

/-- For k in [1, p-2], k cast to ZMod p is nonzero. -/
lemma k_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
  intro heq
  have hdvd : p ∣ k := (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd k p).mp heq
  have h1 : p ≤ k := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
  have h2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], k+1 cast to ZMod p is nonzero. -/
lemma k_succ_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
  intro heq
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hdvd : p ∣ k + 1 := (ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (k + 1) p).mp heq
  have h1 : p ≤ k + 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
  omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], modInv p k lies in [1, p-2] (tighter than [1, p-1]).
    Specifically, modInv p k ≠ p - 1 because that would require k = -1 = p - 1,
    which contradicts k ≤ p - 2. -/
lemma modInv_in_range_tight (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    1 ≤ modInv p k ∧ modInv p k ≤ p - 2 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hk_ne : (k : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := k_ne_zero p k hk1 hk2
  have hinv_ne : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hk_ne
  have h_pos : 0 < ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹) := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_lt : modInv p k < p := ZMod.val_lt ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹)
  constructor
  ·
    exact h_pos
  ·
    by_contra h_eq
    push_neg at h_eq
    have h2 : modInv p k = p - 1 := by omega
    have h3 : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ = -1 := by
      have h3' : ZMod.val ((k : ZMod p)⁻¹) = p - 1 := h2
      rw [← pminus1_eq_neg1 p]
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h3', ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by omega : p - 1 < p)]
    have h4 : (k : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (k : ZMod p), h3]
      simp
    have h5 : ZMod.val (k : ZMod p) = p - 1 := by
      rw [h4, val_neg1 p]
    have hk_lt : k < p := by omega
    have h6 : ZMod.val (k : ZMod p) = k := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk_lt
    rw [h6] at h5
    omega

/-- For k in [1, p-2], modInv p (k+1) lies in [2, p-1].
    Specifically, modInv p (k+1) ≠ 1 because that would require k + 1 = 1,
    which contradicts k ≥ 1. -/
lemma modInv_succ_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    2 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) ∧ modInv p (k + 1) ≤ p - 1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  have hk_succ_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := k_succ_ne_zero p k hk1 hk2
  have hinv_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hk_succ_ne
  have h_lt : modInv p (k + 1) < p := ZMod.val_lt (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹)
  have h_upper : modInv p (k + 1) ≤ p - 1 := by omega
  have h_pos : 0 < modInv p (k + 1) := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_ne_one : modInv p (k + 1) ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    have h1 : ZMod.val (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹) = 1 := heq
    have h2 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
      exact ZMod.val_one p
    have h3 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h1, h2]
    have h4 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)), h3]
      simp
    have h5 : ZMod.val ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) := by rw [h4]
    have h6 : k + 1 < p := by omega
    have h7 : ZMod.val ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = k + 1 := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt h6
    rw [h7, h2] at h5
    omega
  have h_lower : 2 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) := by omega
  exact ⟨h_lower, h_upper⟩

/-- The descent condition I(k+1) < I(k) is equivalent to u > v + 2
    where u = I(k) + 1 and v = I(k+1) - 1. -/
lemma descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k ↔ modInv p k + 1 > modInv p (k + 1) - 1 + 2 := by
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  omega

/-- The map k ↦ (I(k) + 1, I(k+1) - 1) is injective on [1, p-2]. -/
lemma phi_injective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    Function.Injective (fun k : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)} =>
      (modInv p k.val + 1, modInv p (k.val + 1) - 1)) := by
  intro k₁ k₂ heq
  have h_fst : modInv p k₁.val + 1 = modInv p k₂.val + 1 := by
    have := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    exact this
  have h_inv_eq : modInv p k₁.val = modInv p k₂.val := by omega
  have hk₁_mem := k₁.property
  have hk₂_mem := k₂.property
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hk₁_mem hk₂_mem
  have hk₁_lt_p : k₁.val < p := by omega
  have hk₂_lt_p : k₂.val < p := by omega
  have h_zmod_inv_eq : (k₁.val : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (k₂.val : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
    apply ZMod.val_injective p
    exact h_inv_eq
  have h_zmod_eq : (k₁.val : ZMod p) = (k₂.val : ZMod p) := by
    rw [← inv_inv (k₁.val : ZMod p), ← inv_inv (k₂.val : ZMod p)]
    rw [h_zmod_inv_eq]
  have h_val₁ : ZMod.val (k₁.val : ZMod p) = k₁.val := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk₁_lt_p
  have h_val₂ : ZMod.val (k₂.val : ZMod p) = k₂.val := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hk₂_lt_p
  have h_val_eq : k₁.val = k₂.val := by
    have := congrArg ZMod.val h_zmod_eq
    rw [h_val₁, h_val₂] at this
    exact this
  exact Subtype.ext h_val_eq

/-- If v = p - 1 and uv = -1 in ZMod p with u in [1, p-1], then u = 1. -/
lemma v_eq_pminus1_imp_u_eq_1 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v = p - 1)
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) : u = 1 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [hv, pminus1_eq_neg1 p] at huv
  have h1 : (u : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    have hmul : (u : ZMod p) * (-1) = -1 := huv
    calc (u : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) * (-1) * (-1) := by ring
      _ = (-1) * (-1) := by rw [hmul]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have h2 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
  have h3 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
    exact ZMod.val_one p
  rw [← h2, h1, h3]

/-- If u ∈ [2, p-1], then u - 1 ∈ [1, p-2], so (u-1 : ZMod p) is nonzero. -/
lemma u_minus1_ne_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    ((u : ZMod p) - 1) ≠ 0 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  intro heq
  have h1 : (u : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    have hsub : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = 0 := heq
    calc (u : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) - 1 + 1 := by ring
      _ = 0 + 1 := by rw [hsub]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have h2 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
  have h3 : ZMod.val (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
    haveI : Fact (1 < p) := ⟨Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.1⟩
    exact ZMod.val_one p
  have h4 : u = 1 := by rw [← h2, h1, h3]
  omega

/-- v ≤ p - 2 when u ≥ 2 and uv = -1. -/
lemma v_le_pminus2 (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) : v ≤ p - 2 := by
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hv
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hv_eq : v = p - 1 := by omega
  have hu_eq_1 : u = 1 := v_eq_pminus1_imp_u_eq_1 p u v hu hv_eq huv
  omega

/-- Key algebraic identity: If (u : ZMod p) * v = -1, then (u-1)⁻¹ + 1 = (v+1)⁻¹ in ZMod p. -/
lemma key_identity (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (_ : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ + 1 = ((v : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
  set a : ZMod p := (u : ZMod p) - 1 with ha_def
  set b : ZMod p := (v : ZMod p) + 1 with hb_def
  have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := u_minus1_ne_zero p u hu hu2
  have hab_rel : (a + 1) * (b - 1) = -1 := by
    simp only [ha_def, hb_def]
    ring_nf
    have hcast : ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) = ((u : ℕ) * (v : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast]
    have hcast2 : ((u : ℕ) * (v : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast2]
    exact huv
  have hab_eq : a * b = a - b := by
    have h : (a + 1) * (b - 1) = a * b - a + b - 1 := by ring
    rw [h] at hab_rel
    have h2 : a * b - a + b - 1 = -1 := hab_rel
    have h3 : a * b - a + b = 0 := by
      calc a * b - a + b = (a * b - a + b - 1) + 1 := by ring
        _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [h2]
        _ = 0 := by ring
    calc a * b = (a * b - a + b) + a - b := by ring
      _ = 0 + a - b := by rw [h3]
      _ = a - b := by ring
  have hb_formula : b * (1 + a) = a := by
    calc b * (1 + a) = b + a * b := by ring
      _ = b + (a - b) := by rw [hab_eq]
      _ = a := by ring
  have ha1_ne : a + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have : b * (1 + a) = b * 0 := by rw [add_comm, heq]
    simp only [mul_zero] at this
    rw [hb_formula] at this
    exact ha_ne this
  have hb_eq : b = a * (a + 1)⁻¹ := by
    calc b = b * (1 + a) * (1 + a)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by rw [add_comm]; exact ha1_ne), mul_one]
      _ = a * (1 + a)⁻¹ := by rw [hb_formula]
      _ = a * (a + 1)⁻¹ := by rw [add_comm]
  have hbinv : b⁻¹ = (a + 1) * a⁻¹ := by
    rw [hb_eq]
    rw [mul_inv, inv_inv]
    ring
  calc a⁻¹ + 1 = 1 + a⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = a⁻¹ * a + a⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha_ne]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (a + 1) := by ring
    _ = (a + 1) * a⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = b⁻¹ := by rw [← hbinv]

/-- The inverse of (u-1) in ZMod p has value in [1, p-2] when u ∈ [2, p-1]. -/
lemma inv_u_minus1_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ p - 2 := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have ha_ne : ((u : ZMod p) - 1) ≠ 0 := u_minus1_ne_zero p u (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) hu2
  have hinv_ne : ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero ha_ne
  have h_pos : 0 < k := by rw [ZMod.val_pos]; exact hinv_ne
  have h_lt : k < p := ZMod.val_lt (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
  constructor
  · exact h_pos
  ·
    by_contra h_eq
    push_neg at h_eq
    have hk_eq : k = p - 1 := by omega
    have h1 : ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) = p - 1 := hk_eq
    have h2 : ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ = -1 := by
      apply ZMod.val_injective p
      rw [h1, val_neg1 p]
    have h3 : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = -1 := by
      rw [← inv_inv (((u : ZMod p) - 1)), h2]
      simp
    have h4 : (u : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      calc (u : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1) + 1 := by ring
        _ = -1 + 1 := by rw [h3]
        _ = 0 := by ring
    have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
    have h5 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = u := ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_lt
    have h7 : u = 0 := by
      have h6 : ZMod.val (u : ZMod p) = ZMod.val (0 : ZMod p) := by rw [h4]
      simp only [ZMod.val_zero] at h6
      rw [h5] at h6
      exact h6
    omega

/-- Verify that modInv p k + 1 = u when k = val((u-1)⁻¹). -/
lemma verify_first_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    modInv p k + 1 = u := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu
  have h1 : (k : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hval : k = ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) := rfl
    rw [hval]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have h2 : (k : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (u : ZMod p) - 1 := by
    rw [h1, inv_inv]
  have h3 : modInv p k = ZMod.val ((u : ZMod p) - 1) := by
    simp only [modInv]
    rw [h2]
  have hu_lt : u < p := by omega
  have hu_sub_lt : u - 1 < p := by omega
  have h4 : ZMod.val ((u : ZMod p) - 1) = u - 1 := by
    have hu_ge : 1 ≤ u := by omega
    have hcast : (u : ZMod p) - 1 = ((u - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R := ZMod p), ← Nat.cast_sub hu_ge]
    rw [hcast, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hu_sub_lt]
  rw [h3, h4]
  omega

/-- Verify that modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v when k = val((u-1)⁻¹). -/
lemma verify_second_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)) (hv : v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1))
    (huv : (u : ZMod p) * v = -1) (hu2 : 2 ≤ u) :
    let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
    modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v := by
  intro k
  have hp2 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp.1
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hu hv
  have hv_le : v ≤ p - 2 := v_le_pminus2 p u v (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hv) huv hu2
  have hkey := key_identity p u v (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hu) (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hv) huv hu2
  have h1 : (k : ZMod p) = ((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hval : k = ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹) := rfl
    rw [hval]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
  have h2 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((v : ZMod p) + 1)⁻¹ := by
    have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p) + 1 := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast, h1, hkey]
  have h3 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ = (v : ZMod p) + 1 := by
    rw [h2, inv_inv]
  have h4 : modInv p (k + 1) = ZMod.val ((v : ZMod p) + 1) := by
    simp only [modInv]
    rw [h3]
  have hv1_lt : v + 1 < p := by omega
  have h5 : ZMod.val ((v : ZMod p) + 1) = v + 1 := by
    have hcast : (v : ZMod p) + 1 = ((v + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt hv1_lt]
  rw [h4, h5]
  omega

/-- Every pair (u, v) with uv = -1 in [1, p-1]² and u ≥ 2 is in the image of the map
    k ↦ (modInv p k + 1, modInv p (k+1) - 1). -/
lemma phi_surjective (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (_ : 3 < p) :
    ∀ u v : ℕ, u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) → v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) →
    (u : ZMod p) * v = -1 → 2 ≤ u →
    ∃ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2), modInv p k + 1 = u ∧ modInv p (k + 1) - 1 = v := by
  intro u v hu hv huv hu2
  let k := ZMod.val (((u : ZMod p) - 1)⁻¹)
  use k
  have hk_range := inv_u_minus1_in_range p u hu hu2
  constructor
  · rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact hk_range
  constructor
  · exact verify_first_eq p u hu hu2
  · exact verify_second_eq p u v hu hv huv hu2

/-- Helper: φ(k) lands in [1, p-1]² for k ∈ [1, p-2]. -/
lemma phi_in_range (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    modInv p k + 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ∧ modInv p (k + 1) - 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) := by
  have hu := modInv_in_range_tight p k hk1 hk2
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
  constructor <;> omega

/-- Helper: φ(k) satisfies the hyperbola condition u * v = -1 as natural numbers cast to ZMod p. -/
lemma phi_satisfies_hyperbola (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ p - 2) :
    ((modInv p k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) * (modInv p (k + 1) - 1 : ℕ) = -1 := by
  have h := hyperbola_identity p k hk1 hk2
  have hv := modInv_succ_in_range p k hk1 hk2
  have hv1 : 1 ≤ modInv p (k + 1) := by omega
  have hsub : ((modInv p (k + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p) - 1 = ((modInv p (k + 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hv1]
    simp only [Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hsub] at h
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h ⊢
  exact h

/-- The bijection lemma: The set of k in [1, p-2] with I(k+1) < I(k) has the same
    cardinality as the set of (u, v) with uv = -1 and u > v + 2 in [1, p-1]². -/
lemma descent_count_eq_hyperbola_count (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) | modInv p (k + 1) < modInv p k} =
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2 + 2} := by
  apply Finset.card_bij
    (fun k _ => (modInv p k + 1, modInv p (k + 1) - 1))
  · intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_product] at hk ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, hdesc⟩ := hk
    have hrange := phi_in_range p k hk1 hk2
    have hhyp := phi_satisfies_hyperbola p k hk1 hk2
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hrange
    refine ⟨⟨hrange.1, hrange.2⟩, hhyp, ?_⟩
    rwa [descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 p k hk1 hk2] at hdesc
  · intro k1 hk1 k2 hk2 heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hk1 hk2
    have hinj := phi_injective p hp3
    have hk1_mem : k1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) := by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hk1.1
    have hk2_mem : k2 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2) := by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact hk2.1
    have : (⟨k1, hk1_mem⟩ : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)}) =
           (⟨k2, hk2_mem⟩ : {k : ℕ // k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 2)}) := by
      apply hinj
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq ⊢
      exact heq
    simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
    exact this
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_product] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hu1, hu2⟩, ⟨hv1, hv2⟩⟩, hhyp, hgap⟩ := hx
    have hu_ge_2 : 2 ≤ x.1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk_mem, hk_eq⟩ := phi_surjective p hp3 x.1 x.2
      (by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨hu1, hu2⟩)
      (by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨hv1, hv2⟩)
      hhyp hu_ge_2
    use k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hk_mem ⊢
    refine ⟨⟨hk_mem, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    ·
      rw [descent_iff_u_gt_v_plus_2 p k hk_mem.1 hk_mem.2]
      rw [hk_eq.1, hk_eq.2]
      exact hgap
    ·
      ext <;> simp only [hk_eq.1, hk_eq.2]

/-- The equation x(x-1) = -1 in ZMod p is equivalent to (2x-1)² = -3.
    This comes from completing the square: x² - x + 1 = 0 iff 4(x² - x + 1) = 0
    iff (2x-1)² = -3. -/
lemma near_diag_eq_transform (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) (x : ZMod p) :
    x * (x - 1) = -1 ↔ (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 = -3 := by
  have hp2 : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    omega
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : x * (x - 1) + 1 = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
    have h2 : x * x - x + 1 = 0 := by ring_nf; ring_nf at h1; exact h1
    calc (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 = 4 * x * x - 4 * x + 1 := by ring
      _ = 4 * (x * x - x + 1) - 3 := by ring
      _ = 4 * 0 - 3 := by rw [h2]
      _ = -3 := by ring
  · intro h
    have h2 : (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 + 3 = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
    have h3 : 4 * (x * x - x + 1) = 0 := by calc
      4 * (x * x - x + 1) = (2 * x - 1) ^ 2 + 3 := by ring
      _ = 0 := h2
    have h4 : (4 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [ne_eq]
      intro hf
      rw [show (4 : ZMod p) = 2 * 2 by ring] at hf
      have := mul_eq_zero.mp hf
      simp only [hp2, or_self] at this
    have h5 : x * x - x + 1 = 0 := by
      have := mul_eq_zero.mp (by rw [h3] : 4 * (x * x - x + 1) = 0)
      simp only [h4, false_or] at this
      exact this
    calc x * (x - 1) = x * x - x := by ring
      _ = -1 + (x * x - x + 1) := by ring
      _ = -1 + 0 := by rw [h5]
      _ = -1 := by ring

/-- The map x ↦ 2x - 1 gives a bijection from elements of {1,..,p-1} satisfying x(x-1) = -1
    to square roots of -3 in ZMod p. -/
lemma filter_Icc_card_eq_set_card (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)).card =
    ({x : ZMod p | x ^ 2 = -3}.toFinset).card := by
  have h2_ne : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
    omega
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun (n : ℕ) (_ : n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)) => (2 * (n : ZMod p) - 1 : ZMod p))
  · intro n hn
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn
    have hsol := hn.2
    rw [near_diag_eq_transform p hp3] at hsol
    exact hsol
  · intro n₁ hn₁ n₂ hn₂ heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn₁ hn₂
    have h2eq : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ := by
      have heq' : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ - 1 = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ - 1 := heq
      have : (2 : ZMod p) * n₁ - 1 + 1 = (2 : ZMod p) * n₂ - 1 + 1 := by rw [heq']
      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at this
      exact this
    have h2_unit : IsUnit (2 : ZMod p) := h2_ne.isUnit
    have hmod : (n₁ : ZMod p) = (n₂ : ZMod p) := h2_unit.mul_left_cancel h2eq
    have hn₁_bound : n₁ < p := by omega
    have hn₂_bound : n₂ < p := by omega
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at hmod
    have : n₁ % p = n₂ % p := hmod
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn₁_bound, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn₂_bound] at this
    exact this
  · intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy
    let x : ZMod p := (y + 1) / 2
    have hx_eq : 2 * x - 1 = y := by
      simp only [x]
      field_simp
    have hx_sol : x * (x - 1) = -1 := by
      rw [near_diag_eq_transform p hp3]
      rw [hx_eq]
      exact hy
    have hx_ne0 : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hx0
      rw [hx0] at hx_sol
      have : (0 : ZMod p) * (0 - 1) = 0 := by ring
      rw [this] at hx_sol
      have : (-1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have h1eq0 : (1 : ZMod p) = 0 := by
          calc (1 : ZMod p) = -(-1) := by ring
            _ = -0 := by rw [h]
            _ = 0 := by ring
        have hp1 : p ∣ 1 := by
          have := ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd 1 p
          rw [Nat.cast_one] at this
          exact this.mp h1eq0
        have : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp1
        omega
      exact this hx_sol.symm
    have hval_pos : 0 < x.val := by
      rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
      intro hval0
      have : x = 0 := by
        have : (x.val : ZMod p) = x := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
        rw [hval0] at this
        simp at this
        exact this.symm
      exact hx_ne0 this
    have hval_lt : x.val < p := ZMod.val_lt x
    have hcast : (x.val : ZMod p) = x := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
    have hmem : x.val ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod p) * ((n : ZMod p) - 1) = -1) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · constructor <;> omega
      · rw [hcast]; exact hx_sol
    exact ⟨x.val, hmem, by rw [hcast, hx_eq]⟩

/-- 2 is not a square in ZMod 3 -/
lemma not_isSquare_two_ZMod_3 : ¬IsSquare (2 : ZMod 3) := by decide

/-- The Legendre symbol (p/3) equals 1 if p ≡ 1 mod 3, and -1 if p ≡ 2 mod 3. -/
lemma legendreSym_three_p (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    legendreSym 3 p = if p % 3 = 1 then 1 else -1 := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨Nat.prime_three⟩
  have hp' := hp.out
  have hpne3 : p ≠ 3 := by omega
  have hp_ne_0 : (p : ZMod 3) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : 3 ∣ p := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have h3dvd := Nat.dvd_prime hp' |>.mp hdvd
    rcases h3dvd with h1 | h3
    · omega
    · exact hpne3 h3.symm
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt p (by norm_num : 0 < 3)
  interval_cases hp3' : (p % 3)
  ·
    exfalso
    have hdvd : 3 ∣ p := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hp3'
    have h3dvd := Nat.dvd_prime hp' |>.mp hdvd
    rcases h3dvd with h1 | h3
    · omega
    · exact hpne3 h3.symm
  ·
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    have hp_is_1 : (p : ZMod 3) = 1 := by
      have h1 : (p : ZMod 3) = ((p % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) := by simp [ZMod.natCast_mod]
      rw [h1, hp3']
      rfl
    rw [legendreSym.eq_one_iff' 3 hp_ne_0, hp_is_1]
    exact ⟨1, by ring⟩
  ·
    simp only [show (2 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by omega, ite_false]
    have hp_is_2 : (p : ZMod 3) = 2 := by
      have h1 : (p : ZMod 3) = ((p % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) := by simp [ZMod.natCast_mod]
      rw [h1, hp3']
      rfl
    rw [legendreSym.eq_neg_one_iff', hp_is_2]
    exact not_isSquare_two_ZMod_3

/-- The Legendre symbol (-3/p) equals (p/3) for odd primes p > 3.
    This is because (-3/p) = (-1/p)(3/p) = (-1)^((p-1)/2) * (-1)^((p-1)/2) * (p/3) = (p/3). -/
lemma legendreSym_neg_three_eq (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    legendreSym p (-3) = legendreSym 3 p := by
  haveI h3 : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨Nat.prime_three⟩
  have hpne2 : p ≠ 2 := by omega
  have h1 : legendreSym p (-3) = legendreSym p (-1) * legendreSym p 3 := by
    have : (-3 : ℤ) = (-1) * 3 := by ring
    rw [this, legendreSym.mul]
  have h3' : legendreSym p (-1) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) := by
    rw [legendreSym.at_neg_one hpne2]
    have hodd : p % 2 = 1 := Nat.Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two.mpr hpne2
    exact ZMod.χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow hodd
  have h4 : legendreSym 3 (p : ℤ) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * legendreSym p 3 := by
    have hqr := legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity' hpne2 (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 2)
    have h32 : (3 : ℕ) / 2 = 1 := by norm_num
    simp only [h32, mul_one] at hqr
    exact hqr
  have hsign : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    have heven : Even (p / 2 * 2) := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact even_two_mul (p / 2)
    exact Even.neg_one_pow heven
  have h6 : legendreSym p 3 = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * legendreSym 3 p := by
    calc legendreSym p 3 = 1 * legendreSym p 3 := by ring
      _ = ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2)) ^ 2 * legendreSym p 3 := by rw [hsign]
      _ = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * legendreSym p 3) := by ring
      _ = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * legendreSym 3 p := by rw [← h4]
  rw [h1, h3', h6]
  calc (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2) * legendreSym 3 ↑p)
      = ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2)) ^ 2 * legendreSym 3 ↑p := by ring
    _ = 1 * legendreSym 3 ↑p := by rw [hsign]
    _ = legendreSym 3 ↑p := by ring

/-- -3 is a square in ZMod p iff p ≡ 1 (mod 3), for p > 3 prime.
    This follows from quadratic reciprocity: (-3/p) = (-1/p)(3/p) = (p/3).
    And (p/3) = 1 iff p ≡ 1 (mod 3). -/
theorem isSquare_neg_three_iff (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    IsSquare (-3 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 3 = 1 := by
  have hneg3_ne : ((-3 : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_ofNat, ne_eq, neg_eq_zero]
    intro h
    have hp3' : p ∣ 3 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp3'
    omega
  have hconv : (-3 : ZMod p) = ((-3 : ℤ) : ZMod p) := by norm_cast
  rw [hconv]
  rw [← legendreSym.eq_one_iff p hneg3_ne]
  rw [legendreSym_neg_three_eq p hp3, legendreSym_three_p p hp3]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · constructor
    · intro hf; exact hf.elim
    · intro hmod; exact h hmod

/-- The number of elements in ZMod p that square to -3 equals 2 if p ≡ 1 (mod 3), else 0. -/
lemma card_sqrts_neg_three (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ({x : ZMod p | x ^ 2 = -3}.toFinset).card = if p % 3 = 1 then 2 else 0 := by
  have hp2 : ringChar (ZMod p) ≠ 2 := by
    rw [ZMod.ringChar_zmod_n]
    omega
  have hneg3_ne : (-3 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h3 : (3 : ZMod p) = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp h
    have hp3' : p ∣ 3 := by
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast h3
    have : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hp3'
    omega
  have hcard := quadraticChar_card_sqrts hp2 (-3 : ZMod p)
  by_cases h : p % 3 = 1
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
    have hsq : IsSquare (-3 : ZMod p) := (isSquare_neg_three_iff p hp3).mpr h
    rw [(quadraticChar_one_iff_isSquare hneg3_ne).mpr hsq] at hcard
    omega
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
    have hnsq : ¬IsSquare (-3 : ZMod p) := by
      intro hsq
      exact h ((isSquare_neg_three_iff p hp3).mp hsq)
    rw [quadraticChar_neg_one_iff_not_isSquare.mpr hnsq] at hcard
    omega

/-- For a prime p, the equation x(x-1) ≡ -1 (mod p) (equivalently x² - x + 1 ≡ 0 (mod p))
    has exactly 2 solutions if p ≡ 1 (mod 3), and 0 solutions if p ≡ 2 (mod 3).
    The discriminant is -3, so solutions exist iff -3 is a quadratic residue mod p,
    which happens iff p ≡ 1 (mod 3) (for p > 3). -/
theorem count_near_diagonal_solutions (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1)).filter (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p) * ((x : ZMod p) - 1) = -1)).card =
      if p % 3 = 1 then 2 else 0 := by
  rw [filter_Icc_card_eq_set_card p hp3, card_sqrts_neg_three p hp3]

/-- Gap-2 count is zero. -/
lemma count_gap_two_zero (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2 + 2} = 0 := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero]
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false, not_and, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
    Finset.mem_Icc]
  intro hx huv hgap
  have hu1 := hx.1.1
  have hu2 := hx.1.2
  have hv1 := hx.2.1
  have hv2 := hx.2.2
  exact no_gap_two_solutions p hp3 x.1 x.2 ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ huv hgap

/-- Partition of lower triangle into {u = v+1}, {u = v+2}, and {u > v+2}. -/
lemma lower_triangle_partition_card (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (_ : 3 < p) :
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2} =
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2 + 1} +
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2 + 2} +
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) | (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2 + 2} := by
  set S := Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) with hS_def
  set L := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2) with hL_def
  set L1 := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2 + 1) with hL1_def
  set L2 := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2 + 2) with hL2_def
  set L3 := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2 + 2) with hL3_def
  have hL_eq : L = L1 ∪ L2 ∪ L3 := by
    ext x
    simp only [hL_def, hL1_def, hL2_def, hL3_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hS, heq, hgt⟩
      by_cases h1 : x.1 = x.2 + 1
      · left; left; exact ⟨hS, heq, h1⟩
      · by_cases h2 : x.1 = x.2 + 2
        · left; right; exact ⟨hS, heq, h2⟩
        · right; refine ⟨hS, heq, ?_⟩; omega
    · intro h
      obtain (⟨hS, heq, h1⟩ | ⟨hS, heq, h2⟩) | ⟨hS, heq, h3⟩ := h
      · exact ⟨hS, heq, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨hS, heq, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨hS, heq, by omega⟩
  have hd12 : Disjoint L1 L2 := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hL1_def, hL2_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab
    omega
  have hd23 : Disjoint L2 L3 := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hL2_def, hL3_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab
    omega
  have hd13 : Disjoint L1 L3 := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hL1_def, hL3_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab
    omega
  have hd12_3 : Disjoint (L1 ∪ L2) L3 := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨hd13, hd23⟩
  calc L.card = (L1 ∪ L2 ∪ L3).card := by rw [hL_eq]
    _ = (L1 ∪ L2).card + L3.card := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd12_3
    _ = L1.card + L2.card + L3.card := by rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd12]

/-- The lower triangle count equals half of the off-diagonal hyperbola solutions. -/
lemma count_lower_triangle (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp3 : 3 < p) :
    #{x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) |
      (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2} = (p - 1 - (if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0)) / 2 := by
  have h_total := count_hyperbola_solutions p hp3
  have h_diag := count_diagonal_solutions p hp3
  set S := Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 (p - 1) with hS_def
  set H := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1) with hH_def
  set D := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 = x.2) with hD_def
  set L := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 > x.2) with hL_def
  set U := S.filter (fun x => (x.1 : ZMod p) * x.2 = -1 ∧ x.1 < x.2) with hU_def
  have h_partition : H = D ∪ L ∪ U := by
    ext x
    simp only [hH_def, hD_def, hL_def, hU_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hS, heq⟩
      rcases lt_trichotomy x.1 x.2 with h | h | h
      · right; exact ⟨hS, heq, h⟩
      · left; left; exact ⟨hS, heq, h⟩
      · left; right; exact ⟨hS, heq, h⟩
    · intro h
      obtain (⟨hS, heq, _⟩ | ⟨hS, heq, _⟩) | ⟨hS, heq, _⟩ := h
      all_goals exact ⟨hS, heq⟩
  have hDL : Disjoint D L := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hD_def, hL_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab; omega
  have hDU : Disjoint D U := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hD_def, hU_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab; omega
  have hLU : Disjoint L U := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [hL_def, hU_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
    subst hab; omega
  have hDL_U : Disjoint (D ∪ L) U := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨hDU, hLU⟩
  have h_card_eq : H.card = D.card + L.card + U.card := by
    rw [h_partition]
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDL_U]
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDL]
  have h_symm : L.card = U.card := by
    let swap : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ := fun x => (x.2, x.1)
    apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => swap x)
    · intro ⟨u, v⟩ h
      simp only [hL_def, hU_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, swap] at h ⊢
      constructor
      · constructor
        · exact ⟨h.1.2.1, h.1.2.2⟩
        · exact ⟨h.1.1.1, h.1.1.2⟩
      · constructor
        · rw [mul_comm]; exact h.2.1
        · exact h.2.2
    · intro ⟨a, b⟩ _ ⟨c, d⟩ _ heq
      simp only [swap, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      ext <;> [exact heq.2; exact heq.1]
    · intro ⟨u, v⟩ h
      simp only [hU_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at h
      refine ⟨(v, u), ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [hL_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
        constructor
        · constructor
          · exact ⟨h.1.2.1, h.1.2.2⟩
          · exact ⟨h.1.1.1, h.1.1.2⟩
        · constructor
          · rw [mul_comm]; exact h.2.1
          · exact h.2.2
      · simp [swap]
  have h_D_card : D.card = if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0 := by
    rw [← h_diag]
    apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => x.1)
    · intro ⟨u, v⟩ h
      simp only [hD_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at h
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · exact ⟨h.1.1.1, h.1.1.2⟩
      · have huv := h.2.1
        have heq := h.2.2
        subst heq
        simp only [sq]
        exact huv
    · intro ⟨a, _⟩ ha ⟨b, _⟩ hb heq
      simp only [hD_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb
      ext <;> [exact heq; omega]
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
      refine ⟨(x, x), ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [hD_def, hS_def, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · exact ⟨⟨hx.1.1, hx.1.2⟩, ⟨hx.1.1, hx.1.2⟩⟩
      · constructor
        · simp only [sq] at hx; exact hx.2
        · trivial
  have h_result : L.card = (p - 1 - (if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0)) / 2 := by
    have h2 : 2 ∣ (p - 1 - (if p % 4 = 1 then 2 else 0)) := by
      split_ifs with h
      ·
        have : (p - 1 - 2) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero this
      ·
        have hp_odd := Nat.Prime.odd_of_ne_two hp.1 (by omega)
        have hp_mod2 : p % 2 = 1 := Nat.odd_iff.mp hp_odd
        have : (p - 1 - 0) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero this
    omega
  exact h_result

name: Lambda.LExpr.getOps_subset_betaReduceRedexesFuel
statement:
/-- Whole-function call-preservation for the *non-erasing* reducer: every
operator occurrence (call head, `.op`) of `e` survives `betaReduceRedexesFuel
true`. It holds at *every* fuel (even `0`), so consumers do not depend on the
reducer reaching a normal form. The `app`/reduce case reduces exactly the
`bvarUsed 0 body = true` (alias) redexes, so `getOps_arg_subset_betaReduce`
applies and the argument's calls survive. The analogous statement for the
*erasing* reducer (`betaReduceRedexesFuel false`) is provably FALSE: a
constant-lambda redex erases its argument's calls
(`getOps_betaReduce_of_not_bvarUsed`). -/
theorem getOps_subset_betaReduceRedexesFuel {T : LExprParamsT} (fuel : Nat) :
    ∀ e : LExpr T, getOps e ⊆ getOps (betaReduceRedexesFuel true fuel e)
src:
/-- Whole-function call-preservation for the *non-erasing* reducer: every
operator occurrence (call head, `.op`) of `e` survives `betaReduceRedexesFuel
true`. It holds at *every* fuel (even `0`), so consumers do not depend on the
reducer reaching a normal form. The `app`/reduce case reduces exactly the
`bvarUsed 0 body = true` (alias) redexes, so `getOps_arg_subset_betaReduce`
applies and the argument's calls survive. The analogous statement for the
*erasing* reducer (`betaReduceRedexesFuel false`) is provably FALSE: a
constant-lambda redex erases its argument's calls
(`getOps_betaReduce_of_not_bvarUsed`). -/
theorem getOps_subset_betaReduceRedexesFuel {T : LExprParamsT} (fuel : Nat) :
    ∀ e : LExpr T, getOps e ⊆ getOps (betaReduceRedexesFuel true fuel e) := by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro e; simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]; exact List.Subset.refl _
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro e
    cases e with
    | const m c => simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]; exact List.Subset.refl _
    | op m o ty => simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]; exact List.Subset.refl _
    | bvar m i => simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]; exact List.Subset.refl _
    | fvar m x ty => simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]; exact List.Subset.refl _
    | abs m n t body =>
      simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel, getOps]
      exact ih body
    | quant m qk n t tr body =>
      simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel, getOps]
      exact List.append_subset_append (ih tr) (ih body)
    | ite m c t f =>
      simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel, getOps]
      exact List.append_subset_append
        (List.append_subset_append (ih c) (ih t)) (ih f)
    | eq m a b =>
      simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel, getOps]
      exact List.append_subset_append (ih a) (ih b)
    | app m fn arg =>
      simp only [betaReduceRedexesFuel]
      split
      · rename_i mAbs n t body hfn
        have hfnbody : getOps fn ⊆ getOps body := by
          have hf := ih fn; rw [hfn] at hf; simpa only [getOps] using hf
        split
        · simp only [getOps]
          exact List.append_subset_append hfnbody (ih arg)
        · rename_i hcond
          have hbv : bvarUsed 0 body = true := by
            cases hb : bvarUsed 0 body with
            | true => rfl
            | false => rw [hb] at hcond; simp at hcond
          simp only [getOps]
          refine List.Subset.trans ?_
            (ih (betaReduce (betaReduceRedexesFuel true fuel arg) body))
          intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
          · exact List.Subset.trans hfnbody
              (getOps_body_subset_betaReduce (betaReduceRedexesFuel true fuel arg) body) h
          · exact List.Subset.trans (ih arg)
              (getOps_arg_subset_betaReduce (betaReduceRedexesFuel true fuel arg) body hbv) h
      · simp only [getOps]
        exact List.append_subset_append (ih fn) (ih arg)

name: Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
statement:
theorem closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {F : Type*} [DecidableEq F] (u v : ι → F) (e : ℕ) :
    Δ₀(u, v) ≤ e ↔ ∃ (S : Finset ι),
      Fintype.card ι - e ≤ S.card ∧ (∀ (colIdx : ι), (colIdx ∈ S → u colIdx = v colIdx)
        ∧ (u colIdx ≠ v colIdx → colIdx ∉ S))
src:
theorem closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {F : Type*} [DecidableEq F] (u v : ι → F) (e : ℕ) :
    Δ₀(u, v) ≤ e ↔ ∃ (S : Finset ι),
      Fintype.card ι - e ≤ S.card ∧ (∀ (colIdx : ι), (colIdx ∈ S → u colIdx = v colIdx)
        ∧ (u colIdx ≠ v colIdx → colIdx ∉ S)) := by
  classical
  rw [closeToWord_iff_exists_possibleDisagreeCols]
  constructor
  · -- Direction 1: (∃ D, D.card ≤ e ∧ ∀ colIdx ∉ D, u colIdx = v colIdx) → ∃ S, ...
    intro h_exists_D
    rcases h_exists_D with ⟨D, hD_card_le_e, h_agree_outside_D⟩
    -- Define S as the complement of D (the agreeing columns)
    let S : Finset ι := Finset.filter (fun colIdx => colIdx ∉ D) Finset.univ
    use S
    constructor
    · -- Prove Fintype.card ι - e ≤ S.card
      -- S is the complement of D, so S.card = Fintype.card ι - D.card
      have hS_card_eq : S.card = Fintype.card ι - D.card := by
        -- S is the complement of D in univ
        -- Use the fact that S = univ.filter (· ∉ D) and card of complement
        have h_compl : S = Finset.univ \ D := by
          ext x
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          constructor
          · intro hx_S
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, S] at hx_S
            exact hx_S
          · intro hx_sdiff
            exact (Finset.mem_filter_univ x).mpr hx_sdiff
        rw [h_compl, Finset.card_sdiff, Finset.card_univ, Finset.inter_univ]
      rw [hS_card_eq]
      omega
    · -- Prove agreement inside S
      intro colIdx
      constructor
      · intro h_colIdx_in_S
        have h_colIdx_notin_D : colIdx ∉ D := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, S] at h_colIdx_in_S
          exact h_colIdx_in_S
        exact h_agree_outside_D colIdx h_colIdx_notin_D
      · intro h_colIdx_neq_v_colIdx
        by_contra h_colIdx_in_S
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, S] at h_colIdx_in_S
        have h_eq := h_agree_outside_D colIdx h_colIdx_in_S
        exact h_colIdx_neq_v_colIdx (h_agree_outside_D colIdx h_colIdx_in_S)
  · -- Direction 2: (∃ S, ...) → (∃ D, D.card ≤ e ∧ ∀ colIdx ∉ D, u colIdx = v colIdx)
    intro h_exists_S
    rcases h_exists_S with ⟨S, hS_card_ge, h_agree_inside_S⟩
    -- Define D as the complement of S (the disagreeing columns)
    let D : Finset ι := Finset.filter (fun colIdx => colIdx ∉ S) Finset.univ
    use D
    constructor
    · -- Prove D.card ≤ e
      -- D is the complement of S, so D.card = Fintype.card ι - S.card
      have hD_card_eq : D.card = Fintype.card ι - S.card := by
        -- D is the complement of S in univ
        have h_compl : D = Finset.univ \ S := by
          ext x
          simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_sdiff]
          constructor
          · intro hx_D
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, D] at hx_D
            exact hx_D
          · intro hx_sdiff
            exact (Finset.mem_filter_univ x).mpr hx_sdiff
        rw [h_compl, Finset.card_sdiff, Finset.card_univ, Finset.inter_univ]
      rw [hD_card_eq]
      -- We are given: Fintype.card ι - e ≤ S.card
      -- This is equivalent to: Fintype.card ι - S.card ≤ e
      omega
    · -- Prove agreement outside D
      intro colIdx h_colIdx_notin_D
      -- colIdx ∉ D means colIdx is not in filter (fun colIdx => colIdx ∉ S) univ
      -- This means either colIdx ∉ univ (impossible) or colIdx ∈ S
      -- So colIdx ∈ S
      have h_colIdx_in_S : colIdx ∈ S := by
        by_contra h_notin_S
        have h_in_D : colIdx ∈ D := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Decidable.not_not,
            D] at h_colIdx_notin_D
          exact False.elim (h_notin_S h_colIdx_notin_D)
        exact h_colIdx_notin_D h_in_D
      -- By h_agree_inside_S, if colIdx ∈ S, then u colIdx = v colIdx
      exact (h_agree_inside_S colIdx).1 h_colIdx_in_S

name: PebblingLean.Hypercube.dist_appendVertex
statement:
/-- Hamming distance splits over appended coordinates. -/
theorem dist_appendVertex {a m : ℕ}
    (x x' : HypercubeVertex a) (z z' : HypercubeVertex m) :
    dist (appendVertex (x, z)) (appendVertex (x', z')) =
      dist x x' + dist z z'
src:
/-- Hamming distance splits over appended coordinates. -/
theorem dist_appendVertex {a m : ℕ}
    (x x' : HypercubeVertex a) (z z' : HypercubeVertex m) :
    dist (appendVertex (x, z)) (appendVertex (x', z')) =
      dist x x' + dist z z' := by
  classical
  let leftDiff : Finset (Fin (a + m)) :=
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin a => x i ≠ x' i).map (Fin.castAddEmb m)
  let rightDiff : Finset (Fin (a + m)) :=
    (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => z j ≠ z' j).map (Fin.natAddEmb a)
  have hdiff :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin (a + m) =>
        appendVertex (x, z) k ≠ appendVertex (x', z') k) =
        leftDiff ∪ rightDiff := by
    ext k
    induction k using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
        have hnot_right : Fin.castAdd m i ∉ rightDiff := by
          intro hk
          rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hk with ⟨j, _hj, hj_eq⟩
          have hlt : ((Fin.castAdd m i : Fin (a + m)) : ℕ) < a := i.isLt
          have hge : a ≤ ((Fin.castAdd m i : Fin (a + m)) : ℕ) := by
            rw [← hj_eq]
            exact Nat.le_add_right a j
          exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge) hlt
        have happend : appendVertex (x, z) (Fin.castAdd m i) = x i :=
          Fin.append_left x z i
        have happend' : appendVertex (x', z') (Fin.castAdd m i) = x' i :=
          Fin.append_left x' z' i
        simp [leftDiff, rightDiff, hnot_right, happend, happend']
    | right j =>
        have hnot_left : Fin.natAdd a j ∉ leftDiff := by
          intro hk
          rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hk with ⟨i, _hi, hi_eq⟩
          have hge : a ≤ ((Fin.natAdd a j : Fin (a + m)) : ℕ) :=
            Nat.le_add_right a j
          have hlt : ((Fin.natAdd a j : Fin (a + m)) : ℕ) < a := by
            rw [← hi_eq]
            exact i.isLt
          exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge) hlt
        have happend : appendVertex (x, z) (Fin.natAdd a j) = z j :=
          Fin.append_right x z j
        have happend' : appendVertex (x', z') (Fin.natAdd a j) = z' j :=
          Fin.append_right x' z' j
        simp [leftDiff, rightDiff, hnot_left, happend, happend']
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint leftDiff rightDiff := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro k hk_left hk_right
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hk_left with ⟨i, _hi, hi_eq⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hk_right with ⟨j, _hj, hj_eq⟩
    have hlt : (k : ℕ) < a := by
      rw [← hi_eq]
      exact i.isLt
    have hge : a ≤ (k : ℕ) := by
      rw [← hj_eq]
      exact Nat.le_add_right a j
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge) hlt
  unfold dist
  rw [hdiff, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint]
  simp [leftDiff, rightDiff]

name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_prodT_right
statement:
/-- Evaluating an index in the right factor of a tensor product commutes with forming the
  product, up to the identity reindexing which identifies the two ways of removing that
  index from the appended color list. -/
lemma evalT_prodT_right {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) (x : basisIdx (c1 i)) (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT t (evalT i x t1) =
    permT id (IsReindexing.append_succAbove_natAdd (n := n) (n1 := n1) i)
      (evalT (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) (basisIdxCongr (by simp) x) (prodT t t1))
src:
/-- Evaluating an index in the right factor of a tensor product commutes with forming the
  product, up to the identity reindexing which identifies the two ways of removing that
  index from the appended color list. -/
lemma evalT_prodT_right {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) (x : basisIdx (c1 i)) (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT t (evalT i x t1) =
    permT id (IsReindexing.append_succAbove_natAdd (n := n) (n1 := n1) i)
      (evalT (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) (basisIdxCongr (by simp) x) (prodT t t1)) := by
  symm
  induction' t using Tensor.induction_on_basis with b a t ht t2 t3 ht2 ht3
  · induction' t1 using Tensor.induction_on_basis with b1 a t ht t2 t3 ht2 ht3
    · by_cases hi : b1 i = x
      · have hprod : ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1) (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) =
            basisIdxCongr (by simp) x := by
          simp [hi]
        rw [prodT_basis', evalT_basis, if_pos hprod, permT_basis]
        rw [evalT_basis, if_pos hi, prodT_basis']
        congr
        ext j
        refine Fin.addCases (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) j
        · have hidx : (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i).succAbove (Fin.castAdd n1 a) =
              Fin.castAdd (n1 + 1) a := by
            rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt]
            · ext
              simp
            · simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_castAdd, Fin.val_natAdd]
              omega
          simp only [id_eq]
          erw [ComponentIdx.congr_right (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1)) _ _ hidx]
          simp only [ComponentIdx.prod_symm_castAdd]
          exact basisIdxCongr_heq_arg _ _ (by
            simp only [basisIdxCongr, Equiv.cast_apply]
            exact (cast_heq _ _).trans (cast_heq _ _))
        · have hidx : (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i).succAbove
              (Fin.natAdd (m := n1) n a) =
              Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n (i.succAbove a) := by
            have hcond : ((Fin.natAdd (m := n1) n a).castSucc <
                Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) ↔
                (a.castSucc < i) := by
              simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_natAdd]
              omega
            simp only [Fin.succAbove, hcond]
            split_ifs <;> ext <;> simp [Nat.add_assoc]
          simp only [id_eq]
          erw [ComponentIdx.congr_right (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1)) _ _ hidx]
          simp only [ComponentIdx.prod_symm_natAdd]
          exact basisIdxCongr_heq_arg _ _ (by
            simp only [basisIdxCongr, Equiv.cast_apply]
            exact (cast_heq _ _).trans (cast_heq _ _))
      · have hprod : ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1) (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) ≠
            basisIdxCongr (by simp) x := by
          intro hprod
          exact hi (by simpa [ComponentIdx.prod] using hprod)
        rw [prodT_basis', evalT_basis, if_neg hprod]
        rw [evalT_basis, if_neg hi]
        simp
    · simp
    · simp [ht]
    · simp [map_add, ht2, ht3]
  · simp
  · simp [ht]
  · simp [map_add, ht2, ht3]

/-- An open set in ℝ containing a point in [0, 2π) has infinite intersection with (0, 2π) -/
lemma open_set_intersect_Ioo_infinite
    (U : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (θ₀ : ℝ) (hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ U) (hθ₀_range : θ₀ ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Set.Infinite (U ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi))

/-- An open set in ℝ containing a point in [0, 2π) has infinite intersection with (0, 2π) -/
lemma open_set_intersect_Ioo_infinite
    (U : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (θ₀ : ℝ) (hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ U) (hθ₀_range : θ₀ ∈ Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Set.Infinite (U ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_ball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU θ₀ hθ₀
  have h_ball_eq : Metric.ball θ₀ ε = Set.Ioo (θ₀ - ε) (θ₀ + ε) := Real.ball_eq_Ioo θ₀ ε
  rw [h_ball_eq] at hε_ball
  rw [Set.mem_Ico] at hθ₀_range
  by_cases hθ₀_zero : θ₀ = 0
  · have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    set δ := min ε (2 * Real.pi) with hδ_def
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hε_pos (by linarith)
    have h_subset : Set.Ioo 0 δ ⊆ U ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hx
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply hε_ball
        rw [Set.mem_Ioo, hθ₀_zero]
        simp only [sub_zero, zero_add]
        constructor
        · linarith [hx.1]
        · have hx_lt : x < δ := hx.2
          have hδ_le : δ ≤ ε := min_le_left ε (2 * Real.pi)
          linarith
      · exact hx.1
      · have hx_lt : x < δ := hx.2
        have hδ_le : δ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := min_le_right ε (2 * Real.pi)
        linarith
    have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.Ioo 0 δ) := Set.Ioo_infinite hδ_pos
    exact h_inf.mono h_subset
  · have hθ₀_pos : θ₀ > 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hθ₀_range.1 (Ne.symm hθ₀_zero)
    have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    set a := max 0 (θ₀ - ε) with ha_def
    set b := min (θ₀ + ε) (2 * Real.pi) with hb_def
    have ha_lt_θ₀ : a < θ₀ := by
      rw [ha_def]
      apply max_lt hθ₀_pos
      linarith
    have hθ₀_lt_b : θ₀ < b := by
      rw [hb_def]
      simp only [lt_min_iff, lt_add_iff_pos_right]
      constructor
      · exact hε_pos
      · exact hθ₀_range.2
    have ha_lt_b : a < b := lt_trans ha_lt_θ₀ hθ₀_lt_b
    have h_subset : Set.Ioo a b ⊆ U ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hx
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply hε_ball
        rw [Set.mem_Ioo]
        constructor
        · have ha_ge : a ≥ θ₀ - ε := le_max_right 0 (θ₀ - ε)
          linarith [hx.1]
        · have hb_le : b ≤ θ₀ + ε := min_le_left (θ₀ + ε) (2 * Real.pi)
          linarith [hx.2]
      · have ha_ge : a ≥ 0 := le_max_left 0 (θ₀ - ε)
        linarith [hx.1]
      · have hb_le : b ≤ 2 * Real.pi := min_le_right (θ₀ + ε) (2 * Real.pi)
        linarith [hx.2]
    have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.Ioo a b) := Set.Ioo_infinite ha_lt_b
    exact h_inf.mono h_subset

import Mathlib

open Affine EuclideanGeometry

/-- Three distinct points on a circle (sphere in 2D) centered at O with positive radius are noncollinear.
    This is because a line intersects a circle in at most 2 points.
    Proof strategy: Assume collinear, then all 3 points lie on a line.
    The line intersects the circle in at most 2 points, contradicting that A, B, C are distinct. -/
lemma three_points_on_sphere_noncollinear
    (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r)
    (A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hA : dist A O = r) (hB : dist B O = r) (hC : dist C O = r)
    (hAB : A ≠ B) (hBC : B ≠ C) (hAC : A ≠ C) :
    ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := by
  intro hcol
  rcases hcol.wbtw_or_wbtw_or_wbtw with hw | hw | hw
  · have hsbtw : Sbtw ℝ A B C := ⟨hw, hAB.symm, hBC⟩
    have h := hsbtw.dist_lt_max_dist O
    rw [hA, hC, max_self] at h
    exact (hB.symm ▸ h).false
  · have hsbtw : Sbtw ℝ B C A := ⟨hw, hBC.symm, hAC.symm⟩
    have h := hsbtw.dist_lt_max_dist O
    rw [hB, hA, max_self] at h
    exact (hC.symm ▸ h).false
  · have hsbtw : Sbtw ℝ C A B := ⟨hw, hAC, hAB⟩
    have h := hsbtw.dist_lt_max_dist O
    rw [hC, hB, max_self] at h
    exact (hA.symm ▸ h).false

/-- If three points on a circle (centered at O) have the same color c,
    and these points form a valid 2-simplex, then O has color c.
    Proof: The three points are noncollinear (on a circle), so they form a simplex.
    Their circumcenter is O (center of the circle). By the problem hypothesis,
    the circumcenter has the same color as the vertices. -/
lemma circumcenter_color_of_three_same_color_on_sphere
    (color : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Bool)
    (h : ∀ (s : Simplex ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, color (s.points i) = color (s.points j)) →
      color s.circumcenter = color (s.points 0))
    (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r)
    (A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hA : dist A O = r) (hB : dist B O = r) (hC : dist C O = r)
    (hAB : A ≠ B) (hBC : B ≠ C) (hAC : A ≠ C)
    (c : Bool) (hcA : color A = c) (hcB : color B = c) (hcC : color C = c) :
    color O = c := by
  have hCosph : Cospherical ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := by
    rw [cospherical_def]
    exact ⟨O, r, fun p hp => by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hA
      · exact hB
      · exact hC⟩
  have hAffInd : AffineIndependent ℝ ![A, B, C] :=
    hCosph.affineIndependent_of_ne hAB hAC hBC
  let s : Simplex ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2 := ⟨![A, B, C], hAffInd⟩
  have hSpanTop : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range s.points) = ⊤ := by
    have hCard : Fintype.card (Fin 3) = Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) + 1 := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace]
    exact hAffInd.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one.mpr hCard
  have hO_mem : O ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range s.points) := by rw [hSpanTop]; trivial
  have hDist : ∀ i : Fin 3, dist (s.points i) O = r := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [s, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hA, hB, hC]
  have hO_circum : O = s.circumcenter := s.eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq hO_mem hDist
  have hpts0 : s.points 0 = A := by simp [s, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
  have hpts1 : s.points 1 = B := by simp [s, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
  have hpts2 : s.points 2 = C := by
    show (![C]) 0 = C
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  have hSameColor : ∀ i j : Fin 3, color (s.points i) = color (s.points j) := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hpts0, hpts1, hpts2, hcA, hcB, hcC]
  have hCircumColor := h s hSameColor
  rw [← hO_circum, hpts0] at hCircumColor
  rw [hCircumColor, hcA]

/-- Helper: convert a pair to EuclideanSpace -/
noncomputable def myToEuclidean (x y : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  ![x, y]

/-- The parameterization function for sphere_infinite proofs -/
noncomputable def sphereParam (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  O + r • myToEuclidean (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ)

/-- Helper lemma: the unit vector has norm 1 -/
lemma norm_myToEuclidean_cos_sin (θ : ℝ) : ‖myToEuclidean (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ)‖ = 1 := by
  unfold myToEuclidean
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 1
    arg 2
    ext i
    rw [show (![Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) i = ![Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ] i from rfl]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, Real.sqrt_one]

/-- Check that points are on the sphere -/
lemma sphereParam_on_sphere (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (θ : ℝ) :
    dist (sphereParam O r θ) O = r := by
  unfold sphereParam
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr, norm_myToEuclidean_cos_sin, mul_one]

/-- Helper for angle uniqueness -/
lemma Real.sin_int_mul_two_pi' (n : ℤ) : Real.sin (n * (2 * Real.pi)) = 0 := by
  have h : (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = (2 * n : ℤ) * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
  rw [h, Real.sin_int_mul_pi]

/-- If cos and sin agree on (0, 2π), the angles are equal -/
lemma cos_sin_eq_of_Ioo {θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (h1 : θ₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (h2 : θ₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (hcos : Real.cos θ₁ = Real.cos θ₂) (hsin : Real.sin θ₁ = Real.sin θ₂) : θ₁ = θ₂ := by
  have hcos_c : Complex.cos θ₁ = Complex.cos θ₂ := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, hcos]
  rw [Complex.cos_eq_cos_iff] at hcos_c
  obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ := hcos_c
  · have hk_real : (θ₂ : ℝ) = 2 * k * Real.pi + θ₁ := by
      have := congrArg Complex.re hk
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
      convert this using 1
      simp
    rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at h1 h2
    have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    have hbound : -2 * Real.pi < 2 * k * Real.pi ∧ 2 * k * Real.pi < 2 * Real.pi := by
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hk_zero : k = 0 := by
      rcases Int.lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk_neg | hk_zero | hk_pos
      · have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by
          have := Int.le_sub_one_of_lt hk_neg
          simp only [sub_self] at this
          exact_mod_cast this
        have : 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.pi ≤ -2 * Real.pi := by nlinarith
        linarith [hbound.1]
      · exact hk_zero
      · have hk_ge : (k : ℝ) ≥ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk_pos
        have : 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.pi ≥ 2 * Real.pi := by nlinarith
        linarith [hbound.2]
    simp [hk_zero] at hk_real
    linarith
  · have hk_real : (θ₂ : ℝ) = 2 * k * Real.pi - θ₁ := by
      have := congrArg Complex.re hk
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
      convert this using 1
      simp
    rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at h1 h2
    have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    have hsin_eq : Real.sin (2 * k * Real.pi - θ₁) = Real.sin θ₁ := by
      rw [← hk_real, hsin]
    have h2kpi : 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.pi = (k : ℤ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
    rw [Real.sin_sub, h2kpi, Real.sin_int_mul_two_pi', Real.cos_int_mul_two_pi] at hsin_eq
    simp at hsin_eq
    have hsin_zero : Real.sin θ₁ = 0 := by linarith
    have hθ₁_pi : θ₁ = Real.pi := by
      have := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hsin_zero
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
      have hbound' : 0 < (n : ℝ) * Real.pi ∧ (n : ℝ) * Real.pi < 2 * Real.pi := by
        rw [hn]; exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2⟩
      have hn_pos : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by nlinarith
      have hn_lt_2 : (n : ℝ) < 2 := by nlinarith
      have hn_one : n = 1 := by
        have hn_ge_1 : n ≥ 1 := by
          by_contra h; push_neg at h
          have h' : n ≤ 0 := by omega
          have : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h'
          linarith
        have hn_le_1 : n ≤ 1 := by
          by_contra h; push_neg at h
          have : (n : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h
          linarith
        omega
      rw [hn_one] at hn; simp at hn; exact hn.symm
    have hsin_zero_2 : Real.sin θ₂ = 0 := hsin ▸ hsin_zero
    have hθ₂_pi : θ₂ = Real.pi := by
      have := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hsin_zero_2
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
      have hbound' : 0 < (n : ℝ) * Real.pi ∧ (n : ℝ) * Real.pi < 2 * Real.pi := by
        rw [hn]; exact ⟨h2.1, h2.2⟩
      have hn_pos : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by nlinarith
      have hn_lt_2 : (n : ℝ) < 2 := by nlinarith
      have hn_one : n = 1 := by
        have hn_ge_1 : n ≥ 1 := by
          by_contra h; push_neg at h
          have h' : n ≤ 0 := by omega
          have : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h'
          linarith
        have hn_le_1 : n ≤ 1 := by
          by_contra h; push_neg at h
          have : (n : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h
          linarith
        omega
      rw [hn_one] at hn; simp at hn; exact hn.symm
    rw [hθ₁_pi, hθ₂_pi]

/-- Injectivity of the parameterization on (0, 2π) -/
lemma sphereParam_injective_on_Ioo (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Set.InjOn (sphereParam O r) (Set.Ioo 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := by
  intro θ₁ hθ₁ θ₂ hθ₂ h
  unfold sphereParam at h
  have h' : r • myToEuclidean (Real.cos θ₁) (Real.sin θ₁) = r • myToEuclidean (Real.cos θ₂) (Real.sin θ₂) := by
    have := congrArg (· - O) h
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    exact this
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have h'' := smul_right_injective (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) hr_ne h'
  unfold myToEuclidean at h''
  have hcos : Real.cos θ₁ = Real.cos θ₂ := by
    have := congrFun h'' 0
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hsin : Real.sin θ₁ = Real.sin θ₂ := by
    have := congrFun h'' 1
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at this
    exact this
  exact cos_sin_eq_of_Ioo hθ₁ hθ₂ hcos hsin

/-- The antipodal point of G on circle_R is at distance r from R -/
lemma antipodal_on_circle (R G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (hRG : dist R G = r) :
    dist ((2 : ℝ) • R - G) R = r := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have h : (2 : ℝ) • R - G - R = R - G := by
    simp only [two_smul, sub_sub]
    abel
  rw [h]
  rw [norm_sub_rev, ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]
  exact hRG

/-- The antipodal point of G on circle_R is at distance 2r from G -/
lemma antipodal_far_from_G (R G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (hRG : dist R G = r) :
    dist ((2 : ℝ) • R - G) G = 2 * r := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have h : (2 : ℝ) • R - G - G = (2 : ℝ) • (R - G) := by
    simp only [smul_sub, two_smul]
    abel
  rw [h]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
  rw [← dist_eq_norm]
  rw [hRG]
